jobs.title: Software Engineer Focus on Testing (all genders)
jobs.description:
Welcome to baramundi!

"Don't leave your future to chance."

The software market is constantly evolving – just like our development team. To strengthen our Research & Development department, we are looking for flexible thinkers and agile doers. After all, the success of baramundi solutions doesn't come out of nowhere – it comes 100% from Germany. At our Augsburg location, well-coordinated teams from the disciplines of software development, testing, product ownership, and agile coaching are shaping the software products of tomorrow.

The only thing we're missing right now is you.

Do What You Do Best

TAKE RESPONSIBILITY You take responsibility for the quality of our product and actively shape the further development of our testing processes
BE AGILE As part of a self-organized Scrum team, you are responsible for tests at all levels – with a focus on developing automated test solutions
THINK AHEAD You consistently develop the test strategy together with experienced test engineers
WORK NETWORKED You participate in cross-departmental coordination
SET GOALS You work hand in hand with your team, support the definition of clear acceptance criteria, and accompany their implementation until approval
HAVE FUN You find your place in our colorful and collegial environment

What We Appreciate About You

A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a comparable qualification
Several years of professional experience in software development—ideally with a focus on software testing
Strong proficiency in software development using C# or C++
Experience with at least one scripting language — ideally Python or PowerShell
In-depth knowledge of test automation, test design, test strategy, defect management, and test case creation
Enthusiasm for designing, implementing, and maintaining automated component and functional tests as well as associated test frameworks
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, preferably with Microsoft Azure DevOps
Excellent written and spoken German and good written and spoken English

Our Doing

Programming languages: current object-oriented programming languages C# and Python
Development environments: Visual Studio, Team Foundation Server, unit test frameworks, or Git
Nice to have: knowledge in .NET (Core), SQL Server, and ISTQB certification
Client-server applications: WPF, Windows API, WCF, Microsoft web frameworks, and other web technologies

Meet us!

10 reasons to choose baramundi!

#1 ARRIVE IN PEACE

Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace.

#2 FEEL AT HOME

Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because.

#3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION

We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions.

#4 GET REWARDED

You will also feel our appreciation. Success bonuses are as natural as Christmas bonuses, company pension plans, and team events.

#5 ENJOY LIFE

Work time is life time. That’s why you can organize it individually with us. With flexible working hours in full or part-time, home office, and even sabbatical options.

#6 STAY HEALTHY

We want you to feel good. That’s why we have ergonomic furniture and organize health days, massages, yoga, and running groups.

#7 DEVELOP FURTHER

Your personal and professional advancement is important to us. We pay for training and coaching during working hours. Even two-year work stays at our branch in the USA are possible.

#8 WORK AT EYE LEVEL

We are all on a first-name basis, from apprentices to management. We don’t have complicated hierarchies.

#9 YOUR FAMILY IS IMPORTANT TO US

Family means being there, caring, and supporting each other. We do this with daycare subsidies and holiday care, as well as at our family summer festival.

#10 MAKE US EVEN BETTER

We want to be a great place and employer. For that, we need honest feedback.

Contact us!

About Us

As a specialist in Unified Endpoint Management (baramundi Management Suite) and Digital Employee Experience (baramundi Proactive Hub/baramundi perform2work), baramundi software GmbH ensures that companies and organizations can manage work environments and digital workplaces efficiently, securely, and across platforms—both on-premises and in the cloud. baramundi software GmbH is headquartered in Augsburg. The products and services of the company, founded in 2000, are entirely made in the EU. baramundi successfully collaborates with partner companies worldwide for sales, consulting, and customer support.

At the headquarters in Augsburg, as well as at locations in Austria, Switzerland, the U.S., the U.K., Poland, and Italy, more than 350 employees are currently working together to ensure baramundi’s success. Join our international team—we look forward to getting to know you!

Verantwortungsbewusste, strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch sowie Freude an Teamarbeit und Wissensaustausch.

jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Technische Gesamtverantwortung: Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central – von der Architektur über das Design bis hin zur technischen Umsetzung.
Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du trägst die technische Verantwortung für unsere Business-Central-Lösungen, berätst unsere Kunden auf Augenhöhe und triffst maßgebliche Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen. Dabei unterstützt du Kunden und interne Consultants bei Lösungsarchitekturen, Erweiterungsstrategien und dem zielgerichteten Einsatz von Technologien – nach dem Prinzip „Standard first“.
Effiziente Entwicklung: Du konzipierst und entwickelst komplexe Extensions in AL und stellst durch Code-Reviews, Qualitätssicherung und Performance-Optimierung einen hohen technischen Standard sicher.
Integration & Prozessoptimierung: Du planst und realisierst Integrationen und Schnittstellen (z. B. Web Services, APIs, Azure Services) in hybride Systemlandschaften und trägst so maßgeblich zur Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen bei.
Upgrades & Migrationen: Du steuerst Upgrades und Migrationen (z. B. von NAV zu Business Central oder von On-Premises zu Cloud/SaaS) inklusive der Erstellung und Umsetzung technischer Migrationskonzepte.
Mentoring & Weiterentwicklung: Du coachst Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler im Team, wirkst aktiv an Best Practices, Entwicklungsrichtlinien und Tooling mit und treibst so die technische Weiterentwicklung unseres Business-Central-Portfolios voran. Dabei unterstützt du das Team aktiv in seiner fachlichen und technischen Weiterentwicklung.

DEIN PROFIL

Erfahrung mit Business Central / NAV: Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Design von Lösungen mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central bzw. jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Technische Gesamtverantwortung: Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central – von der Architektur über das Design bis hin zur technischen Umsetzung.
Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du trägst die technische Verantwortung für unsere Business-Central-Lösungen, berätst unsere Kunden auf Augenhöhe und triffst maßgebliche Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen. Dabei unterstützt du Kunden und interne Consultants bei Lösungsarchitekturen, Erweiterungsstrategien und dem zielgerichteten Einsatz von Technologien – nach dem Prinzip „Standard first“.
Effiziente Entwicklung: Du konzipierst und entwickelst komplexe Extensions in AL und stellst durch Code-Reviews, Qualitätssicherung und Performance-Optimierung einen hohen technischen Standard sicher.
Integration & Prozessoptimierung: Du planst und realisierst Integrationen und Schnittstellen (z. B. Web Services, APIs, Azure Services) in hybride Systemlandschaften und trägst so maßgeblich zur Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen bei.
Upgrades & Migrationen: Du steuerst Upgrades und Migrationen (z. B. von NAV zu Business Central oder von On-Premises zu Cloud/SaaS) inklusive der Erstellung und Umsetzung technischer Migrationskonzepte.
Mentoring & Weiterentwicklung: Du coachst Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler im Team, wirkst aktiv an Best Practices, Entwicklungsrichtlinien und Tooling mit und treibst so die technische Weiterentwicklung unseres Business-Central-Portfolios voran. Dabei unterstützt du das Team aktiv in seiner fachlichen und technischen Weiterentwicklung.

DEIN PROFIL

Erfahrung mit Business Central / NAV: Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Design von Lösungen mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central bzw. Microsoft Dynamics NAV – idealerweise in mehreren End-to-End-Projekten. AL beherrschst du sicher, arbeitest routiniert mit Visual Studio Code und dem BC-Entwicklungsstack und kennst die BC-Architektur sowohl On-Premises als auch in der SaaS-Welt sehr gut.
Starkes technisches Fundament: Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in Integrationsszenarien mit C#/.NET, REST- und SOAP-Webservices sowie mit relationalen Datenbanken (z. B. SQL Server).
DevOps im Alltag: Azure DevOps ist für dich mehr als ein Buzzword: Du nutzt Repos, Pipelines und Boards in der Praxis und etablierst moderne Entwicklungsprozesse wie CI/CD, sinnvolle Branching-Strategien und automatisiertes Testing.
Kundenfokus & Kommunikation: Du berätst gerne auf Augenhöhe, kannst komplexe technische Inhalte verständlich erklären und arbeitest souverän mit Fachbereichen zusammen – gerne auch in Presales-Situationen und in Workshops.
KI-Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabeim Potentiale von KI zu nutzen.
Arbeitsweise & Sprachen: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, lösungsorientiert und bringst dich aktiv ins Team ein. Wissen teilst du gerne mit anderen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Gestalte Testarchitekturen: Entwickle und pflege Testautomatisierungsarchitekturen und stelle die Qualität geschäftskritischer Software sicher.
Implementiere und überwache Tests: Setze Automatisierungslösungen um, integriere sie in CI/CD-Pipelines, generiere Testdaten und führe automatisierte Testfälle aus, dokumentiere Abweichungen und stimme deren Behebung mit dem Entwicklungsteam ab.
Koordiniere Teams und Lasttests: Leite kleine Teams von technischen Testern, implementiere Testszenarien für Lasttests und stelle sicher, dass sie effizient ausgeführt werden.
Berate Stakeholder: Unterstütze User der Fachabteilungen und Entwicklungsteams bei Fragen zur Softwarequalität und Testmaßnahmen.
Unterstütze die Testplanung: Trage durch Schätzungen und Statusberichte zur Planung und Steuerung von Testaufgaben bei.
Arbeite neue Teammitglieder ein: Unterstütze neue Tester:innen bei der Einarbeitung und teile dein Wissen, um den Testprozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

DEIN PROFIL

Fachliche Qualifikation: Ein Ausbildungs- oder Studienabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik bildet deine Basis für diese Rolle.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Developer who enjoys solving complex problems and building systems that scale. You’ll be part of a tight-knit, cross-functional squad that owns its products from idea to production.

You’ll have the freedom to lead and make technical decisions, the space to experiment, and the support to keep developing your skills. We’ll encourage you to grow into a T-shaped developer, with opportunities to get involved in architecture, DevOps and other areas of development.

We work together in our Liverpool HQ three days a week because we value collaboration, fast feedback and a strong team culture.

Role:
Senior Backend Developer

Location:
Liverpool City Centre HQ / Hybrid (3 days in office) **

Salary:
£65,000–£75,000 depending on experience**

What You’ll Do:

Build and maintain scalable backend services using .NET 8.0 and Azure
Write clean, testable and performant code that’s built to last
Design and implement APIs and database solutions
Deploy and run services using Docker and Azure Cloud
Work closely with product owners and designers to bring features to life
Mentor other developers and help raise the standard across the team
Share ideas and contribute to how we build and improve our systems

Our Tech Stack:

Backend:
C#, .NET 8.0, Mediator, MassTransit

Database:
SQL Server, Entity Framework, Redis, Mongo

Infrastructure:
Docker, Azure, K8s, RabbitMQ

Monitoring:
Grafana, Loki Stack

Tooling:
Git, CI/CD pipelines, Unit and Integration Testing, Agile methodologies

It’s a bonus if you’re familiar with Clean Architecture or the Mediator pattern, but curiosity and a willingness to learn are just as valuable.

Engineering Practices:

We care deeply about quality and maintainability.

We use CI/CD pipelines for fast and reliable deployments
Automated testing and peer reviews are part of our daily rhythm
Our systems are monitored with Grafana and Loki, giving full visibility across environments
We encourage experimentation, retrospectives and continuous improvement in everything we build

What We’re Looking For:

Solid experience with C#, .NET and Dockerised microservices
Strong understanding of SQL Server and Entity Framework
Understanding of event driven architecture and modern microservice patterns
Experience with testing, CI/CD and cloud deployments
A team player who enjoys mentoring and collaborating
A pragmatic problem solver who writes clean, maintainable code
A genuine desire to learn and help others grow

Why Join Us:

Modern tech stack and a strong culture of engineering excellence
A collaborative squad where your ideas make a real impact
Clear path into technical leadership or architecture
Freedom to innovate and take ownership
Top-tier tools and a workspace built for creativity and collaboration

Team and Culture

You’ll be joining a collaborative squad of engineers, designers and product thinkers who enjoy building great software together.

We believe in ownership, curiosity and craftsmanship. Everyone has a voice, and we trust each other to make good decisions. We support one another, share knowledge and celebrate success as a team.

We’re passionate about technology, but even more passionate about building a team that trusts, respects and learns from each other.

Grow with Acorn

At Acorn Insurance, we’re proud of our Liverpool roots — and even prouder of how far we’ve come. As part of the Acorn Group, we bring over 40 years of specialist insurance expertise to the table. From humble beginnings, we’ve grown into a national leader, now employing 1,700+ people across the UK and reached a milestone £750 million in total value of insurance policies written in 2024.

We’re growing fast, with new opportunities emerging every week. That growth is largely due to the values we share:

🦏 We run through walls for our customers and each other
🐐 We challenge the status quo
🐧 We succeed when we help those around us succeed
🐆 We decide quickly when the smart thing to do is use our judgement

Benefits:

🌴 A maximum of 35 days’ holiday (depending on role and tenure) including bank holidays, with additional buy/sell options
🧠 24/7 mental health support & free counselling available
☝ Grow with us: Through career fairs, leadership programs, and learning on the go!
💸 Flexible benefits, including early access to salary via our internal platform
🏡 Hybrid working options to support work-life balance and individual needs
🎉 Recognition awards, social events & more

Our Commitment to our colleague’s:

These aren’t just words — they’re the principles we live by. And we’re proud to back them up with real action, earning recognition and accreditation from leading organisations that share our commitment to people and growth:

🧠 Mindful Employer – championing mental health and wellbeing
♿ Disability Confident Level 1 & 2 – creating accessible, inclusive opportunities
🌸 Menopause Friendly accredited – supporting every stage of life
🎖️ Armed Forces Covenant signatory – honouring those who serve
🎖️ Armed Forces Defence employer recognition scheme - Supporting those who serve
🏆 Great Places to Work 2024/25 – fostering an engaging and positive workplace culture
📈 Best Place to Work for Development – proud to be investing in people’s future
👩‍💼 Best Place to Work for Women – breaking down barriers to women's career progression

If you’re looking for a company with a strong culture, real career progression, and a people-first approach — all rooted in the heart of Liverpool — Grow with Acorn.

A Few Things to Know Before You Apply

We’re really excited that you’re considering joining Acorn! To help everything go smoothly, here are a couple of things to keep in mind:

If your application is successful, we will commence relevant employment checks prior to you commencing employment with us. These will include a standard criminal record check and an insolvency register check.

🌍 Visa Requirements

Because our training is quite comprehensive, we can only consider applicants who have at least one year remaining on their Graduate or Post-Study Work visa. At the moment, we’re not able to offer visa sponsorship.

💬 We’re Here to Support You

We’re committed to creating an inclusive, supportive workplace where everyone can flourish. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process—or once you’re part of the team—just let us know. Whether it’s flexible hours, adapted equipment, or a bit of extra support, we’ll work with you to make sure you can do your best work.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Redgate creates simple software to help data professionals get the most value out of any database. Our solutions solve complex database management challenges across the DevOps lifecycle, making life easier for IT leaders, development, and operations teams by increasing efficiency, reducing errors, and protecting business-critical data. The data community trusts Redgate to balance speed to market, team collaboration, and data protection.
Find out more about us here:

Redgate Software – Culture
Flexa Careers
Glassdoor
RepVue

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll be part of a small, cross-functional team that typically includes a Tech Lead, Lead Software Engineer, Product Designer, Product Manager, and 4–5 software engineers. Beyond your immediate team, you'll benefit from the support of the Group Engineering Manager—who oversees delivery, people, and processes across the group—an architect who provides technical direction at the product level, and a coaching function to help you get unblocked.

This Senior Software Engineer role is for one of the teams working on Redgate Monitor, our flagship monitoring solution.
Redgate Monitor is a widely used tool that helps organisations proactively monitor, diagnose, and optimise their database environments. As part of the Monitor team, you’ll contribute to the ongoing evolution of a mature, high-impact product. You’ll have the opportunity to influence architectural decisions, improve system performance, and deliver features that directly benefit thousands of customers worldwide.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you are expected to demonstrate both breadth and depth of technical expertise. You will confidently solve complex problems with clean, simple solutions, lead and contribute to large, challenging projects, and act as a technical influencer within your team. In addition to championing best practices, you will proactively drive improvements in processes, tooling, and architecture that benefit the wider engineering organisation.

Beyond technical skills, a key part of the senior role is elevating others. This includes mentoring, coaching, teaching, and sharing your expertise through conversations, documentation, and technical talks. You act as a force multiplier, raising the technical abilities of your teammates and improving the engineering environment for all. With a growth mindset, you will actively foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and psychological safety.

Responsibilities (not in order of importance)

Designing, building and testing world-class software, with a focus on scalable, resilient, and secure systems.
Providing guidance and direction to the team when faced with software design and implementation challenges, owning the toughest and most ambiguous technical problems.
Writing well-tested code and maintaining high standards for code quality, system design, and testing.
Taking part in reviews of your own and other developers’ code, offering specific, actionable feedback on code, designs, and behaviours that helps others.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | API Enterprise
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the API Enterprise
team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem. Whereas the Core team obsesses over the self-service developer journey, our focus is on enterprise customer adoption: the usage insights, cost controls, RBAC , compliance, and data residency capabilities that enterprise IT and security teams depend on. We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.

We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Drive Enterprise API Adoption: You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs
Build for Governance & Compliance: You will design the controls enterprise IT and security admins rely on (roles and permissions, projects, data residency, and audit-ability), making DeepL the compliant default for regulated, global organizations
Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability: You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. You will implement strong contract testing, monitoring, and SLOs, preventing breaking changes and security vulnerabilities before they reach our enterprise customers
Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem: You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities

Qualities we look for

An "Enterprise-First" Mindset: You treat enterprise IT and security admins as your primary users. You understand that earning their trust means clear governance, predictable cost control, robust compliance, fast response times and data residency. You're a strong communicator who's comfortable owning product decisions and implementing them
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and distributed architectures, primarily in C# / .NET, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong API design fundamentals and system design are core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/TypeScript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement
Enterprise Platform Fluency: You bring hands-on experience with the building blocks of modern enterprise APIs (MCP, CLIs, and OAuth) and know how to wield them to build secure, extensible integrations
Cross-Team Leadership: You have a track record of leading projects across multiple teams. You can align with different areas and other stakeholders, manage cross-team contracts and dependencies, and keep complex, interconnected systems coherent
Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, learn from incidents, and treat mature SLOs as a core engineering feature
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery so you can focus your energy on high-value architecture and complex problem-solving
Bonus points if you have: a track record of zero-downtime migrations on live systems; experience with metering, quota, or usage-data systems; worked in a compliance environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, C5, or similar)

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

We're recruiting for an experienced Technical Solution Architect to join our Technology team here at Penguin. This role is offered on a permanent basis with hybrid working from our office in Embassy Gardens, London.

This is a senior architecture role with a strong engineering focus. You’ll work to shape and assure our integration architecture, turning wider technology strategy into practical, implementable patterns that our engineering teams can use with confidence.

A key focus of the role will be supporting the modernisation of our integration landscape, as we move away from hundreds of point-to-point and file-based integrations towards a more governed platform of reusable business-domain services, REST APIs, business events and Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces on Azure.

You’ll work closely with engineering teams to guide this transition incrementally, helping us to reduce complexity, improve resilience and make change easier, whilst ensuring the stability and continuity of our existing live services. It’s a role for someone who combines credible architecture expertise with recent, hands-on engineering experience and who enjoys working closely with delivery teams to turn architectural direction into solutions that work in practice.

About the team

The Technology team provides expertise and effective solutions to Penguin Random House. We integrate flexibility and agility which supports our consistent way of working. We set ourselves up for success by holding ourselves accountable and welcoming change. Each member of the Technology team brings skill and initiative to their role; we take personal ownership within a one team culture, working collaboratively to meet expectations from our stakeholders who trust us to deliver.

The role

Key responsibilities:

Own and evolve the target architecture, principles and migration roadmap for Integration Services, defining clear business-domain boundaries, service ownership and stable contracts.
Set reusable architectural patterns for APIs, business events, adapters, synchronous and asynchronous communication, versioning and compatibility.
Design Azure integration solutions using services including API Management, Service Bus, Logic Apps, Functions, App Services, Container Apps or AKS, Key Vault and appropriate data services.
Define non-functional and engineering requirements across security, resilience, performance, scalability, observability, supportability, disaster recovery, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and automated testing.
Create safe modernisation and coexistence approaches for legacy and partner platforms, including adapter patterns, cutover, rollback and decommissioning.
Establish secure-by-design standards across identity, authentication, authorisation, secrets and network controls, alongside appropriate governance for MCP and other AI-facing interfaces.
Maintain hands-on technical credibility through targeted prototypes, proof-of-concepts and technical spikes that help de-risk important architectural decisions.
Lead and contribute to architecture reviews, maintaining clear decisions, standards, reference designs and service documentation, while mentoring developers and enabling teams to make sound technical decisions within agreed architecture.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Data Architecture, Security, Cloud Platforms and delivery teams to ensure integration designs align with wider organisational strategy and controls.
Provide timely architectural guidance during discovery, refinement and delivery, escalating significant enterprise, security, data, commercial or cross-portfolio risks to the appropriate accountable owner.

What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

Substantial senior software engineering experience followed by credible solution-architecture accountability in complex production environments.

jobs.title: Azure DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

At IMSERV, we're proud to be one of the UK's leading energy data and metering specialists. We deliver award-winning services to customers across the country, providing specialist metering technology for electricity, gas and water, alongside highly accurate energy data collection services.

About the Role

The purpose of the role is to own the Azure platform on which IMSERV’s Astral products are built, tested and run, helping us deliver highly scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS software to clients across the globe. You will be one of two DevOps Engineers who together own the path to production: the Azure environments, the CI/CD pipelines, the releases and the security and cost posture of the estate. The pair share the full scope so that no environment, pipeline or release depends on any one individual. This role sits within our Scrum teams, working day to day with Software Engineers, Testers and the Technical Architect. Where they own the code, you own the platform it ships on, through the entire product lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Environment management.
Provision, configure and maintain the Astral environment estate (development, test, UAT/load and production), keeping environments consistent, reproducible and documented through infrastructure as code. Manage environment refreshes and test data in line with our data protection rules.
CI/CD pipelines.
Build, maintain and continuously improve our Azure DevOps build, test and release pipelines, including artifact management, controlled build configurations and pipeline variables, and automated quality and security gates. Consolidate duplicated per-client pipelines toward a single deployment path as the platform moves to multi-tenancy.
Release management.
Plan and execute deployments through the environment chain to production, with rehearsed rollback for every release. Support product go-lives and maintain a clear, communicated release calendar.
Security and access.
Own secrets and certificate management (Azure Key Vault, managed identities), role-based access control and least-privilege across the estate, and platform patching. Work with IT security on audit remediation and the security release plan.
Monitoring, reliability and recovery.
Own observability (Application Insights, Log Analytics), alerting, backups and disaster recovery, including periodic DR tests. Lead incident response for platform issues and run blameless root-cause reviews.
Cost management.
Monitor and optimise Azure spend across environments and clients; right-size resources and report on cost drivers.
Documentation and knowledge.
Keep runbooks, environment documentation and configuration records current, written up the same day work is done. We are removing single points of failure, not creating new ones.
Community membership.
Be an active member of the Scrum team and the wider Product Engineering community, taking part in sprint ceremonies, the Innovation Forum and team events, and unblocking engineers’ environment and pipeline needs quickly.

What you'll need

Essential
Has 5+ years running production Azure environments as their primary discipline (App Services, Azure SQL, storage, networking fundamentals).
Has written and maintained CI/CD, build and deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps (YAML), including artifact management, controlled build configurations and pipeline variables.
Routinely practices infrastructure as code (Bicep, ARM or Terraform) and is a confident scripter in PowerShell and the Azure CLI.
Strong appreciation for secure-by-default platform design: Key Vault, managed identities, RBAC and least privilege.
Has owned monitoring, backup and disaster recovery for a live service (Application Insights, Log Analytics), including responding to and resolving incidents.
Has worked in an Agile SCRUM team and is familiar with the associated ceremonies and artefacts.
Understands SQL Server well enough to manage environment data, refreshes and test data safely (in a Relational Database system).

Desirable:
Microsoft certification: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
Has run or supported one or more of the following Azure PaaS services: Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure API Management (APIM), Azure Logic Apps , Azure Data Factory / Synapse / Microsoft Fabric.
Enough C# / .NET to read application code and debug a failing build alongside the engineers,
Experience consolidating single-tenant, per-client deployments into a shared multi-tenant platform.
Experience of enterprise client security requirements (supplier security reviews, ISO 27001-style controls, penetration test remediation).
Practical use of AI-assisted tooling in platform and pipeline work.

Benefits

28 days' holiday plus Bank Holidays
Buy & sell annual leave scheme
Up to a 10% bonus
Enhanced salary sacrifice pension
Life assurance (up to 6x salary*)
Simply Health plan (with upgrade options)
Car salary sacrifice scheme*

(*Length of service and T&Cs apply)

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and communities. A diverse team brings fresh perspectives, strengthens collaboration and helps us deliver the best possible service to our customers.
If you're interested in the role but don't meet every single requirement, we'd still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Athera Healthcare delivers innovative healthcare solutions that improve patient outcomes and transform healthcare delivery.

About the role

We are looking for a QA Engineer who wants the opportunity to shape how quality assurance is done, rather than simply inherit an established testing process.
You will be our first dedicated QA hire and will work closely with the Head of Technology and the wider development team to define and establish a pragmatic QA approach across a varied technology estate.
Our applications span modern web technologies and long-established desktop systems, including React, Angular, .NET, Java, Delphi, WinForms/WPF and ASP.NET Web Forms.
Automation today is relatively limited. A major part of this role will be helping us change that.
We are particularly interested in someone who is keen to embrace AI-assisted testing and modern automation techniques. We do not expect you to arrive with every answer. We are looking for someone with strong QA fundamentals, good scripting and technical skills, and the curiosity to investigate new approaches and turn them into practical improvements.
This could suit an experienced mid-level QA Engineer who wants greater ownership and the opportunity to demonstrate that they can build and influence a QA capability.

What you'll be doing

The role will be approximately 50% test automation and 50% hands-on exploratory and manual testing, although the balance will naturally change depending on releases and projects.
You will:

Help define and continuously improve our overall QA strategy, processes and standards.
Build out automated regression coverage across both web and legacy desktop applications.
Investigate where AI can make testing faster, broader and more maintainable.
Convert existing manual regression tests into appropriate automated tests.
Use AI-assisted tools to help generate, maintain and improve automated test suites.
Investigate agentic and computer-use technologies for automating applications that are difficult to test using traditional automation frameworks.
Identify gaps in regression coverage and prioritise automation based on risk and business impact.
Create and maintain appropriate test data.
Use AI and automation tooling to analyse failures, diagnose issues and reduce brittle or unreliable tests.
Perform exploratory testing to identify issues that scripted and automated tests may miss.
Manually verify complex functionality and changes where automation would not provide sufficient confidence.
Test functionality across modern web applications and legacy Windows desktop systems.
Test APIs and integrations.
Participate in performance, security and non-functional testing where appropriate.
Review acceptance criteria and contribute to improving testability before development begins.
Produce proportionate test plans based on technical and business risk.
Participate in defect triage and help development teams understand and reproduce issues.
Contribute to release readiness and release sign-off.
Help manage test environments, test data and regression coverage.
Integrate automated testing into our Azure DevOps development and delivery processes.
Work closely with developers to encourage quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final release step.

AI and automation

We see AI as an important part of the future of software quality.
We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to generate test scripts. We want someone interested in understanding where AI genuinely improves QA and where traditional engineering judgement remains essential.
You will be encouraged to investigate and apply AI to areas including:
Generating initial automated test cases and scripts.
Turning manual regression scenarios into automation
Identifying potential gaps in regression coverage.
Generating realistic and useful test data.
Analysing automated test failures and logs.
Diagnosing flaky or brittle tests.
Improving and maintaining existing automated tests.
Exploring AI-driven browser automation.
Exploring computer-use and agentic testing approaches for legacy desktop applications.
Supporting exploratory testing and identifying unusual edge cases.

AI-generated tests and results must still be critically reviewed. Strong QA judgement, curiosity and the ability to recognise unexpected behaviour remain central to the role.

What we're looking for

You should have:
Commercial experience in software quality assurance or software testing.
Strong exploratory and manual testing skills.
Experience testing web applications.
An understanding of automated regression testing and when automation is appropriate.
The ability to write scripts or test automation without needing to be a full-time software developer.
An interest in modern AI-assisted and low-code/no-code automation tools.

Cogna is on a mission to solve this very complex problem. We're creating an AI-powered platform to understand these inefficiencies within customers' operating models, to define the requirements, and develop the software itself in a fully automated way. The result is high-quality, precision software at scale.

Since our launch in May 2023, we've already seen significant traction and customer revenue that outpaces most companies at our stage. We're backed by top VCs, including Notion Capital and Hoxton Ventures, and we're growing our world-class team - ex Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Palantir - to take us to the next level on our mission.

This is more than a job, it's an opportunity to be part of something genuinely transformative. Are you up for the challenge?

Overview

We are hiring multiple interns to join our team of experts building the future of software and natural language programming. Given the recent advances in AI, we're on the cusp of a seismic shift in the way software is developed. This is your chance to be part of it, and experience life at an AI startup.

jobs.description:
Waracle is looking for a Senior QA Engineer
to join our world-class digital technology consultancy. We are home to a diverse, smart, curious, and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation. We partner with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. Together, we innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design, and delivery to operations.

This role is available on Contract (Inside IR35)
bases, initially for 6 months.

As a Senior QA Engineer, you will play a vital role in defining our quality approaches, building scalable automation frameworks, and championing best practices across the development lifecycle. This role isn't just about finding bugs; it’s about collaborating with cross-functional teams and driving continuous innovation. If you thrive in a collaborative environment where your voice is heard and your technical leadership can make a tangible impact, we would love to meet you.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

Strategy & Collaboration:
Shaping testing approaches for complex features, embedding risk analysis into the workflow, and guiding exploratory testing efforts.
Framework Architecture:
Building and evolving modular, reusable, and scalable automation components, and seamlessly integrating quality checks into CI/CD pipelines.
NFR Integration:
Designing and automating tests for performance, security, and accessibility to ensure quality is built-in from the very start.
Code Quality & Standards:
Participating in peer code reviews to maintain robust automation standards and ensure overall software reliability.

What you'll bring:

QA Expertise:
Comprehensive knowledge of QA best practices, methodologies (SDLC, Agile), and a strategic mindset for ensuring deep test coverage.
Automation Mastery:
Advanced automation skills using Playwright
, with the confidence to build, extend, and maintain scalable testing frameworks while focusing on high code quality.
Programming Skills:
Practical, hands-on experience using C#
to interact with and test web applications.
Technical Mastery:
Well-rounded experience across functional, non-functional, white-box, and security testing fundamentals.
Problem-Solving Mindset:
Proactive defect management, strong triage leadership skills, and the ability to anticipate risks before they arise.
Communication & Domain Adaptability:
Excellent collaboration skills, with an ability to explain complex technical ideas simply to both teams and clients, alongside a natural curiosity to learn new project domains quickly.

The Recruitment Process

First Hello:
An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, day rate, contact length and hybrid office locations.
Craft Showcase:
A focused take-home task to demonstrate craft expertise, critical thinking and your real-world expertise.
Talking Impact:
A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual
on day one

jobs.description:
Job Description

If you are a Field Applications Engineer professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. In this role, you will partner with customers to understand their technical challenges, recommend innovative software and hardware solutions, and help drive successful outcomes using NI test and measurement technologies. Working collaboratively with account managers, customers, and internal technical teams, you will contribute to technical strategy development, customer success, and business growth while delivering value through innovation, integrity, collaboration, and inclusion.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Building key technical relationships at top accounts, demonstrating strong technical credibility and increasing customer technical confidence in NI solutions.
Understanding and assisting in the creation of customer technical requirements.
Providing recommendations on software and hardware architectures while helping customers understand the next steps to ensure success.
Collaborating with NI Account Manager(s) as part of an account team to lead development and execution of the account technical strategy, providing insight to the overall account strategy and pipeline.
Coordinating with and informing internal technical stakeholders to execute account technical initiatives and provide feedback to increase account success.
Leveraging industry, application area, and account knowledge to uncover and influence customer future technical needs and challenges, generating further technical demand for NI products, services, and support.
Building trusted customer relationships through technical consultation and solution-focused engagement.
Contributing to a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement.

This position is compensated by 80% base salary and 20% variable pay based on achievement of annual quota attainment.

Who You Are:

You build strong customer partnerships and work collaboratively across teams to meet shared objectives. You communicate effectively in a variety of settings, actively listen to understand diverse perspectives, and adapt your approach to meet stakeholder needs. You apply business insight and technical expertise to identify opportunities, solve complex challenges, and create value for customers. You consistently build trust through credibility, integrity, and a commitment to achieving successful outcomes.

For This Role, You Will Need:

Bachelor's degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
Experience applying engineering, test, measurement, automation, or software development principles in a professional environment.
Programming experience supporting technical solutions, applications, or systems development.
Willingness and ability to travel to support customer and business needs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences.
Commitment to delivering customer-focused solutions while working collaboratively across functions.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

Degree concentration in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering.
Experience with NI LabVIEW, NI TestStand, and NI PXI platform, including developer certifications.
English language competency with effective oral and written communication skills.
Advanced skill in at least one of the following programming languages: LabVIEW, .NET, Python, C++, or C#.
Advanced skill in FPGA development using VHDL or LabVIEW FPGA.
Experience in a customer-facing role.
Experience contributing to organizational, account, or engagement strategies.
Ability to integrate business, operational, and interpersonal considerations into technical engagements.
Experience supporting automated test, validation, instrumentation, or measurement applications.

Our Culture & Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

About Us

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. jobs.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Expleo is a leading global engineering service provider with UK presence in 10 locations. We are seeking a skilled automotive software test engineer to perform functional, component and integration testing of vehicle functions.

Working within an agile V-cycle delivery framework, the test team is responsible for conducting functional, component and integration level software testing against requirements. Close collaboration and clear communication with the software team is essential.

Responsibilities

Develop test plans against project plan. Design component functional and integration tests cases against design specifications. 
Execute tests cases and generate test reports.
Perform issues resolution and regression testing to root-cause failures.
Review requirements and architecture to proactively flag gaps, inconsistencies, or ambiguities.
Coordinate with software development team on testing outcomes and failures.

Qualifications

Degree (BEng / MEng) in Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, Software Engineering or closely related discipline.

Essential Skills

Automotive SW testing in HIL, component and vehicle environments.
Familiarity with verification test tooling (e.g. Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, dSPACE, or similar)
Body and HVAC domain testing experience.
Good understanding of vehicle electrical/electronic architecture.
Reading and interpreting design specifications and Simulink models.
Test documentation and reporting.

Desired Skills

Detail-oriented and self-motivated.
Pragmatic and solutions-focussed with a measured approach to risk.
Collaborative and transparent.
Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.
Excellent communication skills.

Experience

Knowledge of Euro7 emission legislation and its software/control implications.
Experience working directly with an OEM or Tier 1.
Experience in the automotive sector, including understanding of V-cycle software development methodology.
Experience with requirements and test management tools (e.g. DOORS, Polarion, or similar)

Benefits

Collaborative working environment – we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges 
We empower all passionate technology loving professionals by allowing them to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects  
Expleo Academy - enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses 
Competitive company benefits
Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo

jobs.title: Unity Developer
jobs.description:
About Rezzil

Rezzil creates innovative sports technology products across performance, gaming and broadcast. Our products serve professional teams, athletes, broadcasters and consumers, spanning VR, mobile, console and real-time 3D experiences.

Our exar.live platform provides the ingest and data transport infrastructure for live sports data, powering our own analysis tools, broadcast solutions, augmented reality graphics and virtual production experiences. Alongside continuing to develop our existing products, we are expanding into new areas including computer vision and AI-led sports technology.

Rezzil is based in Manchester and London, with flexible and hybrid working options available depending on the role.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Unity Developer with strong commercial mobile game development
experience and a track record of shipping titles on iOS and Android.

You will play a key role in developing our mobile games, working closely with design, art, technical art, backend, and product teams to take features from concept through to release.

This is a hands-on senior position. You will be expected to write high-quality production code, make sound technical decisions, help solve complex development challenges and contribute to the overall architecture and quality of the project.

You should be comfortable owning significant features and systems while also supporting other developers and helping establish strong development practices across the team.

What You'll Be Doing

Developing and maintaining mobile games in Unity and C# for iOS and Android.
Taking ownership of major gameplay features and technical systems from initial design through to release.
Working closely with designers, artists and technical artists to turn ideas into performant, polished game features.
Designing scalable, maintainable systems suitable for a live mobile product.
Integrating backend services, APIs, analytics and third-party SDKs.
Supporting online functionality, player accounts, progression and live game systems.
Optimising CPU, GPU, memory, loading times and application size across a broad range of mobile devices.
Profiling and debugging issues across both iOS and Android hardware.
Contributing to architecture, coding standards and engineering best practices.
Reviewing code and providing technical guidance to other developers.
Helping improve development workflows, tools and build processes.
Supporting releases, updates and ongoing development of live products.
Working with QA and product teams to diagnose and resolve technical issues.

Skills & Experience

Essential

Several years of professional game development experience, including experience at a senior level.
Strong commercial experience developing games with Unity and C#.
Proven experience shipping at least one commercial title, ideally multiple titles.
Strong experience developing and releasing games for iOS and Android.
Excellent understanding of software architecture, object-oriented programming and common game development patterns.
Strong knowledge of mobile performance optimisation, memory management and profiling.
Experience integrating third-party SDKs, APIs and platform services.
Good understanding of mobile platform requirements, build pipelines and submission processes.
Experience working with version control, ideally Git.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
Comfortable working collaboratively across engineering, design, art, QA and product disciplines.
Able to take ownership of complex features and make pragmatic technical decisions.

Desirable

Experience with PlayFab, particularly authentication, player data, cloud services, economy or live game functionality.
Experience developing live-service or continuously updated mobile games.
Experience with multiplayer or networked game systems.
Experience integrating analytics, attribution, crash reporting and remote configuration platforms.
Experience with Firebase or similar mobile backend services.
Understanding of mobile monetisation systems, including in-app purchases and subscriptions.
Experience with CI/CD and automated Unity build pipelines.
Experience working on sports, action or casual mobile games.
Experience mentoring or providing technical direction to other developers.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with a practical understanding of shipping mobile games.

You should be comfortable owning technical decisions, but equally comfortable collaborating with specialists across the wider team. You will understand when to build a robust long-term solution and when a simpler, pragmatic approach is the right choice.

Most importantly, you will have experience taking real games through production and release, and understand the technical challenges involved in delivering a polished product across a wide range of mobile hardware.

What We Offer

Competitive salary + share options.
25 days’ holiday + bank holidays.
Christmas closure.
Flexible working and hybrid options.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Apex Fintech Solutions (Apex) powers innovation and the future of digital wealth management by building tech-forward solutions that help simplify, automate, and facilitate access to financial markets for all. Our robust suite of fintech software enables us to support clients such as Stash, Betterment, SoFi, Webull, and eToro, amongst many others; collectively, Apex powers access to the stock market for over 22+ million end customers.

At Apex, we are changing how the securities industry operates by reinventing the status quo, which was manual, slow, and accessible only by the ultra-wealthy. We're digitizing and democratizing systems so that everyone has an opportunity to invest.

When you're at Apex, you drive this change. You're part of a global team with a clear vision: to be the trusted technology that powers the digital economy. Our offices in Austin, Dallas, Chicago, New York, Portland, Belfast, and Manila are home to over 1,000 employees.

Together, we’re shaping the future of financial innovation. Embrace change. Solve big. Win together. And be G.R.E.A.T. — grit, results, empathy, accountability, and teamwork — with Apex.

We’re proud to be recognized for the innovative work we do, the purpose-driven nature of our work, and the collaborative culture we’ve created. Here are just a few of the many awards we’ve recently received:

Best Places to Work

2026, 2025, 2024, 2023 - Presented by BuiltIn

WealthTech of the Year

2025 - Presented by US FinTech Awards

The World’s Top 250 Fintech Companies

2024 - Presented by CNBC

About This Role

We are seeking a skilled and customer-oriented Application Support Engineer
to join our production support team. In this role you will act as the primary escalation point for production issues, work alongside engineering to resolve complex problems, and use AI tooling to remove repetitive work.

Duties/Responsibilities

Incident and Escalation Response

Serve as the escalation point for frontline support, owning complex production issues end to end from triage through resolution and client communication
Participate in major incident response, providing impact analysis and actionable recommendations
Monitor system performance and availability, resolving issues before they impact clients
Manage production access and support configuration and change management activities

Automation and AI Tooling

Use AI tooling to accelerate investigation, including log analysis, data extraction, and issue reproduction
Build and maintain automations and reusable AI assets that other engineers can run
Validate AI-generated output before it reaches a client, a ticket, or production

Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing

Collaborate with development teams on fixes and improvements, and mentor newer engineers on the team
Create and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles

Education And/or Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
3+ years of experience in application support, preferably in a financial services or trading environment
2+ years in a customer-facing role
Strong foundational knowledge of networking, operating systems (Linux and Windows), and databases (MSSQL and/or NoSQL)
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or LLM-based tooling in a professional setting
Ability to read and modify application code in a compiled language preferred

Required Skills/Abilities

Strong understanding of REST APIs, Google Cloud Platform, and microservices architecture
Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases (MSSQL, MongoDB, Postgres)
Solid networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, and network security concepts
Experience with Linux and Windows operating systems
Strong scripting abilities in Python and PowerShell
Practical skill with AI coding assistants, including the ability to break a problem into a workable prompt, iterate on the output, and recognize when the tool is wrong. Experience with Claude Code preferred
Judgment about where automation pays off and where a process should stay manual
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues
Strong customer service orientation and ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Experience with observability and ticketing platforms such as Datadog, Jira, Zendesk, Confluence, and PagerDuty is a plus
Familiarity with trading systems, financial markets, and regulatory requirements is a plus

Work Environment

This role operates in a hybrid environment, in office 3 days per week.
Participation in a shared on-call rotation is required, including nights, weekends, and market holidays.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Our Rewards

We offer a robust package of employee perks and benefits, including a market-leading salary with an annual bonus, 28 days of annual leave plus 10 Northern Ireland national holidays, a training and development budget, and a pension matched up to 7%. Our benefits also cover private health insurance for medical, dental, and optical care, and life insurance. We emphasize work-life balance with flexible working hours, parental leave, a modern city center office, and a hybrid work schedule that allows for greater flexibility by partially working from home. Additional perks include monthly catered lunches, unlimited drinks and snacks, hackathon events, poker tournaments, and a charitable matching gift program.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer

Reports to: Director of Engineering

Works With: Engineering Leadership, Product Managers, Designers, Software Engineers

Hours: 37.5 pw (9.30-6pm Monday to Friday, 1 hour lunch)

Term: Permanent

Location: Hybrid - London office based in Oval (2 days / week)

About us

Artlogic is a leading technology platform for the art world. Founded in 1989, Artlogic empowers over 6,000 galleries, dealers, and art professionals worldwide to streamline their operations and grow their businesses. The company’s integrated platform combines inventory management, CRM, websites, sales, marketing, and payment tools, everything needed to run a modern and successful art business.

In 2021, Artlogic was acquired by tech investors Cove Hill Partners to accelerate innovation and expand its global reach. Since then, the company has doubled in size, with employees across London, New York, Atlanta, and Cape Town.

Today, Artlogic is entering an exciting new chapter through its merger with ArtCloud, another industry leader in art technology. Together, the two companies are uniting complementary platforms to build the most comprehensive, forward-thinking solution for the art world. This collaboration brings together deep expertise across CRM, sales, marketing, inventory, payments, and AI-powered tools, empowering galleries, artists, and collectors worldwide.

Joining Artlogic means becoming part of a growing global team that is shaping the future of how art is bought, sold, and managed, both online and in person.

Our technology team comprises over 50 people across Product, UX and Engineering working in cross-functional teams geographically distributed principally between the UK and Brazil with a technical operations team in the UK and South Africa. At present, our technology stack comprises a combination of Python, Typescript, C# in Azure, GCP and AWS cloud environments.

About the role

We are seeking a pragmatic, impact-driven AI-Native Senior Software Engineer
to help evolve and extend our platform while guiding technical direction and supporting team development.

This role centres on solving real-world problems for art professionals, making thoughtful technical decisions that balance business impact with engineering trade-offs. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and engineers to take ideas from inception through to production, ensuring we build the right solutions for our customers.

You will act as both a senior technical contributor and a product-minded engineer, someone who doesn’t just implement requirements but actively shapes them. You will challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and help ensure we are solving meaningful problems in the most effective way.

You will contribute to technical strategy by identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, performance, and user experience within our current architecture, while also supporting the evolution of our strategic platform.

This role will play a key part in driving the adoption of AI across engineering, leveraging emerging technologies and embedding AI-native workflows to improve how we design, build, and deliver software.

This role is predominantly hands-on, with around 20–30% of time on technical leadership: architecture, mentoring, and shaping how the team works.

Key Responsibilities

Help the team move faster by adopting AI-native workflows and the shift to an agentic development lifecycle, without compromising the architectural qualities that make our platform reliable, scalable, and maintainable over the long term.
Define guardrails, review practices, and validation gates that hold AI-generated code to our standards for security, reliability, and cost-efficiency (FinOps). These are first-class concerns in agentic pipelines, not afterthoughts.
Design, build, and operate software across our platform, applying the same rigour to AI-augmented work as to anything else you ship.
Embed deeply with Product and Design from the earliest stages of discovery, using rapid prototyping and iteration to compress the gap between idea and validated solution.
Act as feature lead on a rotating basis, taking accountability for the development and delivery of a feature from shaping through to production. This means partnering with Product and Design on the approach, breaking the work down, coordinating the engineers contributing to it, removing blockers, and being the person who knows the state of the feature at any point
Serve as a critical technical voice, stress-testing AI-generated solutions, surfacing second-order risks, and ensuring the team builds the right thing, not just the fast thing.
Shape platform architecture with an architectural lens, contributing to long-term decisions about how AI tooling, LLM integrations, and human-in-the-loop controls evolve across the stack.
Continuously identify and exploit opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and user experience, using observability and analysis to find signals in noisy systems.
