jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Why work for us?

A career at Janus Henderson is more than a job, it’s about investing in a brighter future together.

Our Mission at Janus Henderson is to help clients define and achieve superior financial outcomes through differentiated insights, disciplined investments, and world-class service. We will do this by protecting and growing our core business, amplifying our strengths and diversifying where we have the right.

Our Values are key to driving our success, and are at the heart of everything we do:

Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust

If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you!

Your opportunity

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will build, and you will lead the people who build. It starts with your own hands on the keyboard; it grows into ownership of a team, its deliverables, and the roadmap they work to.

Janus Henderson is undertaking a firm-wide AI transformation to become the most technologically sophisticated asset manager in the industry. Our AI capability sits in a single centralised function under the Head of AI, and Forward Deployed Engineering is the part of it that embeds with the business and builds what business units cannot stand up alone. As Principal Forward Deployed Engineer you are the most senior engineer in that team and its lead. Reporting to the Head of AI Technology, you set the technical bar, own the team’s deliverables and outputs, and are accountable for what it ships and runs — while still embedding with business units yourself.

You will also form part of the AI Technical Leadership Team, whose remit is to build an AI Technology roadmap that lines up with the JHI strategic roadmap and own the deliverables against it. It works across every AI technology remit — AI Platforms, AI Architecture, AI Engineering, and AI Governance Implementation — keeping them aligned so the firm has one coherent plan rather than four competing ones. It also decides what we adopt: you will review new models, tools, and vendors, test their claims against our own workloads, and judge whether they are feasible here, technically, commercially, and against the constraints a regulated asset manager operates under.

The balance of the role will shift, and we would rather be explicit than discover a mismatch later. Today it is predominantly hands-on: you are expected to be one of the strongest builders in the firm. As the team grows, the weight moves towards strategy, roadmap, and management, and your technical contribution shifts from writing most of the code to setting direction and holding the standard. If you want to stay purely hands-on, the Forward Deployed Engineer role is the better fit.

What success looks like

Your team ships. Solutions reach production, are used, and stay healthy — and you can point to the business outcome, not the delivery activity.
You are still trusted technically. Engineers bring you the hard problems, and you are close enough to the work to help.
The Forward Deployed Engineering roadmap is sequenced, agreed with the AI Technical Leadership Team, and lines up with the JHI strategic roadmap.
Technology decisions are evidence-based, and your engineers grow — people join, get productive quickly, take on more, and stay.

Your responsibilities

Lead the
team and own its deliverables

Line-manage Forward Deployed Engineers as the team grows: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development, and performance.
Own the team’s deliverables and outputs — what is committed, what is delivered, to what standard, and by when.
Allocate people and effort across the demand pipeline, and be the person who says no, not yet, or not like that.
Hold the engineering bar through design and code review, and grow engineers into owning engagements themselves.
Report progress, risk, and capacity to the Head of AI Technology and to business stakeholders honestly, including when delivery is off track.

Build and deliver, hands on

Design, build, and productionise bespoke, higher-complexity AI solutions yourself, taking the hardest and least-defined engagements personally.
Own the architecture and design decisions for the team’s solutions, keeping them secure, scalable, and aligned to the enterprise core stack.
Take solutions through evaluation, observability, and our AI governance checkpoints, and keep them healthy afterwards.

Own the roadmap and the technology choices

Form part of the AI Technical Leadership Team, and build an AI Technology roadmap that lines up with the JHI strategic roadmap.
Work across the AI technology remits — AI Platforms, AI Architecture, AI Engineering, and AI Governance Implementation — owning the Forward Deployed Engineering deliverables and keeping them aligned to enterprise architecture.
Contribute to AI technology strategy, standards, and buy-versus-build, and to the investment recommendations and backlog that follow.
Review new models, tools, and vendors and determine their feasibility here, weighing cost, licensing, security, supportability, and vendor viability alongside capability, and documenting the recommendation — including the recommendation not to adopt.

Embed with the business and build investment capability

Sit with business users and hold the relationship senior enough that the team is invited into problems early rather than handed finished requirements.
Partner with the AI Enablement Partners on escalated demand, and set realistic expectations with senior stakeholders.
Build advanced investment capability on Nexus, our agentic workspace, taking models and signals from one desk into a supported, firm-wide capability, and lead the build-out of citizen developer workflows through to production.
Expose data and capability through Accio, our centralised MCP server, and as skills, tools, and connectors on Nexus, building reusable components rather than one-off integrations.
Co-build enterprise core-stack deliverables with Percepta and AI Engineering, and represent Forward Deployed Engineering in architecture and design authority forums.

What to expect when you join our firm

Hybrid working and reasonable accommodations
Generous Holiday policies
Excellent Health and Wellbeing benefits including corporate membership to Wellhub
Paid volunteer time to step away from your desk and into the community
Support to grow through professional development courses, tuition/qualification reimbursement and more
Maternal/paternal leave benefits and family services
All employee events including networking opportunities and social activities
Lunch allowance for use within our subsidized onsite canteen

Must have skills

At minimum eight years in technical, business-facing engineering roles — forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, consulting-side software engineering, or engineering embedded in a business unit — including time as the most senior engineer on the work. Former technical founders are encouraged to apply.
Experience leading engineers as a line manager, tech lead, or founder. You need not have run a large team, but you must have been accountable for other people’s delivery.
Strong Python and SQL, and a track record of shipping production applications, with hands-on delivery recent enough to still be real.
Production experience with LLMs — prompt and context engineering, agent development, evaluation, deployment at scale — including agentic capability such as MCP servers, tools, or connectors.
Experience building data pipelines from APIs and enterprise systems, and working knowledge of a major cloud, ideally Azure, with CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure as code.
Experience owning a technical roadmap, and judgement on technology selection — you can evaluate a new tool, model, or vendor, test it properly, and defend the recommendation.
Excellent stakeholder skills, credibility with senior audiences, and the ability to influence without direct authority.
High agency, genuine interest in the business problem, and willingness to move from building towards leading as the team grows.
Experience in a regulated environment where governance, compliance, and data sensitivity shape how solutions are built.

Nice to have skills

Experience standing up a new engineering team or function from scratch, including hiring and defining how it works.
Asset management or financial services domain knowledge, particularly the investment process, front office workflows, or fixed income.
Quantitative investment concepts such as fair value, relative value, signal generation, or portfolio construction.
Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake, Azure AI Foundry, model gateways, or AI observability in production.
Vendor selection, commercial negotiation, or licensing at enterprise scale, or contributing to architecture and technology governance forums.

Supervisory responsibilities

Yes. This role line-manages Forward Deployed Engineers. There may be no direct reports on day one; the team is expected to be built out under this role, with line-management responsibility growing accordingly. Until then it carries technical leadership and delivery accountability for Forward Deployed Engineering.

Potential for growth

Mentoring
Leadership development programs
Regular training
Career development services
Continuing education courses

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Foundry
jobs.description:
At a glance

Location:
Cambridge
In-office expectation:
Once every two weeks
Employment type:
Permanent
Salary:
£55,000-£80,000

This role will be a mid or senior level engineer dependant on experience

Why this role exists

Redgate's Foundry is our innovation incubator, the team scanning the horizon for Redgate's next big opportunity. This role exists because that kind of work needs engineers who are genuinely excited by discovery: people who can form a hypothesis, test it fast, and make a clear-eyed call on whether to push forward or change course.

Most ideas won't become products. That's by design. Each experiment sharpens our thinking and improves the odds of finding the one that will. If you're motivated by that kind of challenge, where the destination isn't fixed and the work is never the same twice, this is the role for you.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organisations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

Why join our engineering team?

You'll work in a team that cares about collaboration, craft and quality, not just in how we build, but in choosing what to build, finding the shortest path to the questions that matter most.
There’s real scope to grow your skills and impact, with clear pathways and support.
We value sustainable delivery, good ways of working and time to improve how we build.

About the role

The Foundry operates differently to the rest of Redgate's product teams. You won't be handed a roadmap. Instead, you'll work across the full arc of innovation — from horizon-scanning and ideation through to early-stage research, rapid prototyping, and working directly with customers to validate what you're building.

You'll be part of a small cross-functional team (a Tech Lead plus four to six Software and Machine Learning Engineers), and you'll regularly run projects in parallel: contributing to ongoing experiments while also exploring entirely new directions. The tech stack is deliberately varied, the right tool for the job, not a fixed list, spanning C#, TypeScript, Python, and more across desktop, web, API, database, and ML development.

What makes this role different:

You'll work on problems where there is no established answer and you'll have the autonomy to explore them seriously.
Your work sits at the intersection of software engineering, customer insight, and product thinking; it's rare to find all three in one role.
You'll use and help shape how Redgate adopts agentic coding and AI development tools, not as an afterthought, but as a core part of how the team works.
The scope is genuinely broad: a typical day could see you balancing technical prototypes, customer interviews, and competitor teardowns.

What makes you a great fit

Proven experience using AI coding tools. You've used them extensively, understand their limitations, and have developed ways to work around them productively and safely.
Strong software design and coding skills across modern languages, particularly C#, TypeScript, or Python, enough to guide and review AI-generated code with confidence.
Hands-on experience building agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, Microsoft Agentic Framework, or MCP, with a solid understanding of LLM capabilities and risks.
Experience designing and running experiments to validate ideas quickly, using technical prototypes, customer feedback, and lean startup principles to test assumptions and make clear decisions.
Comfortable engaging directly with customers and stakeholders: running interviews, demos, and concierge-style validation processes, and communicating findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A product mindset; you think in terms of user value, outcomes, and market fit, not just features or technical delivery.

What we offer

Salary range: £55,000-£80,000
Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office
Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off
Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression
Private health insurance

What happens next

Your application will be reviewed by a person, we don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications. Every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You'll hear back within a few days, whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

Our interview process is straightforward and consistent, you'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking a Security Solution Architect - AI to work for our client within the Financial Services sector. This is initially a 6-12 month contract with the potential to extend and will be a hybrid role that will be based in London, Edinburgh or Bristol.

Our client is seeking an experienced Security Solution Architect with a strong background in cloud architecture, AI technologies, and enterprise security solutions. The successful candidate will lead the design and delivery of innovative security architectures that leverage Artificial Intelligence to detect, prevent, and respond to evolving fraud threats.

This role requires a highly capable architect with demonstrable experience delivering AI solutions end-to-end, operating across major cloud platforms, and defining secure enterprise architectures within complex environments. The position will play a key role in helping our organisation strengthen fraud prevention capabilities through the application of advanced AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and modern security technologies.
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise within the Microsoft security ecosystem, whilst maintaining the ability to integrate and architect solutions involving complementary technologies such as CrowdStrike.

Responsibilities:

Solution & Security Architecture:

Design and develop enterprise-scale security architectures across cloud and hybrid environments.
Lead solution architecture activities from requirements gathering through to implementation and operational handover.
Define security patterns, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps aligned to business objectives.
Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, governance, resilience, and operational requirements.
Collaborate with security operations, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to deliver secure-by-design solutions.

AI & Fraud Prevention:

Architect and deliver AI-powered security and fraud prevention solutions.
Apply Large Language Models (LLMs), generative AI, machine learning, and behavioural analytics to identify, prevent, and investigate fraudulent activity.
Design solutions leveraging AI to enhance threat detection, anomaly identification, user behaviour analysis, and fraud risk mitigation.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative approaches to combat evolving fraud threats.
Support responsible AI adoption, ensuring security, governance, and ethical use of AI technologies.

Security & Technology Leadership:

Provide technical leadership on Microsoft security products and services, including:
Microsoft 365 Security
Microsoft Entra
Microsoft Defender Suite
Microsoft Purview
Microsoft Security Copilot
Design integrations between Microsoft security services and third-party platforms, including CrowdStrike.
Support incident response, threat modelling, security assessments, and security transformation initiatives.
Advise stakeholders on security architecture best practice and emerging industry trends.

About You

Significant experience in a Security Architect or Solution Architect role.
Strong solution architecture capability across major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform).
Demonstrable end-to-end delivery experience of AI-enabled solutions in enterprise environments.
Experience designing secure architectures involving machine learning, generative AI, and LLM technologies.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture principles, frameworks, and best practices.
Experience translating business requirements into scalable and secure technology solutions.
Knowledge of identity and access management, data protection, threat detection, and security operations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
Experience working within complex, regulated environments.

Highly Desirable:

Experience within fraud, fraud prevention, financial crime, behavioural analytics, or risk management domains.
Demonstrable experience using AI and LLMs to reduce fraud risk and improve fraud detection capabilities.
Knowledge of behavioural fraud detection techniques and user/entity behaviour analytics (UEBA).
Experience integrating AI-driven fraud prevention capabilities into enterprise security architectures.
Familiarity with Microsoft Security Copilot and AI-assisted security operations.
Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon and associated security tooling.

About Us

FDM is an award-winning global leader in tech and business talent solutions, backed by more than 35 years of industry experience. We have centres across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, and a global workforce of over 2500 employees. FDM has shown exponential growth throughout the years, firmly establishing itself as an award-winning employer, currently listed on the FTSE4Good Index and as a 2026 Financial Times UK ‘Best Employer’.

Diversity and Inclusion

FDM Group is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by federal, provincial or local laws.

Why join us

Career coaching, mentoring and access to upskilling throughout your entire FDM career
Assignments with global companies and opportunities to work abroad
Opportunity to re-skill and up-skill into new areas, develop non-linear career paths and build a skillset within your field
Annual leave and work-place pension

jobs.title: Senior Field Applications Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

If you are a Field Applications Engineer professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you. In this role, you will partner with customers to understand their technical challenges, recommend innovative software and hardware solutions, and help drive successful outcomes using NI test and measurement technologies. Working collaboratively with account managers, customers, and internal technical teams, you will contribute to technical strategy development, customer success, and business growth while delivering value through innovation, integrity, collaboration, and inclusion.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Building key technical relationships at top accounts, demonstrating strong technical credibility and increasing customer technical confidence in NI solutions.
Understanding and assisting in the creation of customer technical requirements.
Providing recommendations on software and hardware architectures while helping customers understand the next steps to ensure success.
Collaborating with NI Account Manager(s) as part of an account team to lead development and execution of the account technical strategy, providing insight to the overall account strategy and pipeline.
Coordinating with and informing internal technical stakeholders to execute account technical initiatives and provide feedback to increase account success.
Leveraging industry, application area, and account knowledge to uncover and influence customer future technical needs and challenges, generating further technical demand for NI products, services, and support.
Building trusted customer relationships through technical consultation and solution-focused engagement.
Contributing to a collaborative environment that encourages knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement.

This position is compensated by 80% base salary and 20% variable pay based on achievement of annual quota attainment.

Who You Are:

You build strong customer partnerships and work collaboratively across teams to meet shared objectives. Permanent

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI agents and automation tools to solve complex problems and improve business processes.
Design AI solutions across multiple projects and portfolios, including orchestration layers and scalable, reusable solutions.
Decide between, and build with, both low-code and pro-code approaches.
Design cloud native solutions as the platform for AI solutions, and integrate new AI offerings.
Provide technical oversight and quality assurance of projects and of the work of others, alongside building yourself.
Set engineering standards and review the code and solutions produced by the team.
Shape and scope new demand as it comes in, translating business problems into deliverable technical scope with an assessment of effort and feasibility.
Own governance and set-up end to end, including AI risk assessment, information security, data loss prevention, change advisory board, environments and licensing, taking products all the way through to live release.
Manage senior stakeholders, including demonstrating, defending and shaping the work with partners and business leadership.
Support and mentor junior members of the team, and coordinate delivery across onshore and offshore resources.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI and apply them to projects.
Document code, processes and methodologies to ensure maintainability and knowledge sharing within the team.
Lead and participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers.

Required Skills And Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained through several years in a relevant role.
Proven experience as an AI developer or engineer, with a strong portfolio of delivered projects.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and TypeScript.
Working knowledge of Git and version control.
Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design principles.
Familiarity with data manipulation and analysis tools such as Pandas, NumPy, and SQL.
Experience across the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages and Dataverse, together with solution management, environments and application lifecycle management.
Experience building and orchestrating LLM agents, including prompt design, grounding and retrieval, structured outputs, and testing and evaluating agent behaviour where outputs are uncertain or non-deterministic.
Experienced with cloud solutions, including how they are run, costed and used.
Experience integrating AI tools with enterprise systems through APIs, including Graph, REST, SQL, SharePoint and dedicated business systems.
Experience working within enterprise guardrails, including AI risk assessment, information security review, data loss prevention, environments and licensing.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Strong communication skills, including senior stakeholder management and the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Copilot Studio, or another agent orchestration platform.
Experience mentoring developers or providing technical oversight to a delivery team.
Front end, user experience or product design exposure that signals an awareness of user considerations.
Knowledge of containerisation technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge AI projects that make a difference.

Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking a API Platform Lead to work for our client within the Financial Services sector. This is initially a 6-12 month contract with the potential to extend and will be a hybrid role that will be based in Edinburgh.

Our client is seeking a Platform Engineering Lead to own the strategy, engineering, governance, and operation of critical enterprise platforms, with a particular focus on API and integration capabilities.

This role will lead the evolution of a global API platform, enabling secure, scalable, and reusable services across multiple product and engineering teams. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership experience and a proven track record of delivering enterprise-wide platform transformation initiatives.

Responsibilities:

Platform Ownership

Own the strategic direction, roadmap, and operational performance of the enterprise API platform.
Lead the design, build, operation, and continuous improvement of scalable, resilient, cloud-native platforms.
Ensure platform capabilities are reusable and consumable across global engineering teams.
Drive platform adoption, developer experience, engineering standards, and governance across the organisation.
Establish platform reliability, security, scalability, and disaster recovery standards.

API Platform Leadership

Lead the enterprise API platform strategy and operating model.
Own API lifecycle management including design, development, governance, security, versioning, monitoring, and decommissioning.
Define and implement API standards, design patterns, and best practices across multiple engineering teams.
Build and maintain API management capabilities including developer portals, API gateways, security controls, and consumption frameworks.
Enable federated API development across engineering teams while maintaining enterprise governance standards.

Engineering Leadership

Lead globally distributed software engineering teams and engineering managers.
Build high-performing engineering teams through coaching, mentoring, and leadership.
Drive modern engineering practices including DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, and Agile delivery methods.
Manage relationships with third-party suppliers, technology partners, and offshore delivery providers.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

Stakeholder Management

Partner with senior technology and business stakeholders to align platform strategy with organisational priorities.
Influence architecture, technology strategy, and digital transformation initiatives.
Communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Manage competing priorities while delivering measurable business outcomes.

About You

Significant experience leading Enterprise Platform Engineering, Platform Operations, or API Engineering functions.
Proven experience owning and managing a large-scale enterprise API platform.
Hands-on experience with Azure API Management (Azure APIM), including platform design, governance, lifecycle management, security, developer enablement, and platform operations.
Strong Azure cloud experience and delivery of cloud-native platforms.
Experience establishing API strategies, standards, governance models, and reusable platform capabilities across large engineering organisations.
Demonstrable experience delivering digital transformation and platform modernisation programmes.
Strong understanding of:
API Architecture
Microservices Architecture
Integration Platforms
Middleware Technologies
Cloud Technologies
Platform Engineering
Identity & Access Management
Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams.
Strong stakeholder engagement and executive communication skills.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate:
Ownership and leadership of an enterprise API platform, ideally leveraging Azure API Management (APIM), including strategy, governance, standards, platform operations, and adoption across a large engineering organisation.

About Us

FDM is an award-winning global leader in tech and business talent solutions, backed by more than 35 years of industry experience. We have centres across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, and a global workforce of over 2500 employees. FDM has shown exponential growth throughout the years, firmly establishing itself as an award-winning employer, currently listed on the FTSE4Good Index and as a 2026 Financial Times UK ‘Best Employer’.

Diversity and Inclusion

FDM Group is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by federal, provincial or local laws.

Why join us

Career coaching, mentoring and access to upskilling throughout your entire FDM career
Assignments with global companies and opportunities to work abroad
Opportunity to re-skill and up-skill into new areas, develop non-linear career paths and build a skillset within your field

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview

Netwrix is on a mission to help customers protect and secure their identity and data landscape through market-leading on-prem and SaaS products and integrated solutions. Netwrix Identity products provide leading identity security solutions to thousands of enterprise customers worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer

who will develop new features and capabilities for Netwrix Identity Recovery, our enterprise solution for backup and recovery of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta environments

. The Software Engineer will ensure scalable, secure, high-quality experiences for enterprise customers in both on-prem and SaaS environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer to help build and shape the user experience for our identity recovery product that protects organizations when it matters most. You will own the browser-based administration console and desktop application, drive UX improvements across complex recovery workflows, and play a key role in evolving the product toward a modern SaaS platform. You will integrate AI capabilities into both the product and your development process and work closely with product leaders and engineers to deliver software that protects organizations worldwide against identity-based threats.

Your home base is the Netwrix Identity Recovery team. You will work within a shared engineering platform and technology stack, with opportunities to contribute to other products across the Netwrix ITDR portfolio — such as PingCastle, Threat Prevention, and Threat Manager.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain the web-based administration console for Netwrix Identity Recovery, creating intuitive and performant UX for complex enterprise recovery workflows
Design and implement UX flows for recovery scenarios involving Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta — including object restore, multi-step forest recovery, and real-time operation progress
Own real-time notification and status update experiences in the browser, keeping administrators informed during long-running recovery operations
Own authentication and account management UI: login flows, MFA enrollment, and session management
Contribute to the backend services layer to support new UI features — this role requires full-stack capability beyond the UI
Integrate data and capabilities with Netwrix's cybersecurity product platform and other ITDR products
Drive the evolution of the product's UI toward a modern SaaS and cloud-hosted architecture
Promote and optimize the use of AI tools and capabilities to accelerate Netwrix product development
Partner with customers and customer-facing teams to triage and address issues, understand customer needs, and gather feedback on product features
Collaborate across functions with product management, platform and product teams, and engineering leadership to align technical direction with business needs
Help foster a culture of innovation, security-first thinking, mentorship, professional growth, and technical excellence

Qualifications

Required Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience
4+ years of software development experience with a focus on enterprise software
Production experience with C# and .NET in a web application context
Production experience with ASP.NET Core Blazor or a comparable component-based web framework (React, Angular, Vue.js)
Experience designing and delivering on-prem or SaaS software at scale
Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring/observability

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET)
Familiar with C++ enough to read and understand it to trace bugs and understand backend behavior.
Solid grounding in web fundamentals: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and browser rendering
Experience with a modern component-based web framework — ASP.NET Core Blazor, React, Angular, or Vue.js
Understanding of authentication patterns: cookie auth, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and MFA flows
Proficiency in RESTful API design and consumption
Familiarity with real-time web patterns: WebSockets or similar push mechanisms
Experience with relational databases and the ability to read and understand a data model
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), containerization fundamentals, and infrastructure as code

Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
Proven ability to balance technical quality with business priorities and timelines
Strong UX instincts: you notice when enterprise admin workflows are confusing and can advocate clearly for improvements
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex, ambiguous challenges

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with ASP.NET Core Blazor Server and a commercial component library (Telerik, MudBlazor, or equivalent)
React and TypeScript experience, particularly for building enterprise admin or data-heavy SPA applications
Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, or similar identity and access management concepts
Understanding of Active Directory and Windows identity concepts — directly applicable to recovery workflow design
Experience building or participating in on-prem to SaaS UI migrations
Familiarity with Azure services relevant to SaaS web hosting: Azure App Service, Azure SignalR Service, Azure Container Apps
Familiarity with threat detection methodologies, SIEM concepts, and security frameworks
Experience developing products that support both on-prem and SaaS environments
Understanding of the ITDR market and solutions

Our Values

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

Competitive Health Benefits
Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed

jobs.title: Senior Software  AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Software AI Engineer to join a high-impact, AI-augmented modernization initiative for a leading global asset management firm. In this role, you will help modernize a mission-critical estate of 149 production applications using cutting-edge agentic AI coding workflows, specification-driven analysis, and automated remediation pipelines. The portfolio is predominantly C# / .NET and Python, with Angular, WPF/WCF frontends, SQL Server backends, and internal APIs. Working alongside senior London-based consultants, you will build and drive an advanced AI pipeline designed to improve existing codebases, lift automated test coverage past 70%, clear security vulnerabilities (CVEs), and migrate services to the cloud via GitHub Actions.

Responsibilities

Spec-Driven Insights & Agentic Diagnostics: Apply cutting-edge spec-driven approaches and agentic AI tooling (Copilot agent mode, internal client LLMs, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude Code) to analyze code health, perform deep-dive assessments, and triage defects at scale.
Vulnerability Remediation: Validate and fix pre-identified security vulnerabilities, execute dependency upgrades, and resolve SAST/DAST/CVE findings to pass quality gates into modern delivery platforms.
Test Engineering & Quality Hardening: Build out functional, integration, and end-to-end test suites using AI tooling, replacing ineffective tests with high-confidence automated suites to reach 70%+ coverage.
Pipeline Extension & BAU Scaling: Enroll additional portfolio services into the standing agentic analysis and remediation pipeline while continuously refining the pipeline's automation patterns.
Extended Architectural Analysis: Perform deep architectural evaluations for flagship codebases exceeding 500k LoC to formulate targeted analysis and refactoring strategies.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with London-based onsite consultants, business stakeholders, and technical teams to validate findings, prioritize backlogs, and align on remediation goals.

Requirements

General Engineering & Legacy Experience: Strong general software engineering background with proven ability to navigate, understand, and contribute production-quality changes across under-documented legacy codebases.
Agentic AI & LLM Proficiency: Demonstrated, hands-on experience using LLMs in software engineering settings to drive agentic coding workflows, generate tests, and remediate non-trivial code at scale.
Testing Discipline: Genuine test engineering mindset—writing high-confidence tests by default and differentiating between raw line coverage and true functional confidence.
Autonomy & Communication: High autonomy with a pragmatic, get-it-done attitude; fluent written and spoken English with clear technical communication capabilities.
Location: Based in Poland, comfortable working in a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office) with regular collaboration across Poland and London teams.

Nice to have

Core Tech Stack Experience: Production experience with C# / .NET (.NET Framework to .NET 6/8 modernization, WPF/WCF replacement) and/or Python.
Spec-Driven & Pipeline Tooling: Exposure to specification-driven AI tools (e.g., JUXT's Allium or GitHub's spec-kit) or experience building repeatable code-analysis pipelines.
Security & CI/CD: Practical experience with CVE triage, dependency upgrades, SAST/DAST tools, and enterprise CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy).
Domain Knowledge: Prior experience in financial services, asset management, or other heavily regulated enterprise environments.

We offer

Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects
Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team
Competitive salary
Flexible schedule
Benefits package - medical insurance, sports
Corporate social events
Professional development opportunities
Well-equipped office

Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Internal Developer Platform
jobs.description:
About Frontiers

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

The Mission

At Frontiers, we are rewriting the rules of scientific publishing. To support our scale, we are transforming our Engineering Platform into a state-of-the-art Internal Developer Platform (IDP) built on modern principles and AI-augmented workflows — with a North Star of evolving it into an Agentic Development Platform (ADP) where human engineers and AI agents build software side by side, safely and at scale.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer
— Internal Developer Platform
to help build and run that platform and the AI-First Delivery capabilities on top of it. This is the modern evolution of the DevOps Engineer role: you won't run a ticket queue — you'll treat the platform as a product, own a capability area end to end, and ship the golden paths, guardrails and automation that let our Stream-Aligned Teams (and their agents) deliver faster and more safely. You'll work closely with our Platform Product Manager and Senior Cloud Architect — turning platform strategy and prioritised needs into working capabilities.

The Technical Context

You will build and operate the capabilities that make up the IDP.

Core Stack: Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes (AKS), containers (Docker); services in C#/.NET and Node.js
IaC & GitOps: Terraform, Helm, and a move toward GitOps with ArgoCD
CI/CD: Evolution from Azure DevOps toward GitHub Actions, modernizing pipelines (not a blind "lift and shift")
Integration: Azure API Management, Apollo Federation/GraphOS, n8n
Security: Azure Entra ID, SonarQube, Azure Policy, Key Vault
Observability: NewRelic and Grafana (proactive SRE and business-value metrics)
Developer Experience & AI: Backstage, our Technology Framework (policies/standards as executable AI context), MCP, and AI-driven development (e.g. Cursor AI, GitHub Spec-Kit)

What You'll Do

Build and operate the IDP: golden paths, self-service templates, the developer portal (Backstage) and IDP catalog, and guardrails that keep teams compliant by default (guardrails, not gates)
Own CI/CD and GitOps: GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions; help drive the migration off Azure DevOps; implement GitOps (ArgoCD) for AKS — rethinking deployments rather than lifting-and-shifting custom tasks
Provision cloud infrastructure as code: evolve Azure (AKS, networking, databases, APIM, Key Vault, Entra ID) with Terraform and Helm; manage reliability and cost (FinOps)
Improve observability & reliability: instrument systems (NewRelic, Grafana), define SLOs, reduce operational toil, and drive monitoring-cost accountability
Advance AI-First Delivery and the ADP: build agent-ready context (MCP, the Technology Framework), path definitions (e.g. validate-change, PR-review), and agent governance (non-human identity, sandboxed execution, evaluation, agent observability)
Own a capability area end to end and set the standard: take a platform domain (e.g. CI/CD & GitOps, or cloud foundations) from design to run, define the reference patterns and ADRs others build on, and raise the bar through code review, mentoring and pairing
Build for adoption, like a product: design capabilities around real internal customers, write docs that work, and gather feedback from the teams you serve — so the platform is genuinely the easiest, safest path. Partner with the Platform Product Manager on priorities, and let adoption, DORA and DevEx metrics (not ticket counts) tell you what to improve next

Requirements

A full-stack software engineering background (prerequisite): you've built and shipped production software yourself (e.g. in C#/.NET, Node.js, Python, Go or similar) — so you bring genuine developer empathy for the engineers you build the platform for, and you design self-service that you'd actually want to use
Senior-level experience: typically 5+ years building and operating cloud platforms or infrastructure, including owning a capability area end to end and setting patterns / mentoring other engineers
Cloud & Kubernetes: strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (AWS/GCP transferable) and Kubernetes (AKS): networking, storage, managed databases
Infrastructure as Code & GitOps: Terraform and Helm; GitOps with ArgoCD or similar
CI/CD: modern pipelines (GitHub Actions ideal); experience migrating from other CI systems a plus
Observability & reliability: metrics/logs/traces, SLOs and error budgets; security/compliance as code (policy-as-code, secrets management, identity basics)
Product mindset for internal tooling: developer empathy, self-service design, guardrails not gates
AI-First: you already work with AI coding assistants (e.g. Cursor) and are excited to build golden paths and agent workflows, not just consume them
Language: Professional-level English (spoken and written)

Nice to Have

API platform experience (Azure APIM, Apollo Federation/GraphOS) and developer-portal experience (Backstage)
Exposure to agentic/LLM tooling, MCP, GitHub Spec-Kit, or building AI developer workflows
Interest or experience in Spec-Driven Development and AI coding assistants
Experience facilitating InnerSource or community-driven platform contributions
Familiarity with Team Topologies, DORA, SPACE / DX Core 4, CNCF platform maturity; workflow automation (n8n) and FinOps

How We Measure Success In This Role

Adoption: teams/services on golden paths; self-service actions; time-to-first-deploy for a new service
Delivery (DORA): deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change-failure rate, time to restore
Developer experience: internal NPS/satisfaction, support-ticket trend, golden-path coverage
Reliability & cost: SLOs met; cloud and monitoring spend under control

Why This Role Is Exciting

Platform engineering gets more
valuable in the AI era, not less: the platform does :90% of the work, the model :10%. You'll help move engineering effort from one-off delivery toward owning, running and evolving the platform and its agents
— the scarce, high-leverage work of the next decade — all in service of a mission that matters: making science open for everyone.

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

Equal opportunity statement

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.

The Role

As a Backend Engineer at our client, you will contribute directly to the core index layer, processing video indexing based on signals from the algorithm team. Your work will power the auto-tagging engine—the system that splits sports games into distinct events and accurately assigns start and end times to each action. You will balance deep feature development with critical problem-solving in a highly collaborative, AI-integrated environment.

About The Product

The product is an AI-powered sports media platform used by major sports organizations to transform live broadcasts into personalized digital content at scale. Every live stream is continuously ingested, analyzed, and enriched with AI-generated metadata, enabling automatic detection of key moments, intelligent video indexing, and near real-time content creation.

Behind the scenes, the platform processes massive volumes of live and archived video 24/7, powering personalized fan experiences across web, mobile, social, and broadcast channels. The backend infrastructure is built for extreme throughput, low-latency processing, and elastic scaling, combining distributed microservices with production-grade ML inference pipelines to deliver reliable performance under unpredictable traffic peaks.

Team Structure & Collaboration

You will join a focused backend squad consisting of four developers, one QA, and one PM, led by the engineering manager. This squad sits within a larger group of two backend teams and two algorithm teams. Because the index layer relies heavily on algorithm signals, you will work in close daily collaboration with the AI and algorithm teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

Video Indexing & Auto-Tagging: Build and maintain the C#/.NET backend infrastructure that interprets algorithm signals to index videos and auto-tag live sports events
Technical Leadership: Elevate the team by actively participating in design discussions, driving code review standards, and mentoring fellow developers
On-Call Rotation: Participate in a shared on-call pool (approximately one week every five weeks). While critical nighttime or weekend outages are rare, you must remain reachable and have access to a laptop to respond to operations team escalations
Proactivity: Execute tasks independently, demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, and maintain prompt, proactive communication via Slack with the Israel-based team

What We Expect

Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, with 5+ years of commercial .NET experience
Hands-on experience developing within Azure cloud environments
Familiarity with and daily use of AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor)
Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven ability to mentor peers and lead design discussions
High autonomy, independent task execution, and proactive communication habits for effective distributed collaboration
Familiarity with event-driven messaging services such as Azure Service Bus or Kafka
Working knowledge of SQL databases (general proficiency; specific engines do not matter)
Basic familiarity with DevOps terminology and Kubernetes (operational expertise is not required)
Willingness to work in a hybrid mode, 3 days from the office in Warsaw

Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

Direct ownership of pure backend compute at scale—no full-stack dilution, focusing entirely on high-load microservices, indexing engines, and real-time processing
High-autonomy environment with modern workflows where AI tools (Claude, Cursor) are embraced to eliminate boilerplate and keep focus on architecture

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. . Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA offer and make it more accessible for the many people. We offer this position in a fast-paced, truly global environment with an endless supply of challenges and development opportunities.

You will play a key role in defining engineering standards, guiding technical decisions, and evolving our capabilities in automation, AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent workflows.

As a technical leader and role model, you will mentor engineers, promote best practices, and help teams deliver business value through modern engineering and emerging technologies.

Define and drive the engineering direction for Digital Automation platforms and products.
Act as the technical authority for software engineering, automation engineering, AI engineering, and platform development practices.
Drive adoption of engineering standards, development frameworks, architecture principles, and secure-by-design practices.
Lead technical design and architecture discussions for automation, AI, and agentic solutions.

Evaluate new technology trends and emerging capabilities in AI, Agentic AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Automation.
Partner closely with Architects, Platfrom engineers and Software Engineer managers to define future technical roadmaps.
Lead Proof of Concepts (PoCs), Proof of Technologies (PoTs), and technical innovation initiatives.
Drive engineering excellence through reusability, automation, quality practices, observability, and operational resilience.
Champion AI-native software development and AI-assisted engineering practices across the organization.

Qualifications

IKEA are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data & technology together as an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. On this journey we’re doing some amazing things; therefore, we need some amazing people – this position is not an exception.

We are looking for a leader who is passionate about developing people and technology capabilities while enabling business transformation through automation and AI. To succeed in this role, you are a collaborative and people-focused engineering leader who can inspire, coach, and mobilize teams towards shared objectives. You combine strong engineering understanding with the ability to build trust, develop talent, and drive change in a fast-paced environment.

We Believe You MUST have

Software Engineering Leadership: 8+ years of experience in software engineering, automation engineering, or digital product development, with proven experience leading technical direction across engineering teams.
Development Background: Strong hands-on development experience using modern programming languages, frameworks, APIs, integrations, and cloud-native architectures.
Engineering Excellence: Deep understanding of software engineering principles, architecture patterns, DevOps practices, quality engineering, security, scalability, and maintainability.
Intelligent Automation Expertise: Extensive experience delivering solutions using digital automation technologies like RPA, workflow automation, Process Mining, Power Platform, and AI-enabled automation.

jobs.title: NETSUITE ARCHITECT
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – NETSUITE ARCHITECT (FIXED TERM CONTRACT - 2 Years)

THE TEAM & THE JOB

The Enterprise Systems NetSuite team owns the support, development and strategic direction of YouGov's NetSuite ERP platform, the system underpinning the company's core finance processes. The team is being reshaped to combine operational analyst support with dedicated architectural capability under the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager.

As NetSuite Architect, you will be the expert-level professional providing technical leadership for the platform on a fixed term contract. You will own the overall technical vision and architecture, define the "how" and "what" of solutions on significant and unique issues, and act as the recognised subject matter expert advising senior stakeholders. You will translate the functional vision for the ERP into an architectural plan and guide its execution, maintaining a future-focused approach to scalability, maintainability and long-term platform evolution.

What You Will Be Doing – Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end technical vision and architecture for the NetSuite platform, translating business strategy into an architectural roadmap.
Design and architect end-to-end NetSuite solutions, including customisations, integrations and workflows, exercising considerable creativity, foresight and judgment.
Make high-impact technical decisions on integration patterns, customisation approaches and data models, evaluating trade-offs between business needs, intangibles and technical constraints.
Assess and document the existing customised NetSuite landscape (scripts, workflows, forms, integrations) to support future transitions and upgrades.
Architect integrations across multiple systems using SuiteTalk, RESTlets and middleware platforms.
Define and enforce NetSuite development standards, governance policies and best practices across the platform.
Lead complex, enterprise-wide NetSuite initiatives from requirements gathering through deployment and post-go-live support.
Conduct solution design reviews, code reviews and performance optimisation assessments, providing expert technical leadership and mentorship to the wider team.
Advise senior business and functional stakeholders, developing recommendations and persuading diverse audiences on platform decisions and module/third-party evaluation.
Produce comprehensive technical architecture documentation, data models and integration specifications so knowledge is retained beyond the contract term.
Work closely with the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager, the Senior NetSuite Analyst, Finance stakeholders and third-party providers, staying current with NetSuite platform updates and industry trends.

What You Need To Know (technical & Behavioural Skills/Competencies)

6–8+ years' hands-on NetSuite experience operating as an architect, with a proven track record of leading full implementation lifecycles as a technical leader.
Experience architecting solutions independently across multiple implementations or complex enterprise-wide projects, in more than one enterprise-sized organisation.
Deep technical expertise across the entire NetSuite platform, including expert knowledge of SuiteScript 2.x (Client, User Event, Scheduled, RESTlets, Map/Reduce) and custom development.
Extensive experience with SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (SOAP/REST), SuiteAnalytics and SuiteBundler, and a deep understanding of NetSuite data architecture, saved searches and custom records.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and experience with integration platforms (Boomi, Celigo, Workato, MuleSoft or similar).
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and ERP business processes (Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Financial Close).
Conceptual thinking to work on significant and unique issues where analysis requires evaluation of intangibles, with independent judgment on methods, techniques and evaluation criteria (be accountable).
Ability to convey complex, non-routine information and persuade diverse senior stakeholders across multiple cultures, frequently advising others on complex matters (communicate clearly).
A collaborative approach to technical leadership, building capability in others rather than holding knowledge (trust each other), and staying current with platform and industry developments (be fast).
NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteFoundation; SuiteCloud Developer II preferred) and ideally architect qualifications such as TOGAF or CSA.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Why join YouGov?

Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.

Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.

Life at YouGov

We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.

We strive to provide YouGovers with best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.

Equal Opportunity Employer

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity or expression, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, HIV status, political affiliation, socioeconomic background, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law or in line with our responsibilities as a fair and ethic employer. All employment decisions are made based on occupational qualifications, merit, and business need.

Job Description

As a Software Engineering Specialist in Digital Automation, you will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on software engineering to enable the successful delivery of automation capabilities across the IKEA value chain. You will act as a recognised specialist within your area of expertise while remaining actively involved in the design, development, deployment and operation of digital solutions.

The Software Engineering Specialist role builds upon the Software Engineer role by providing deeper expertise within a specialised discipline and supporting engineering excellence across teams, products and technology domains. You will contribute both vertically within your assigned product area and horizontally through collaboration, coaching and knowledge sharing across the broader engineering community.

Within Digital Automation, your specialisation may include areas such as DevOps engineering, cloud engineering, data and integration engineering, API development, Requirement solicitation, security engineering, knowledge engineering, intelligent automation or other specialised technical domains. Act as a recognised technical specialist within a defined software engineering discipline, driving best practices and providing expert guidance.

Apply and promote modern software engineering practices, including continuous integration, continuous delivery, automation and quality engineering.
Take ownership of complex technical challenges and provide specialist expertise to support delivery teams.

Explore and evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends and engineering practices that may benefit Digital Automation products and platforms.
Create prototypes, proofs of concept, data models, integrations, configurations or other technical artefacts needed to validate new ideas and technologies.
Support and coach engineers within your area of expertise through mentoring, knowledge sharing and technical guidance.

Qualifications

We are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data & technology together - an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. A journey that needs passionate people who embrace change, dare to question and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us. Together we can do great things.

We’re doing some amazing things in IKEA Supply; therefore, we need some amazing people – this position is not an exception.

To be successful in this role, we expect you to have:

Experience & Qualifications

Formal qualifications in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline.
Formal qualifications within a recognised specialist discipline, or demonstrated expert-level experience within that area.
A minimum of five years' professional experience as a Software Engineer.
At least three years of experience within a defined specialist area such as cloud engineering, integration engineering, API development or a similar discipline.
Experience designing, developing, deploying and supporting enterprise-grade software solutions.
Experience influencing technical decisions and driving adoption of engineering standards and good practices.
Experience working within large and complex organisations is considered an advantage.

Knowledge & Motivation

Expert knowledge within a defined specialist software engineering discipline.
Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, methodologies and industry-leading practices.
Good understanding of software architecture, design patterns and engineering quality attributes.
Broad technical understanding across multiple technology domains and how they interact within a larger ecosystem.
Passion for technology, innovation and continuous learning.
Motivation to stay at the forefront of emerging tools, technologies and engineering practices.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Curiosity and confidence to navigate uncertainty, challenge existing approaches and explore new possibilities.

Additional Information

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Hi there!

We are STX Next, a global IT consulting company specializing in customer-focused software services. Join a group of 500 professionals dedicated to helping customers build outstanding products. Leveraging the latest advancements in the field, and a passion for innovation, we're shaping the future of technology one project at a time.

Are you the NEXT one?

Type of contract
A B2B contract for your flexibility and competitive compensation package

Location
A remote model. Work anywhere from Poland but be ready for regular business trips.

Role Description

We are looking for an engineer
who would rather sit in a client's office and build the thing than sit in ours and specify it.

STX Next builds software for European companies, and we are changing how we do it. Instead of sending a team and a project manager, we send one engineer who owns the client. You work inside their business, you find out how it actually runs, and you build. Behind you sits an AI pod, a small team of engineers plus our own agent tooling on our AI SDLC, which takes on the bulk of delivery once you have proven what is worth building.

The name is literal. Forward deployed means physically there. Not remote, not from our office, not on a call. You will be at the client's premises around four days a month, and the whole role depends on it.

What This Role Is Not

You will write production code. If you want to stop being hands-on, this is the wrong move.
It is not a specialist post. Not only data, not only AI, not only backend. Versatility is the point, because you will not get to choose what the client's problem needs.
It is not project management. Reporting cadence, documentation and invoicing stay with our PM function.
It is not new business development. Winning new logos stays with Sales. You grow the client you already have.

What You'll Do

Own one client, end to end. You are the one name the client knows, from the first conversation through discovery, build, production and whatever comes after it. Nobody hands them on to a successor.
Find the real problem. Discovery is not a workshop. It is watching how the work is really done, listening for the manual workaround nobody has mentioned, and working out whether fixing it would actually move the client's numbers.
Build the prototype yourself. The way you prove something is worth doing is to build a working version of it and put it in front of the client. Not a deck, not a recommendation. A thing that runs.
Lead the AI pod behind you. You decide who is on it, you are accountable for what it ships, and you stay close enough to know when it is drifting. As delivery settles, more of it moves to the pod and more of your time goes to the next problem.
Make the value legible. You will show the client what a change saved them in hours, cost or risk, in numbers their own leadership can act on. Technical elegance is not the argument.
Unlock the next project. Once the current work is safe, your job is to spot the next problem, prototype the answer and put the case to the client. Our commercial team handles pricing, contracting and paperwork. The idea and the conversation are yours.
Bring it back to us. What you learn about how this client works, and about how we should estimate and sell this kind of work, comes back into our playbooks and accelerators. The second engagement should be cheaper than the first.

What We're Looking For

Strong, broad engineering. You can design, build, deploy and run a real system end to end, across the stack, in an environment that will not look like a clean internal codebase.
Working command of AI. Real understanding of what current AI tooling can and cannot do, and where an accelerator shortens the path. Not prompt literacy.
Translation, both directions. You listen to a business problem and come back with a technical option framed as a commercial decision. Cost, risk, payback, and what happens if the client does nothing.
Communication as a first-class skill. You can hold a room with a CTO and a CFO at the same time and make sense to both. You send the update before anyone asks for it, and bad news comes from you first.
You behave like an owner. The team is yours, the client is yours, the result is yours. You will have the mandate that goes with that, including the standing to advise a client against work we could have sold.
Comfort with ambiguity. No finished spec, a moving target, and a client who often cannot yet articulate the problem. If that reads as energising rather than exhausting, good.
Language. Fluent English, spoken and written. Polish if you will be working with our Polish clients.

Extra package

Pay that reflects the ownership. Market salary for a senior engineer of this calibre, plus an uncapped bonus tied to the margin your account delivers and to the new work you unlock.
A genuine mandate. Decision authority over your pod, your technical approach and the proposals that go to your client, with the access to project financials that makes that real.

What You'll Get

Remote-First Flexibility

Stay where you feel most productive. Here’s a remote-first environment with the freedom to set your own schedule. Whether you need a midday break or a specific routine, we trust you to manage your time and deliver results while maintaining your personal well-being.

Cafeteria & Health Membership

We provide access to premium medical packages which include Medicover Sport. You can also choose a MultiSport card and group insurance options. All these packages are managed through Cafeteria System, giving you the autonomy to choose exactly what fits your lifestyle.

Collaboration Mindset

Facing a complex challenge? At STX Next, you collaborate with true enthusiasts and experts who prioritize professional support and direct, honest feedback.

Tech Events

Gain access to specialized knowledge through bootcamps, Strategic Skills Labs, and Tech Knowledge Hubs focused on AI, Data, and Cloud. Beyond our internal webinars and technical materials, we host branded meetups like DevDuck and PAIDA.

In-person Networking

We support autonomy by enabling project groups to set up their own internal meetings in a location they prefer, often in our Poznań or Gliwice offices, which are great for coordination and building professional relationships. We also take a break from our screens twice a year for our Summer and Winter events.

Professional Toolkit

Prior to your first day as a NEXTer, you will receive a top-tier equipment setup: laptops, monitor, and peripherals tailored to your needs and specific project role.

Our Team:

At our global Digital Document Management (DDM) team, we provide cross-functional services for all Business and Functional Units worldwide within DSV supporting them with our services as backbone for DSV operations by providing digital creation, distribution, archival and document exchange processes. Running initiatives and upcoming projects are thriving to further improve and boost our way of digitizing DSV’s global digital document management.

You will primarily fill the role of Application architect for DSV’s Document Enterprise Service (Doc ES) application under the Digital Document Management (DDM) team along with architectural support to other applications under DDM.

This role is expected to:

Drive system level technical design and implementation of greenfield components
Have constant focus on architectural best practices for solving scalability, availability and security areas in Doc ES
Collaborate with product administration and management peers
Ensure consistency and quality in the digital document services landscape
Work closely with Solution architects, DDM Lead Architect, Lead developer and development team as well as Product Managers to enhance stability and drive improvements
Solution and system design all relevant new integrations and further targets from enterprise data platform relations

Responsibility/ Tasks:

Adapt and apply system architecture, integration guidelines, and data architecture principles defined by the DDM Solution Architecture and EDP
Maintain a strong focus on operational cost and nonfunctional requirements in close alignment with the DDM Solution Architect
Continuously learn and adapt to the evolving enterprise Digital Document Solution landscape with guidance from the DDM Solution Architect
Collaborate with the Lead Solution Architect, Domain Specialists, and Business Analysts during requirement analysis to ensure alignment with the broader DDM solution direction
Serve as a backup domain SME for DocES to prevent single points of failure in domain expertise
Act as the custodian of the technical and system level architecture of DocES components as they evolve

Serve as the bridge between DocES and the Digital Core Backend Team for changes involving relevant SDKs and architectural dependencies

Engage with DevSecOps, Database, and Network teams to troubleshoot blocker issues in environments or CI/CD pipelines

BE language: Java

Event Streaming: Confluent Kafka, K streams
Containerization: Docker
Container orchestration: Kubernetes
CI/CD: Azure DevOps, AWS
Identity brokerage: Keycloak
Load balancing: NGINX
