University degree in computer science, IT or equivalent.
3-4 years of experience in architect roles (e.g technical architect or software architect) with an overall minimum technical/IT experience of 8-12 years.
Experience with ELK and Prometheus for application log and metrics monitoring.
Experience with microservice patterns (such as Domain Driven, Event Driven, and CQRS) is valuable.
Good knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure), containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform).

Experience in designing and aligning system interface documentation to ensure clarity and consistency.
Business fluency in both written and spoken English is a must.
Strong at effective cross-cultural communication with an international and collaborative mindset.
Knowledge of agile software delivery methodologies along with experience of handling development tickets in Jira & documentation in Confluence like tools

Work environment rooted in Scandinavian organisational culture

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs.
Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction.
Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability.
Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment.
Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost.
Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.
Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices.
Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, and API design using REST and GraphQL.
Practical experience with Git branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.

AI-powered engineering (required)

Deep, hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI coding tool such as Claude Code
, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work.
Practical fluency with AI productivity tools across the broader workflow: LLM chat assistants for design and review, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, and research.
Ability to design effective context for AI agents — writing good prompts, structuring repos and docs (e.g. CLAUDE.md / rules files) so agents perform well, and knowing when to delegate vs. when to drive manually.
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
and the broader pattern of connecting AI agents to internal tools, data sources, and services.
Awareness of the security, privacy, IP, and quality risks of AI-assisted development, and opinions on how to mitigate them at an organizational level.
Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities and agent-based components into backend products and workflows is a strong plus.

Ways of working

Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end delivery of complex features — from architecture through production.
Excellent analytical skills and a strong self-learning instinct; comfortable ramping up quickly on unfamiliar domains.
Strong communication and influencing skills — able to align engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders around a technical direction.
Excellent written and verbal English.

jobs.title: Senior Software  AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Software AI Engineer to join a high-impact, AI-augmented modernization initiative for a leading global asset management firm. In this role, you will help modernize a mission-critical estate of 149 production applications using cutting-edge agentic AI coding workflows, specification-driven analysis, and automated remediation pipelines. The portfolio is predominantly C# / .NET and Python, with Angular, WPF/WCF frontends, SQL Server backends, and internal APIs. Working alongside senior London-based consultants, you will build and drive an advanced AI pipeline designed to improve existing codebases, lift automated test coverage past 70%, clear security vulnerabilities (CVEs), and migrate services to the cloud via GitHub Actions.

Responsibilities

Spec-Driven Insights & Agentic Diagnostics: Apply cutting-edge spec-driven approaches and agentic AI tooling (Copilot agent mode, internal client LLMs, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude Code) to analyze code health, perform deep-dive assessments, and triage defects at scale.
Vulnerability Remediation: Validate and fix pre-identified security vulnerabilities, execute dependency upgrades, and resolve SAST/DAST/CVE findings to pass quality gates into modern delivery platforms.
Test Engineering & Quality Hardening: Build out functional, integration, and end-to-end test suites using AI tooling, replacing ineffective tests with high-confidence automated suites to reach 70%+ coverage.
Pipeline Extension & BAU Scaling: Enroll additional portfolio services into the standing agentic analysis and remediation pipeline while continuously refining the pipeline's automation patterns.
Extended Architectural Analysis: Perform deep architectural evaluations for flagship codebases exceeding 500k LoC to formulate targeted analysis and refactoring strategies.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with London-based onsite consultants, business stakeholders, and technical teams to validate findings, prioritize backlogs, and align on remediation goals.

Requirements

General Engineering & Legacy Experience: Strong general software engineering background with proven ability to navigate, understand, and contribute production-quality changes across under-documented legacy codebases.
Agentic AI & LLM Proficiency: Demonstrated, hands-on experience using LLMs in software engineering settings to drive agentic coding workflows, generate tests, and remediate non-trivial code at scale.
Testing Discipline: Genuine test engineering mindset—writing high-confidence tests by default and differentiating between raw line coverage and true functional confidence.
Autonomy & Communication: High autonomy with a pragmatic, get-it-done attitude; fluent written and spoken English with clear technical communication capabilities.
Location: Based in Poland, comfortable working in a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office) with regular collaboration across Poland and London teams.

Nice to have

Core Tech Stack Experience: Production experience with C# / .NET (.NET Framework to .NET 6/8 modernization, WPF/WCF replacement) and/or Python.
Spec-Driven & Pipeline Tooling: Exposure to specification-driven AI tools (e.g., JUXT's Allium or GitHub's spec-kit) or experience building repeatable code-analysis pipelines.
Security & CI/CD: Practical experience with CVE triage, dependency upgrades, SAST/DAST tools, and enterprise CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy).
Domain Knowledge: Prior experience in financial services, asset management, or other heavily regulated enterprise environments.

We offer

Opportunity to work on bleeding-edge projects
Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team
Competitive salary
Flexible schedule
Benefits package - medical insurance, sports
Corporate social events
Professional development opportunities
Well-equipped office

About Us

Grid Dynamics (NASDAQ: GDYN) is a leading provider of technology consulting, platform and product engineering, AI, and advanced analytics services. Fusing technical vision with business acumen, we solve the most pressing technical challenges and enable positive business outcomes for enterprise companies undergoing business transformation. A key differentiator for Grid Dynamics is our 8 years of experience and leadership in enterprise AI, supported by profound expertise and ongoing investment in data, analytics, cloud & DevOps, application modernization and customer experience. Founded in 2006, Grid Dynamics is headquartered in Silicon Valley with offices across the Americas, Europe, and India.

jobs.description:
About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 56,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion (at the go-forward perimeter), operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE listed on Euronext Paris.

The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance.

We are looking for a strong Backend Engineer or Full-Stack Engineer with deep backend expertise who can combine software engineering
excellence with a Forward Deployed Engineer
mindset.

This person will work closely with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to rapidly understand problems, design practical solutions, build prototypes, and deliver production-ready applications.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in ambiguous environments, translating business needs into technical solutions, and using modern AI development tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, documentation, and delivery. A person who enjoys solving complex business problems rather than working with a predefined technology stack.

Required experience and skills:

Experience in consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or Forward Deployed Engineering.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong backend development experience using technologies such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar.
Experience designing REST APIs, event-driven services, integrations, and distributed systems.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and modern development practices.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems and quickly become productive.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to work directly with clients and operate effectively when requirements are incomplete or rapidly evolving.
Practical experience using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar.
Valid work permit

AI Engineering capabilities:

Understanding of LLM-based application architecture.
Experience with prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, agents, and RAG patterns.
Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
Experience using AI tools to accelerate the complete software-development lifecycle.
Ability to move quickly from an idea or natural-language requirement to a working prototype without compromising production engineering standards.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless platforms, or microservices.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with observability, infrastructure as code, API management, and integration platforms.

Your future role

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, integrations, and data-processing solutions.
Build full-stack applications when required, with primary ownership of backend architecture and implementation.
Work directly with clients and business stakeholders to understand challenges and translate them into working software.
Rapidly prototype, validate, and roll out new solutions.
Take end-to-end ownership, from requirements discovery and solution design to deployment and operational support.
Integrate enterprise platforms, cloud services, databases, APIs, and AI capabilities.
Use AI-assisted development tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and rapid experimentation.
Apply rapid “vibe coding” techniques responsibly while maintaining security, maintainability, testing, and engineering quality.
Build AI-enabled applications using LLMs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and structured data.
Establish reusable development patterns, accelerators, templates, and engineering standards.
Support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, observability, and production troubleshooting.
Collaborate with architects, DevOps engineers, data engineers, frontend developers, and client delivery teams.
Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Selection process

What you only must do is to take the first step – press the apply button and send us your CV, go through all the stages of the recruitment process:

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects
Meeting with Business
(optional, depends on case)

Then, last thing to do will be to sign a contract with us. Deloitte is simply your best choice.

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. jobs.title: Software Engineer in Digital Automation
jobs.description:
IKEA Group brings together three core businesses: Retail Concept, Range and Supply
. Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA offer and make it more accessible for the many people. IKEA Supply is responsible for securing that the product offer is produced and delivered to our customers. We lead the supply agenda across many functions and work together with all business areas, different business units, but also retail markets to secure customer availability in all markets and sales channels at lowest total cost.

Together we create a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves, to experiment, try new ways, and dare to ask, “What if…?”. We believe in everyday personal growth and offer the opportunity to develop your career globally. At IKEA we have a vibrant culture where ideas are heard, where there is opportunity to learn new skills and where the goal always is “To create a better everyday life for the many people”. We give down-to-earth, straightforward people the possibility to grow, both as individuals and in their professional roles. We offer this position in a fast-paced, truly global environment with an endless supply of challenges and development opportunities.

Job Description

As a Software Engineer in Digital Automation, you will design, develop, test, deploy and maintain high-quality software that enables automation and supports business outcomes across the IKEA value chain. You will work within an agile, cross-functional team and contribute across the full software lifecycle, from understanding needs and shaping solutions to operating and continuously improving them in production.

You will apply modern software engineering principles and use appropriate tools, automation and delivery practices to create secure, reliable, reusable and maintainable solutions. Within Digital Automation, your work may include workflow and process automation, integrations, APIs, low-code or pro-code extensions, data models, cloud services and AI-enabled capabilities. The exact technology focus will depend on the assigned product, platform or technology domain.

More Specifically, In This Role You Will (be)

Develop and operate software for the assigned Digital Automation product, platform or technology domain, taking shared responsibility for quality throughout its lifecycle.
Deliver tested, deployable and maintainable code that supports agreed business outcomes, architectural principles and security requirements.
Apply and promote modern software engineering practices, including version control, code review, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery.
Work collaboratively in an agile, cross-functional team, contributing to planning, backlog refinement, delivery, maintenance and continuous improvement.
Create and evaluate solution proposals and prototypes, such as mock-ups, data models, integrations or proof-of-concept implementations.
Continuously explore relevant technologies, tools, standards and working methods that can improve innovation, productivity, reliability and user experience.
Produce and maintain appropriate technical documentation and proactively share knowledge, learning and good practices with colleagues.
Contribute to team and product performance indicators and work with colleagues to continuously improve delivery effectiveness and technical quality.

Qualifications

We are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data & technology together - an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. A journey that needs passionate people who embrace change, dare to question and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us. Together we can do great things.

Experience & Qualifications

Formal qualifications in computer science, software engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Minimum three years of professional experience as a Software Engineer.
Experience designing, implementing, testing, deploying and maintaining software solutions.
Experience working in agile software development teams with a DevOps working setup, self-organisation and delivery against agreed commitments.
Experience working collaboratively in cross-functional and culturally diverse teams.
Experience with digital automation, workflow solutions, integrations, APIs, cloud services, low-code platforms or AI-enabled solutions is an advantage.

Knowledge & Motivation

Good knowledge of software engineering principles and modern development practices using industry-standard tools.
Good knowledge of design and architecture concepts, and the ability to follow agreed architectural, security and interoperability requirements.
Technical knowledge of relevant technologies, standards, protocols and interfaces, and the ability to apply them effectively.
Clear communication skills, verbally and in writing, with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organisational levels and backgrounds.
Passion for delivering high-quality software and a great user experience.
Motivation to continuously develop programming skills and stay curious about evolving tools, technologies and ways of working.
A solution-oriented, collaborative mindset, with the confidence to navigate uncertainty, challenge existing approaches and prototype new ideas.

Additional Information

If you have any questions about the role, please reach out to Jason Dennehy, Platform Manager in D&T SCD. Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. We look forward to receiving your application at the latest 09.10.2026.

You might have some questions about the recruitment process, and we are more than happy to answer those! Feel free to connect with the People & Culture Generalist, Katarzyna Ziółkowska-Niezgoda.

...and more!

Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

• Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
• Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
• Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
• Experience building and running containerized applications
• Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
• Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
• Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
• Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
• Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
• Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Microservices architecture and system design
• Messaging and integration technologies: Kafka, IBM MQ, Tibco EMS
• Relational databases: Azure SQL, Oracle, Sybase
• Testing frameworks (unit, integration and E2E testing)
• CI/CD pipelines (GitLab / GitHub)
• Monitoring and observability practices

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

jobs.description:
Software Engineer .NET & React, Accenture Gothenburg

Are you an experienced Software Engineer looking to work with modern technologies, cloud solutions, and AI-driven projects? Do you want to help build innovative solutions for some of Sweden’s most exciting organizations? If so, Accenture in Gothenburg could be the right place for you.

About Accenture Digital Core

Accenture Digital Core
helps organizations turn innovation into reality and drive sustainable growth through user-centered and creative problem-solving, deep industry expertise, and modern solutions in digital transformation and security.

With our broad capabilities, strong delivery excellence, and extensive experience, we are a trusted partner to our clients.

Together with our skilled and dedicated colleagues around the world, we work to bridge business needs with the opportunities created by rapid technological advancement.

About The Role

We are currently looking for Software Engineers to join our team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will work on a variety of client engagements, developing modern, scalable, and business-critical solutions. You will collaborate closely with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams to create value through technology.

As a Software Engineer, you will work across the entire development lifecycle - from user experience and frontend development to backend services, integrations, and cloud-based infrastructure. Our projects vary in size and complexity, providing opportunities to both broaden and deepen your expertise.

We build digital products and platforms that matter. As a Software Engineer at Accenture, you'll work with experienced engineers, architects, and product teams to solve complex business challenges using modern technology. We believe great software is built by empowered teams, continuous learning, and close collaboration with our clients.

Whether your passion lies in frontend experiences, backend systems, cloud-native architectures, or AI-enabled solutions, you'll have the opportunity to influence both technology and ways of working

What We're Looking For

We're looking for Software Engineers who have experience building modern applications in cloud environments.

You likely have 4+ years of experience with:

.NET/C# development

Modern frontend development, preferably with React and TypeScript

Designing and consuming APIs

Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud

Modern software engineering practices including CI/CD, containers, and automated testing

It's a plus if you have experience with:

Kubernetes and microservices architectures

Data platforms and integrations

AI-assisted development or AI-powered solutions

Who Are You?

We believe you:

Have 4+ years of experience in Software Engineering.

Are confident working with C# and .NET.

Have experience with modern frontend frameworks, preferably React.

Are passionate about building smart technical solutions and sustainable system design.

Thrive in a consulting environment and enjoy building long-term relationships.

Are curious about new technologies and eager to continue learning and growing.

Enjoy sharing knowledge and contributing to the development of your team.

All job ads will be reviewed in August. We encourage you to apply already in July, but please note that we will provide updates only from August onwards.

Why Join Accenture?

At Accenture, you'll be part of a strong engineering culture where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are at the heart of how we work. We actively invest in competence development through certifications, training programs, technical communities, and hands-on learning in client projects.

Our client engagements vary in size, complexity, and industry, providing opportunities to work with everything from digital customer experiences and business-critical platforms to cloud transformations and AI-driven solutions. Gothenburg also offers exciting opportunities to work with some of the leading companies in the various sectors and contribute to the future of connected, software-defined, and sustainable mobility.

Depending on the client engagement and project requirements, you will have the opportunity to work in a hybrid setup, combining on-site collaboration with remote work.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Fullstackutvecklare
jobs.description:
Vi utmanar de traditionella konsultbolagen och vi kan med stolthet säga att Castra är konsultbranschens mest utvecklande arbetsplats där allt är möjligt. Känns det här som företaget för dig så läs gärna vidare.

Rollen

Vi söker en erfaren Senior .NET-utvecklare med fullstackprofil som vill arbeta med utveckling av moderna och robusta system i tekniskt utmanande miljöer.

I rollen kommer du att ha .NET som din huvudsakliga kompetens och arbeta med både backend- och frontendutveckling. Du blir en viktig del av utvecklingsarbetet och kommer att vara involverad i allt från teknisk analys och design till implementation, testning och vidareutveckling.

Vi söker dig som har ett starkt tekniskt intresse och som trivs med att ta ansvar för hela utvecklingsprocessen. Du har förmågan att förstå komplexa tekniska problem, se helheten och samtidigt arbeta på detaljnivå när det krävs.

Vi har pågående projekt inom bland annat statliga myndigheter där du får möjlighet att arbeta med lösningar som stödjer viktiga verksamhetsprocesser och möter höga krav på kvalitet och stabilitet. I rollen kommer du bland annat att analysera behov och tekniska frågeställningar, utveckla och vidareutveckla funktionalitet samt arbeta med både backend- och frontendlösningar. Du kommer även att bidra i testning, felsökning och vidareutveckling av befintliga system.

Erfarenhet

Minst 7 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, med .NET som huvudsaklig teknisk kompetens.
Erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling med både backend och frontend.
Minst 2 års erfarenhet av React.
Praktisk erfarenhet av cloudmiljöer, exempelvis AWS, Azure eller GCP.
Erfarenhet av Kubernetes och/eller OpenShift.
Erfarenhet av Docker och containerbaserade lösningar.
Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska i tal och skrift.

Meriterande

Erfarenhet av Apache Kafka och eventdriven arkitektur.
Erfarenhet av både privat och offentlig sektor.

Varför ska du välja oss?

Här tror vi på frihet, möjligheter och medbestämmande. Att du som medarbetare ska ha möjlighet att utvecklas och forma ditt arbete utefter dina intressen och prioriteringar i livet. Att alla får vara med och forma och påverka bolaget genom delägarskap, advisory board och projektgrupper. Att det är viktigt att ha ett sammanhang, känna tillhörighet och att man har kollegor som stöttar, utvecklar och tror på en.

Om Castra

Castra är en entreprenörsdriven konsultgrupp inom IT, management och systemutveckling. Bolaget ägs gemensamt av medarbetarna och tillsammans bygger vi det företag vi själva vill jobba på.

Vår vision är att vi ska vara Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare för konsulter. Att vi blivit certifierade av Great Place to Work® fem år i rad är ett bevis på våra höga mål kring företagskultur. Våra tankar om delaktighet, påverkansmöjligheter och respekt för individens egna val och möjligheter fungerar.

Företaget har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Örebro och Jönköping. Mer information om Castra-koncernen hittar du på vår hemsida www.castra.se.

Sök direkt via länken eller kontakta emma.emsjo@castra.se.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Full Stack Developer who enjoys building modern, scalable, and business-critical applications? Do you want to play a key role in a new strategic initiative within a global organisation while working with modern technologies and cloud-based solutions?

We are currently looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Global Applications team in Malmö, Sweden.

In this role, you will take a leading part in developing new applications and enhancing existing solutions used across ASSA ABLOY's global business. You will work with technologies such as .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL, and Microsoft Azure, collaborating with colleagues across multiple countries and functions.

This is an opportunity for an experienced developer who thrives in a hands-on role, enjoys technical ownership, and wants to contribute to the design, development, and future direction of business-critical applications. You will join a collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

What you will do as our Senior Full Stack Developer

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and improving applications and services that support our global business. You will work closely with colleagues across development, support, and business functions to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

You would also:

Participate in daily operations and strategic digital transformation initiatives, contributing to the ongoing evolution of our application landscape.
Design, develop, maintain, and enhance applications, services, and platforms using technologies such as Microsoft Azure, .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL, MS Windows, Visual Studio, and related tools.
Develop, maintain, and support application platforms and their underlying infrastructure, ensuring reliability, scalability, performance, and required maintenance activities.
Identify and drive improvement and automation opportunities, taking ownership from idea and solution design through implementation and documentation in line with best practices.
Act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, development teams, business users, and business analysts to translate business requirements into practical solutions.
Architect, design, build, and implement application platforms and services, while delivering new functionality and enhancements for internal customers.
Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve platform-related issues, coordinate defect resolution across teams, and support the ongoing maintenance, improvement, and documentation of application platforms.

The Skills And Experience You Need

We are looking for someone who has:

At least 5 years of experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong experience with C#, .NET, SQL, and modern application development.
Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based solutions.
Experience with frontend technologies such as React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience building and consuming APIs and working across the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to deployment.
Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and communicate effectively in English and Swedish.

You are a proactive, structured, and solution-oriented developer who enjoys taking ownership and turning ideas into practical, scalable solutions. You thrive in collaborative environments and are comfortable working closely with developers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. Experience working in Agile environments is important, and you bring curiosity, initiative, and a genuine passion for learning new technologies and approaches.

Experience working in enterprise-scale environments, setting up Azure infrastructure and cloud environments, and using tools such as Jira, GitHub, and ServiceNow is considered an advantage. Most importantly, you are someone who can navigate complex technical challenges, balance technical excellence with business needs, and contribute ideas that improve both our technology and the way we work.

What We Offer

We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:

Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills.
A competitive salary
Hybrid model of working
Stable employment in a friendly international atmosphere

We review applications regularly, so don't wait.

We are building diverse and inclusive teams and encourage applications from all who can envision themselves working with us.

To ensure that your personal information is secure, we do not review any applications sent via email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please send an email to Khalil Kabakibi, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at Khalil.kabakibi@assaabloy.com .

Let's together create a safer and more open world!

To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

jobs.title: System Developer
jobs.description:
Vill du bygga och vidareutveckla system som används för lån, sparande och kreditkort – i ett team som tar fullt ansvar från behov till drift? På Norion Bank söker vi nu en utvecklare som vill kombinera stark teknisk problemlösning med nära samarbete i team.

OM ROLLEN

I vårt team utvecklar vi bankens plattform, web och app för konsumentprodukter. Vi jobbar nära våra användare och produktchefer för att förstå deras och kundens behov.

Vår plattform bygger på modern teknik. Vi håller fokus på kvalitet och resiliens även när vi håller ett högt tempo.

Som devops-team tar vi ett helhetsansvar för utveckling, test, deployment, drift och support för vårt/våra system. Cybersäkerhet och sekretess är en naturlig del av vår vardag och genomsyrar såväl arbetssätt som designval. Alla ges utrymme (och förväntas) bidra med design- och arkitekturbeslut.

På Norion Bank har vi en cloud first-strategi vilket betyder att alla tjänster utvecklas mot och driftas i Azure.

OM DIG

Vi söker dig som har några års arbetslivserfarenhet inom utveckling i .NET. Du ser testbarhet, automatisering och observability som en naturlig del av utvecklingsarbetet. Som person är du nyfiken, lyhörd och kvalitetsmedveten.

Du har erfarenhet av drift i Azure och gärna även av att sätta upp infrastruktur med kod, gärna Bicep. Det är självklart för dig att skriva tester.

Vi tror att du som söker har erfarenhet och intresse för några av dessa områden:

.NET 10/C#
Blazor
Azure
SQL

Ett extra plus om du är intresserad av Domain Driven Design, CQRS och eventsourcing!

På Norion Bank vill vi bygga team där lösningar, utmaningar och hinder diskuteras öppet och hanteras tillsammans. Det ställer krav på att du är en person som engagerar dig, delar med dig av dina perspektiv och tar ansvar för helheten – inte bara din egen kod eller dina egna uppgifter. Hos oss behöver du kunna be om hjälp när det behövs, bidra till att stötta andra och våga ifrågasätta, utmana och driva tekniska resonemang framåt.

Koncernspråket är svenska och all dokumentation sker på svenska.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med en provanställning i början, med start enligt överenskommelse.

På Norion Bank arbetar vi enligt en hybrid-setup med både kontorsarbete och distansarbete. Kontorsarbetet sker på vårt huvudkontor vid Lilla Bommen i Göteborg. Där sitter våra team tillsammans vilket främjar både kommunikation och samarbete.

OM NORION BANK GROUP

Norion Bank Group är en affärsnära nordisk finansieringsbank. Genom koncernens varumärken Norion Bank, Walley och Collector erbjuds kundanpassade finansieringstjänster som möter distinkta kundbehov inom tre kundsegment: medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag, handlare och privatpersoner. Som specialist på finansieringslösningar är Norion Bank Group ett ledande komplement till traditionella storbanker, med visionen att vara den främsta nordiska finansieringsbanken inom de utvalda segmenten.  

Norion Banks erbjudande omfattar företags- och fastighetskrediter samt factoring för medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag. Genom varumärket Walley erbjuds flexibla betal- och checkoutlösningar till handlare och privatpersoner. Varumärket Collector tillhandahåller privatlån och kreditkort till privatpersoner samt sparkonton för privatpersoner och företag. Norion Bank Group (tidigare Collector Bank) grundades 1999 och har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Oslo och Helsingfors. Verksamheten bedrivs genom Norion Bank AB (publ) som är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm.  

NORION BANKS ERBJUDANDE TILL DIG

För oss är det självklart att varje individs utveckling värdesätts högt vilket innebär ett stort fokus på självledarskap och kompetensutveckling. Gemenskap, innovation och modern arbetsmetodik är saker som kännetecknar Norion Bank Group. Vi erbjuder dig helt enkelt en organisation med snabba beslutsvägar, stor öppenhet och mycket energi.

Vi erbjuder dig ett spännande bolag med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, löpande kompetensutveckling och gemensamma aktiviteter på och utanför arbetsplatsen.

REKRYTERINGSPROCESSEN

Vi vill att vår rekryteringsprocess ska vara rättvis och inkluderande. Därför ber vi dig att inte bifoga foto eller annan information som inte är relevant för tjänsten. Personligt brev är inget krav.

I samtliga rekryteringsprocesser genomför Norion Bank bakgrundskontroller på slutkandidaten. Bakgrundskontrollen innefattar bland annat ekonomisk information, juridisk information och bosättningsuppgifter.

Norion Bank kommer att behandla dina personuppgifter i enlighet med gällande dataskyddslagstiftning. Läs mer om vår hantering av personuppgifter och dina rättigheter på https://karriar.norionbank.se/data-privacy

Vi undanber oss kontakt med rekryteringsbolag, konsultbolag samt annonsörer i rekryteringen.

INTRESSERAD?

Kul! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så ansök redan idag!

Frågor? Välkommen att höra av dig till oss!

För frågor kring teamet och rollen, kontakta gärna Adam Svensson, Head of Development Consumer på adam.svensson@norionbank.se

För frågor om oss som arbetsgivare eller rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta gärna Jesper Östlund, HR Business Partner på jesper.ostlund@norionbank.se

As a Solution Designer you will be part of a dedicated agile Software Development Team and your main responsibilities are:

To guide and support the agile development team to build high quality software solutions
To develop and design robust and sustainable IT Solutions to ensure the best user and customer experience.
To act as a bridge between business and technical knowledge
Be able to translate user stories into detailed solutions and integration design, following architecture guidelines.
To team up with IT Solution Architects and Solution Designers to collaborate on technical aspects by following and improving Vattenfall IT framework and guidelines
To refine and review business requirements to ensure the most effective use of infrastructure, IT systems and customer experience
Your solution design and software development skills are according to best practice principles
Contribute to agile team norms and coding standards, software design best practices, and architecture strategy
Use, ensure and implement secure software development
Be an ambassador for application solution best practices and application security
Share your software development and solution design best practices with your peers within IT

Qualifications

We believe you will thrive in this role if you have strong communication skills, a solid understanding of the IT business, and a collaborative mindset, along with the ability to motivate others. A deep interest in driving value-creating innovation is key. We also value experiences that have helped you develop leadership capabilities.

University degree in Information Technology, Engineering or other relevant education
At least 6 years of the tech stack: Angular 20+, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS .net core 9, Microsoft Azure Cloud solutions
Including: Experienced fullstack developer (Frontend and Backend)
Experienced in Frontend software development
Experienced in API development, design, integration and management

At least 5 years’ experience in Solution Design and good understanding of IT architecture within end to end web and cloud solutions
Have used Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, Git, Tailwind, Bootstrap, SAST and DAST tools in your daily work
A deep interest in driving value-creating innovation and of using AI software development tools (like Cursor, Github CoPilot and MS Foundry)
Knowledge of  Optimizely (EpiServer CMS) development is a beneficial
Experience in Agile frameworks and agile software development

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom applications-team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation, med leverans av affärskritiska cloudlösningar i hög kvalitet och hastighet, möjliggjort genom Generative AI. Bli en del av oss och hjälp världsledande organisationer att frigöra teknikens värde och bygga en mer hållbar och inkluderande framtid!

Om rollen

Som Cloud Engineer med fokus på Azure blir du en del av vårt Göteborgsteam med cirka 30 engagerade utvecklare som tillsammans skapar affärskritiska lösningar i varierande och spännande kunduppdrag. Du arbetar i agila team där modern teknik, samarbete och verkligt kundvärde står i centrum.

Hos oss är lärande en naturlig del av vardagen. Genom certifieringar, utveckling i uppdrag och arbete i tekniskt komplexa Azure-miljöer får du kontinuerligt stärka din kompetens. AI‑stödd utveckling är en viktig del av vårt arbetssätt, där du använder AI‑verktyg som stöd i ditt dagliga arbete, samtidigt som du behåller fullt tekniskt ansvar för arkitektur, kodkvalitet och säkerhet.

Vi satsar aktivt på att bygga AI‑kompetens och ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas inom området genom praktisk tillämpning, samarbete med specialister och tillgång till kurser. Fokus ligger på att använda AI på ett ansvarsfullt och värdeskapande sätt i utvecklingsprocessen.

Vi ger dig förutsättningarna att växa, både tekniskt och professionellt, och att utvecklas till en nyckelperson inom cloud.

I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i:

Designa, implementera och optimera säkra och skalbara Azure-lösningar
Arbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter och andra kompetenser i tvärfunktionella team
Arbeta med AI‑stöd i utvecklingsarbetet, till exempel för kodgenerering, refaktorering, test, felsökning eller dokumentation
Bidra med din Azure-expertis och aktivt delta i ständig förbättring och innovation

Vi arbetar enligt en hybrid arbetsmodell, där du varierar mellan arbete hos kund, på vårt kontor och hemifrån med flexibilitet utifrån uppdrag.

Din profil

Minst 5 års erfarenhet som utvecklare, med goda kunskaper inom .NET och Microsoft Azure
Praktisk erfarenhet eller vana av att använda AI‑verktyg, exempelvis AI‑baserad kodkomplettering eller AI som “pair programmer” samt förmåga att kritiskt granska och kvalitetssäkra AI‑genererad kod ur perspektiv som säkerhet, prestanda och arkitektur
Erfarenhet av containerteknologier (t.ex. Kubernetes/AKS)
Erfarenhet av CI/CD, exempelvis via Azure DevOps eller GitHub
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har Microsoft Azure-certifieringar, exempelvis AZ-204 och/eller AZ-900 samt certifieringar eller erfarenhet inom AI.

Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas

Möjlighet att ta en viktig roll i utvecklingen av affärskritiska cloudlösningar, där du får påverka arkitektur, och hur AI‑stödd utveckling används i praktiken hos våra kunder
Arbete i tekniskt komplexa och moderna Azure-miljöer, där du får tillgång till och arbetar med den senaste tekniken inom moln, automatisering och AI, tillsammans med erfarna kollegor och ett starkt globalt nätverk av specialister.
En kultur som aktivt uppmuntrar lärande, innovation och kunskapsdelning, med tydliga möjligheter till certifieringar, kompetensutveckling och mentorskap, och där du ges förtroende att driva förändring, utvecklas som expert och skapa verkligt affärsvärde.
Flexibelt arbete som stödjer balans i livet, samt kontinuerligt lärande genom utbildningar, certifieringar och mentorskap
Engagerande tech communities och interna initiativ, i en inkluderande kultur med fokus på gemenskap, hållbarhet och välmående

Ansökan

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.

Målet är tydligt: att vara en helhetsleverantör inom Microsoft Azure, end to end. Hos oss tror vi att verkligt värde skapas när du behärskar båda sidor av AI: att både bygga med AI och att bygga AI-lösningar som skapar affärsvärde för kunder.

Arbeta aktivt med AI‑stöd i utvecklingsprocessen, exempelvis för att generera, granska, förklara eller förbättra kod samt för test och felsökning
Använda din Azure‑expertis för att driva förbättringar, dela kunskap och bidra till innovation och ständig utveckling

jobs.title: Engineering Manager till Hogia Redovisning & Revision
jobs.description:
Är du en tekniskt stark ledare som drivs av att utveckla både människor och teknik? Vill du leda ett kompetent utvecklingsteam samtidigt som du driver den tekniska utvecklingen mot moderna, molnbaserade lösningar? Hos Hogia Redovisning & Revision får du en nyckelroll där du kombinerar ledarskap, teknikstrategi och innovation med ett nära samarbete med verksamheten.

Om rollen

Som Engineering Manager har du det övergripande ansvaret för ett utvecklingsteam med ca 10 medarbetare bestående av utvecklare och testare. Ditt främsta fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för teamets framgång genom ett närvarande och utvecklande ledarskap, samtidigt som du leder den tekniska utvecklingen framåt.

Du ansvarar för att driva de strategiskt viktiga teknikfrågorna inom området och säkerställa en hållbar utveckling av våra produkter. Rollen innebär ett stort fokus på modernisering, automation och AI-drivna arbetssätt där du tillsammans med teamet identifierar möjligheter att effektivisera utveckling, kvalitetssäkring och leverans. Du följer aktivt utvecklingen inom teknikområdet, omvärldsbevakar och omsätter relevanta trender till konkreta initiativ som stärker både produkterna och arbetssätten.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att balansera förvaltningen av våra hybrida Core-produkter med den fortsatta utvecklingen av våra molnbaserade lösningar. Du arbetar nära produktledning, kravställare och andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa rätt tekniska vägval över tid.

Rollen är huvudsakligen strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, men beroende på situation och behov kan du även bidra operativt i tekniska frågor eller utvecklingsarbete.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi tror att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande samt flera års erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling. Du har tidigare haft personalansvar eller lett utvecklingsteam och känner dig trygg i att kombinera ett coachande ledarskap med tekniskt beslutsfattande.

Du har erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmiljöer och molnbaserade lösningar samt ett intresse för hur automation och AI kan skapa effektivare utvecklingsprocesser och bättre produkter.

Vi arbetar bland annat med: C#, .NET Core, Microservices, Azure DevOps, Git, React, HTML/CSS, SQL, Cosmos DB, C++, MFC, XML

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga tekniker, men du har en bred teknisk förståelse och en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.

Som person är du en trygg och prestigelös ledare som bygger engagemang, tydlighet och samarbete. Du är strukturerad och har förmågan att prioritera, skapa riktning och driva förändring även när flera initiativ pågår samtidigt. Du trivs med att arbeta långsiktigt, har ett genuint intresse för ny teknik och inspireras av att omsätta nya möjligheter till affärsnytta. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska och samarbetar naturligt med kollegor, chefer och externa samarbetspartners.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss bygger du lösningar som används av tusentals kunder och blir en viktig del av vår resa mot framtidens molnbaserade affärssystem. Du får möjlighet att påverka både teknikval, arbetssätt och teamets utveckling i en organisation som värdesätter innovation, kvalitet och långsiktighet.

Vi erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och fritid samt attraktiva förmåner. Vi satsar på hälsa och erbjuder flera träningsaktiviteter, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan och en arbetsmiljö där kompetensutveckling uppmuntras.

Hos Hogia får du en roll där ditt ledarskap och din tekniska förståelse blir avgörande för att forma framtidens produkter.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stenungsund med möjlighet till att arbeta två dagar i veckan på distans.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Hogia-gruppen

Hogia utvecklar, säljer och supportar programvaror och IT-system för företag som effektivt vill fokusera på sina verksamheter i stället för krånglig och tidsödande administration. Vi erbjuder allt från mindre löne- och bokföringsprogram för småföretagaren till kompletta, branschspecifika IT-lösningar och -system för exempelvis kollektivtrafik, åkerier, godsterminaler, revisionsbyråer och fastighetsbolag. jobs.title: Software Test Engineer — Verification & Test Automation
jobs.description:
Denna annons är publicerad i samarbete med Jobbet.se. Ansökan sker via Jobbet.se:s hemsida.

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure? Scandinavian Real Heart (Realheart) is a Swedish company developing and manufacturing an artificial heart that mimics the anatomy and function of the human heart. In Västerås, where the company was originally founded, our team is working to take the technology from development to clinical reality. Realheart is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

About the role

We are hiring a Software Test Engineer to own software verification for a Class III medical device system spanning embedded firmware, desktop applications and the communication between them. This is a verification role in the regulatory sense: you will derive test cases from approved software requirements, demonstrate objectively that the software meets them, and produce the traceable, auditable evidence that supports the design history file and technical documentation.

You will also develop and maintain the automation that makes verification repeatable. Using a Python-based test framework integrated with CI/CD, you will help turn regression testing from extensive manual work into reliable pipeline-driven execution.

You will analyse software requirements and design specifications for testability, ambiguity and measurable acceptance criteria. You will create verification plans, protocols and test cases, select and justify suitable verification methods, define expected results and pass/fail criteria, and maintain traceability from requirement through execution record to result.

The role also includes executing protocols under configuration control, documenting objective evidence, managing deviations and amendments, investigating defects, and writing verification reports. You will contribute to design reviews and audits by clearly explaining and defending the verification approach.

On the automation side, you will design, build and maintain test frameworks and automated suites across unit, integration and system levels. This includes developing test harnesses, simulators, stubs and fixtures, as well as supporting hardware-in-the-loop testing where appropriate. You will integrate suites into GitHub Actions and help ensure that automated results can serve as reliable verification evidence.

About you

You have experience of working with software testing in a regulated environment and understand the importance of disciplined design control, configuration management and technical documentation. You are comfortable moving between detailed test work and the broader verification argument, and you can distinguish between requirement, implementation and test defects.

To succeed in the role, you combine a rigorous, structured approach with practical engineering judgement. You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating closely with software, firmware, systems and QA/RA colleagues to keep requirements, code and tests aligned.

What we offer

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of verification in a complex medical device environment and to contribute to both the verification process and the automation infrastructure that supports it. You will work across embedded firmware, desktop applications and connected interfaces, with a clear opportunity to influence templates, tooling and workflows as verification needs evolve. We welcome you to be a central member of our highly skilled and engaged team.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application. The application period runs from 18 September 2026 to 18 October 2026. For more information please feel welcome to contact Anna Nordanstig +46 70 306 55 64.

Interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

Requirements

Experience of software testing in medical devices or another comparably regulated industry, such as aerospace, automotive, rail, nuclear, defence or regulated pharma/IVD.
Understanding of formal design control or safety lifecycles, including the distinction between design verification and design validation.
Demonstrated experience of requirements-driven test design, including defining objective acceptance criteria, maintaining traceability, and producing verification protocols and reports suitable for audit.
Experience of building and maintaining automated test suites, including framework design, test data management and test fixtures.
Experience of version control, change control and formal defect management.
Strong technical documentation skills, with attention to detail and traceability.
Strong spoken and written English.

Preferred qualifications

A Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, computer science or a closely related technical field; equivalent demonstrable experience is also valued.
Working familiarity with .NET/C# and C++, including the ability to read code, understand architecture and create meaningful integration tests.
Practical Python experience for test automation, using a framework such as pytest, unittest or Robot Framework.
CI/CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions, including workflow YAML, runners, matrices, secrets, caching and artifacts.
Experience of IEC 62304 software lifecycle activities, including software safety classification, testing expectations, SOUP management and anomaly evaluation.
Familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR technical documentation and IEC 62366 usability engineering.
Experience of ALM or requirements-management tools such as Polarion, Jama, Codebeamer, DOORS or Azure DevOps, including generating trace matrices.
Experience of embedded or hardware-adjacent testing, for example serial protocols, CAN bus, instrument control, logic analysers, test rigs or hardware-in-the-loop frameworks.
Experience of static analysis, code coverage measurement and their role in software verification.
Experience of FDA inspections, notified body audits, or regulatory submissions such as 510(k), PMA or CE submissions.
Exposure to cybersecurity testing for connected medical devices.

About the employer – Scandinavian Real Heart

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure?

Scandinavian Real Heart AB is a Swedish MedTech company that develops a total artificial heart (TAH) for implantation in patients with life-threatening heart failure. Realheart® TAH has a unique, patented design that resembles that of the natural human heart. Only about 8,000 heart transplants occur annually worldwide, and the availability of donated hearts is very limited. Realheart’s mission is to save as many patients who suffer from congestive heart disease as possible through this advanced MedTech solution. Realheart has a an extremely competent and engaged team placed in Västerås in Sweden and is also carried out in very close collaboration with world-leading heart surgeons and international researchers and engineers. In 2028 the goal is to be able to perform the first implantation in a human patient. Realheart is a public company listed on Nasdaq First North and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

Job Title

ERP Integration & Automation Specialist, Lund

Job Description

Connect the systems that keep a global business moving . Every order Axis fulfills, every product we manufacture, every purchase we make touches our ERP platform. And none of it works unless the systems talk to each other properly.

That's where you come in. We're looking for an ERP Integration and Automation Specialist to join our ERP & PLM Applications team, where you'll build the connections and remove the manual work that slows a fast-growing global business down.

The role is based at our headquarters in Lund or at our office in Linköping.

Who is your future team?

You'll join our ERP & PLM applications team, the group behind some of the most business-critical applications at Axis. We support a global organization and run the full application lifecycle, from daily support to long-term development and upgrades.

The team sits in Lund and Linköping, and we work with colleagues around the world to improve our ERP platform. You'll have people close by to think out loud with, and a global organization to make an impact on.

What will you do here?

Our ERP platform is a global solution that supports many of our core functions, including manufacturing, warehousing, order fulfillment, purchasing, and finance. You'll work closely with users, business stakeholders, and your teammates to solve problems, sharpen end-to-end processes, and shape what comes next.

Your responsibilities include:

Design, build, and maintain integrations between our ERP solution and connected systems
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data flows and integration performance
Make sure integrations stay secure, scalable, and aligned with our architectural guidelines
Spot opportunities to automate manual and repetitive tasks in and around the ERP solution
Help the business put smart automation to work, so processes run smoother
Support implementation and deployment projects
Improve our platform continuously, alongside the rest of the team
Keep solutions consistent by collaborating across functions

Who are we looking for?

You're a team player who enjoys working with people, whether they sit in the next room or on another continent. You're curious about how things fit together, you share your ideas and your knowledge, and you get a small kick out of replacing a manual routine with something that just runs.

You have experience with integration and automation, ideally around Microsoft Dynamics 365 or IFS

We'd love to hear that you have:

A solid understanding of integration patterns, APIs, REST and OData, JSON and XML

Connect the systems that keep a global business moving . Every order Axis fulfills, every product we manufacture, every purchase we make touches our ERP platform. And none of it works unless the systems talk to each other properly.

That's where you come in. We're looking for an ERP Integration and Automation Specialist to join our ERP & PLM Applications team, where you'll build the connections and remove the manual work that slows a fast-growing global business down.

Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Join our Business Area IPR & Licensing Patent Operations team as an AI and Automation Software Developer. You will help create secure, practical digital solutions that improve how patent professionals work with information and manage daily processes.

You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and developing applications to deployment, maintenance and continuous improvement. Your work may support processes such as patent document analysis, claim comparison, invention evaluation and office-action preparation.

The role is based in Stockholm, with other possible locations in Madrid, Montreal or Aachen.

What you will do:

Design, develop and deploy AI-enabled applications and automation solutions for patent-related processes.
Build web applications, backend services, APIs, integrations and automated workflows using modern technologies such as Python.
Use generative AI and information-retrieval techniques to identify, process and present information from patent databases and other enterprise sources.
Develop AI-based assistants and automated solutions that support workflows from start to finish.
Integrate language models, enterprise data and machine learning capabilities into user-focused applications.
Work with patent professionals and other stakeholders to understand needs and turn them into effective technical solutions.
Write clear, maintainable and well-documented code.
Ensure that applications are reliable, responsive, maintainable and secure.
Apply appropriate controls for authentication, access management, secure data handling, secrets protection, audit records and enterprise-system integration.
Maintain, troubleshoot and improve existing applications based on user feedback and changing business needs.
Keep up to date with relevant developments in artificial intelligence, software engineering and patent technology.

The skills you bring:

Three to five years of practical experience developing software, AI-enabled applications, automation solutions or enterprise web applications.
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field.
Strong Python and backend development skills, including APIs, databases and system integration.
Experience developing web applications; full-stack experience is an advantage.
Knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript and a modern frontend framework such as React, Vue or Angular.
Practical experience with generative AI, language models, retrieval-augmented generation or similar information-retrieval approaches.
Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, REST APIs and software integration.
Familiarity with AI and machine learning tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, TensorFlow, PyTorch or similar.
Experience using Git and collaborative software development practices.
Understanding of software development processes, agile ways of working and secure application design.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical audiences.

Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom Applications team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda, skalbara och säkra cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation. AI är en nyckelteknologi i allt vi gör och en central del i hur vi formar och bygger moderna system och lösningar, där intelligenta AI-drivna arbetssätt och teknologier som Agentic AI driver utvecklingen framåt. Bli en del av oss och var med och forma framtidens system tillsammans med världsledande organisationer och bidra till att frigöra teknikens fulla potential i en mer hållbar och inkluderande värld!

Om rollen

Som integrationsutvecklare hos Capgemini blir du en nyckelspelare i utvecklingen av moderna integrationslösningar. Du arbetar nära kunden för att skapa hållbara och skalbara integrationer, samtidigt som du bidrar i plattformsresor, transformationer och tekniska förnyelseprojekt. Du anställs för din kompetens och inte bara för ett specifikt uppdrag. Detta ger dig möjlighet till variation, att både rotera mellan uppdrag och utbildning. Vilket är grunden för din utveckling. I denna position kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i:

Designa, implementera och underhålla integrationer samt genomföra analyser och utveckla strategier för att framtidssäkra integrationsmetoder, inklusive etablering av Centers for Enablement.
Genomföra molnmigreringar till Azure med hjälp av Azure integrationstjänster, hantera generell plattformsosäkerhet och underlätta övergångar mellan tekniska plattformar.
Stödja andra transformationer såsom ERP för att påskynda leverans och bidra till Capgeminis interna nätverk samt andra initiativ som utvecklar vår verksamhet.
Utveckla strategier för att framtidssäkra integrationsmetoder och etablera Centers for Enablement som en del av den långsiktiga tekniska plattformsutvecklingen.

Din profil

Du är en erfaren integrationsutvecklare som trivs i konsultrollen och gillar att driva utveckling, utmana när det behövs och skapa lösningar som gör verklig skillnad. Du är proaktiv, prestigelös och samarbetsorienterad. Du ser helheten, kommunicerar tydligt och tar ansvar i både team och kunddialoger. Vi ser att du behärskar både svenska och engelska obehindrat i tal och skrift. Du är expert inom några av följande områden, gärna flera:

AI driven utveckling: Erfarenhet av att använda AI och agentic arbetssätt för att planera, skriva och förbättra kod.
Integrationsmönster: Stark förståelse för EIP såsom händelsedrivet, API baserat, batch, streaming och datatransformation.
Teknisk integrationsbredd: Van vid Azure Integration Services, kodbaserad integration (C#/Java, REST/GraphQL) och iPaaS (tex: BizTalk, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Frends)
Modern leverans & drift: Meriterande erfarenhet av DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, IaC och observability.
Du behärskar svenska och engelska i både i tal och skrift

Vad vi tror kommer att få dig att trivas

Inspirerande arbetsmiljö med fokus på innovation, kundnöjdhet och samarbete, du arbetar med de senaste trenderna inom Cloud & Application Integration tillsammans med skickliga kollegor i ett erfaret team som levererar till både offentlig och privat sektor.
AI driven utveckling med agentiska metoder, designa skalbara lösningar i teknikens framkant.
Starkt lokalt och globalt nätverk: expertis, stöd och kunskapsutbyte i Norden såväl som internationellt.
Kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter, med tillgång till över 250 000 kurser och certifieringar samt regelbundna dialoger med din teamchef kring uppdrag, mål och utveckling.
Värderingsdriven kultur: Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Freedom, Team Spirit, Modesty och Fun.

Ansökan

Vi arbetar normalt med löpande urval, men på grund av semester under juli kan det dröja till början av augusti innan vi går igenom din ansökan. Vi återkommer så snart som möjligt därefter. Vi ser framemot din ansökan och att du vill bli en del av vår fortsatta resa!
Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,1 miljarder euro för 2024.

Define and design software architectures that meet business, functional and non-functional requirements.
Make architectural decisions covering scalability, performance, security, resilience, maintainability and accessibility
.
Translate business and technical requirements into practical, scalable software solutions.
Lead architectural discussions with product managers, project managers, developers, technical leads and other stakeholders.
Establish and promote software architecture standards, patterns and best practices.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Review designs and code to ensure solutions adhere to agreed architectural and engineering standards.
Identify technical risks, dependencies and challenges, developing appropriate mitigation strategies.
Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks and tools in line with the wider technology strategy.
Contribute to the software development roadmap and support proof-of-concept initiatives where appropriate.
Support development teams with complex technical issues and troubleshooting when required.
Mentor and coach developers and other technical team members, helping to raise engineering capability.
Ensure software development and implementation align with organisational standards and governance.
