We're looking for a strong .NET/Azure technical architect
with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex software solutions in an enterprise environment.

Essential experience

Extensive commercial experience with C#, .NET Framework and modern .NET
.
Strong practical experience designing and developing solutions on Microsoft Azure
.
Strong understanding of Azure PaaS
services and cloud development patterns.
Proven experience designing complex, scalable and maintainable software systems.
Strong knowledge of software architecture patterns, development principles and engineering best practices.
Experience with SQL Server and Entity Framework
.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and API-led integration
.
Experience with Azure DevOps
and modern software delivery practices.
Familiarity with SonarQube
and code-quality practices.
Experience considering non-functional requirements (NFRs)
including performance, security, scalability and resilience.
Awareness of accessibility standards
and their application within software solutions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and influence stakeholders at different levels.

.
Experience working within large-scale enterprise or transformation programmes.
Experience establishing or evolving software architecture standards and governance.
Experience with proof-of-concept development and technology evaluation.

This is an opportunity to join a significant technology transformation environment where you'll have genuine scope to influence architecture, shape technical direction and work on complex enterprise solutions

Operating directly within our global Product & Technology organisation, this role functions as an internal Forward Deployed Software Engineer. Rather than maintaining a traditional product lifecycle, you will partner closely with our leadership team, including the CTO, senior engineers and architects on short-cycle strategic initiatives. Your customers are Bentley's global Product & Technology (P&T) organization - the teams responsible for building and operating the products and solutions that power our customers' success.

You will take on complex, ambiguous technical challenges, rapidly evaluate solution options across the full stack, from architecture and design to hands-on implementation, build functional proof-of-concepts, and transition successful solutions to our core product teams.

Full-Spectrum Problem Solving: Fluidly navigate across varied technical domains depending on the project. One month you may be addressing deep performance profiling and cloud reliability; the next, you may be building modern front-end spikes or evaluating microservice patterns.
De-Risk Architecture: Architect, code, and benchmark functional proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to validate performance and evaluate emerging technologies before Bentley makes a company-wide commitment.
Operate Across the Stack & Cloud: Leverage a wide range of technologies, acting as a polyglot across multiple programming languages and major cloud platforms to deliver the right solution for the business.

Qualifications

Based in Oslo and working in close proximity to the customer, including regular presence on customer site, you will act as the bridge between customer stakeholders, Services, Product Management, and Engineering teams. You will ensure best-in-class and optimal technical design aligned with customer functional and non-functional requirements, while promoting the use of standard products, standard interfaces, and reference architectures.

This role is focused on post-sales delivery adoption, strategic technical leadership, and integration architecture across OT and IT environments, with particular relevance to energy systems, OT platforms, and Energy Management Systems.

Solution Architecture & Solution Evolution

Define and maintain architecture for integrations between GE Vernova solutions and customer-owned applications across OT and IT environments.
Ensure design proposals address functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, cybersecurity, maintainability, and scalability.
Promote standardization through the use of reference architectures, reference solutions, and reusable design patterns.
Evaluate the impact of changes and enhancements on the existing deployed solution landscape and surrounding systems.

Collaboration And Delivery

Work in coordination with the Services function, including Technical Leads Managers and Project Managers, to support successful implementation and adoption.
Manage the involvement of SMEs, including cybersecurity, infrastructure, domain, and integration experts, and ensure their contributions meet system architecture requirements.
Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineering teams on return on experience, product enhancements, and continuous improvement.

Previous experience as Solution Architect. Technical Architect or similar role in a comparable domain
Strong experience with critical systems having demanding requirements in terms of 24/7 availability.
Experience in energy systems, OT environments, or Energy Management Systems.
Strong understanding of integration architectures spanning OT and IT environments.
Cloud architecture experience (AWS and/or Azure) and experience with cloud-native technologies such as containers and Kubernetes.
Strong understanding of microservices design principles, including RESTful services and API development.

Professional English level.

Energy sector / Electric utility Industry domain knowledge,

Strong customer engagement and stakeholder management skills.
Business-oriented mindset with strong technical literacy.

jobs.title: Bli med å kvalitetssikre samfunnskritiske IT-løsninger med Quality Engineering, Test og Testledelse
jobs.description:
Accenture søker erfarne og dedikerte testere som vil være med å videreutvikle vårt fagmiljø innen Quality Engineering. Du blir en del av et sterkt og erfarent team på ca. 30 personer – som sammen jobber med å kvalitetssikre noen av de mest komplekse og samfunnsviktige IT-løsningene i Norge.

I våre prosjekter jobber vi med helhetlig og kontinuerlig testing og kvalitetssikring av komplekse og samfunnskritiske IT-løsninger. I denne rollen får du utfordret deg på et bredt spekter av ferdigheter innen fagområdet Quality Engineering og Testing, inkludert bruk av Kunstig Intelligens i testrollen.

Høres dette spennende ut? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er en kreativ og erfaren tester, med interesse for å koordinere testaktiviteter på tvers av team. Du synes det er givende å jobbe med samfunnskritiske systemer og du omfavner DevOps som tilrettelegger for effektiv testing og raske leveranser. Du har erfaring med API-drevet testing og du har et stort engasjement for automatisering. Du er initiativrik og har et detaljert øye for helheten i et prosjekt. Du er en person som er interessert i kontinuerlig læring og utvikling og trives i å sette deg inn i nye og komplekse funksjonelle og tekniske problemstillinger.

I tillegg er du løsningsorientert, nysgjerrig og liker å sette deg inn i nye problemstillinger der du deler av din kunnskap. Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner og trives i tverrfaglige team der du bygger bro mellom teknologi og forretning. Du liker å jobbe i team, samtidig som du liker å jobbe selvstendig med krevende arbeidsoppgaver hos våre kunder.

Du vil ha innflytelse på arbeidshverdagen og det du ønsker å jobbe med. Hos oss sitter du i førersetet for din fremtidige teknologikarriere, enten av om du ønsker å bli en ekspert innen et område, eller en leder med bredere faglig- og teknologibakgrunn. Accenture er en karriereskole der du coacher andre, og der du selv blir coachet.

Oppsummert, vi ser etter deg som:  

Har minimum tre års utdannelse som Bachelor

3+ års erfaring med test og kvalitetssikring som tester i team i smidige prosjekter

Erfaring med testadminstasjonsverktøy som Jira og Confluence eller lignende verktøy for oppgavestyring og testadministrasjon

Har vært utførende på test av GUI, funksjonell test av brukergrensesnittet, backend-testing, test av funksjoner og forretningslogikk

Har kjennskap eller erfaring med ett eller flere av følgende verktøy: Bruno, SoapUI, Postman, JMeter, Selenium, Playwright, SQL og databaseverktøy, Camunda, Kafka, Splunk

Har erfaring med testing på strømmende data og Kafka

Kjennskap til kunstig intelligens og prompt engineering

ISTQB Foundation sertifisering (eller planer om å ta den)

Flytende norsk muntlig og skriftlig (tilsvarende C1 eller bedre)

Hvem er vi? 

I tillegg til prosjektarbeid jobber vi i fagmiljøet med de nyeste innovative løsninger innen Quality Engineering. Vi organiserer workshops internt og for kunder, deltar og presenterer på konferanser, holder gjesteforelesninger på høgskoler og universiteter samt støtter salgsaktiviteter. Utover fagmiljøet har vi goder som firmahytter, sosiale grupper av mange slag, årlige fester og sosiale samlinger. Det er viktig for oss å trives på jobb!

Vi dyrker både fag og fellesskap, og hos oss får du støtte til å utvikle deg videre – enten du vil fordype deg som teknolog, eller gå en ledervei.

"Det mest givende med jobben min er kombinasjonen av teknisk utvikling og reell samfunnsinnvirkning. Vi jobber med nye teknologistakker, automatisering og AI – og bidrar samtidig til tryggere tjenester for folk flest."

— Shiladitya, systemtestleder i Accenture

Stillingen rapporterer til leder for Quality Engineering Norge. Arbeidssted: Oslo - med fleksible løsninger.

Høres dette interessant ut?

Send inn din CV og kort søknadsbrev så snart som mulig. Vi vurderer søkere fortløpende.

jobs.title: Software Developer (Application development)
jobs.description:
NAPA Design Solutions offers a comprehensive solution for 3D ship modeling and design tools covering hull form design and hydrodynamics, hydrostatics and stability, structural design, and information sharing across the shipbuilding process. These are among the most powerful tools in the industry, trusted by the world's largest shipyards and classification societies.

The role: what is it about?

The team is now looking for a Software Developer who will focus on application usability development with .NET, C#, WPF and XAML. Development, testing, and maintenance of the NAPA ship design solutions are part of your daily work. In this role you will mainly work on developing NAPA Engineer, a modern design and computing platform for naval architects. It combines trusted NAPA calculation capabilities with a redesigned, intuitive user experience and a powerful visual approach to engineering workflows. You can read more about the solution at: https://www.napa.fi/software-and-services/ship-design/software/napa-engineer/

You will do this work with artificial intelligence (AI) as a normal part of your toolchain. We use agentic coding capability across our development teams, which means using AI coding agents to plan, write, test, review and refactor code, and doing it in a way that improves both delivery speed and code quality. We expect you to use these tools in your daily work, to help us learn where they work well and where they do not, and to share those learnings with your team.

You will be working with Windows desktop applications, native libraries, third-party components, including a 3D graphics library, database engines, a licensing solution, and more
.

This job is permanent and full-time
.

Your team and job location

You will work in an international team where your closest colleagues are experienced software developers and naval architectural domain experts who will support you in your role. You will also interact with local and global colleagues
from various teams in software development, UX design, DevOps, and sales. Together with them you will also shape how we use AI coding agents in practice, from tooling choices to review practices.

Our office is located in Helsinki (Ruoholahti), and you can work at the office or in hybrid mode
. We hope to meet you at our Helsinki office regularly.

What are we looking for?

What matters most: you're curious about UI development, energized by AI-assisted development tools, and hungry to solve real problems as a self-starter
. If the visual side of UI excites you too, that's a big plus.

Our Ideal Candidate Would Have

Academic degree in a relevant field such as computer science, mathematics, physics, naval architecture, or engineering
Completed basic studies and/or having a good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and OOP (object-oriented programming)
2+ years of experience in building native Windows desktop applications
Experience in UI design
Experience using WPF, C#, and XAML
Understanding of user experience and the ability to apply it in your own design work
Hands-on experience of using AI coding assistants or coding agents in real development work, together with the judgment to review, test and take responsibility for what they produce
Interest in NAPA’s domain (maritime business)

Additionally, The Following Skills Would Be Considered An Advantage

Experience with agentic coding workflows
Knowledge or studies in usability
Experience with database solutions
Experience in automated testing methods
Knowledge of software reliability and maintainability
Experience in CAD or CAE applications

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English
across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

You get to combine modern desktop application development on a next-generation engineering platform, combined with AI agentic development that we are scaling across the company
The design work of the world's largest shipyards and classification societies happens in the software you develop
Great colleagues with expertise in, for example, naval architecture, software development and UX design
A global team of 230 experts who support you and share what they know
When you join NAPA, you will be assigned an onboarding buddy who will help ensure a smooth start and introduce you to the NAPA way of working

Ready to get on board and join the napa crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the "Apply for this job" button on the job ad page), but no later than 11 October 2026
. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, please send your questions by e-mail to jobs@napa.fi. Notice that we cannot accept job applications sent by e-mail.

NAPA as a company and as an employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 230 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

With over 90% of new vessels built by NAPA customers, NAPA’s ship design software is the global de facto standard in shipbuilding. Furthermore, NAPA is a market leader in ship stability management and safety data services for passenger ships, and its cloud-based solutions for ship performance monitoring and voyage optimization support shipping’s decarbonization journey. For more information, visit www.napa.fi .

Meaningful work

We are proud to play our part in creating a sustainable world, and a career at NAPA means working with a purpose. We focus on building the best possible products for our customers, with whom we have close and long-lasting relationships. We protect the environment and human life at sea by powering safer and greener vessels with our technology.

NAPA way of working

At NAPA, we lead and manage the company together. We help and learn from each other, while making impactful decisions for a cleaner, safer maritime industry.

At its heart, our co-leadership philosophy is founded on trust. We trust that our people are smart enough that if they make a decision, having consulted the right people, it will be good for our company. And if it's not the right decision on that occasion, that's fine too. We trust that we'll make it right, learn from the decision, and grow as a company as a result.

Enjoy working together

is one of our core values. Learning from and respecting each other provides a healthy and pleasant working environment. We, as NAPArians, share our knowledge and help each other when needed. NAPA has offices and customers around the world, and you will be able to meet people from many different cultures. We are a diverse team with a shared goal.

Read more about our values and culture: https://www.napa.fi/careers/

Read more about NAPA: https://www.napa.fi/

jobs.description:
Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help modernize a product area at the heart of construction projects.

Dalux is growing, and we are looking for an experienced software developer to join our team called "Tender".

You will work on software that supports the bidding process for construction projects and is tightly integrated with the wider Dalux platform. It is a domain where reliability, data security, and good technical design matter – and where there is plenty of opportunity to influence how the product and architecture evolve.

You will also have the opportunity to influence how we increasingly use AI to make software development more effective.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will join a full-stack development team working closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Within Tender, there is a particular focus on strengthening and evolving the technical foundation of the product while continuing to deliver new functionality.

Your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and the technical direction of the team
Improving the structure of an established codebase and reducing technical debt
Helping evolve boundaries and modularity within the application
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas, technologies, and development practices into the team when they create real value

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

The Tender team is already experimenting with how these tools can improve its day-to-day development work.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in that development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue evolving your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Tender is a full-stack product area primarily built with:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
MSSQL
Elasticsearch

Our wider platform runs on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

What would make you a particularly strong match?

We are looking for an experienced software developer with strong technical fundamentals and the ability to influence the software around you.

For this particular team, we would especially value:

Strong professional experience with C# and .NET
Experience improving or modernizing established software systems
An understanding of Domain-Driven Design, modular architecture, or similar approaches to structuring complex applications
Experience mentoring or providing technical sparring to other developers
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

You do not need to match every point.

Technical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to make an established product better are more important than having worked with exactly the same technologies or architectural patterns before.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussions
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to improve an established product and architecture
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Interested?

If you are looking for a role where you can remain hands-on while gaining greater technical influence and helping evolve an established product and architecture, we would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact IT Talent Acquisition Specialist Sara at sni@dalux.com.

We host hackathons to explore new tech, ideas and tools, and our internal developer forums are open spaces for discussing architecture, new technologies, and tough engineering challenges. Whether building or learning, there's always room to experiment and grow.

Let's dive into your key responsibilities. You will:

Work in a dynamic and international environment with experienced and skilled colleagues
Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable solutions across backend, web frontend, and mobile, using engineering best practices and design patterns.
Drive a culture of “you build it – you own it” mentality
Identify and act on areas for your own personal development
Mentor and coach co-workers on topics that you master.

What you’ll need

We’re looking for a pragmatic generalist with a strong backend foundation. You should be confident working with .NET and C#.

Strong hands-on experience building backend services with .NET and C#
Sound knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience working with databases
The ability to troubleshoot problems and take ownership of software in production
A collaborative and adaptable mindset, with a focus on shared ownership and continuous improvement
Good communication skills and fluency in business English

You do not need to be an expert in every part of our stack. We use agentic development to help engineers work effectively across technical boundaries. Sound engineering judgement, code reviews, and testing remain essential.

Nice to have

We’d also value experience in some of the following areas, but we do not expect you to bring all of them:

Feeling comfortable contributing to web frontend and, when needed, React Native development
Distributed systems and event-driven architecture
Vue 3 and TypeScript; we are currently transitioning from Webpack to Vite
React Native and TypeScript
AWS or another cloud provider, particularly containerization or serverless computing
Designing and working with RESTful APIs

We’re eager to hear from you. If the role sounds like a good match, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every nice-to-have. Curiosity, sound engineering judgement, and the willingness to learn matter more to us than matching every part of the stack.

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

In August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

Senior Backend Specialist

Location:

Aarhus C, DK, 8000

Category: IT

Job Type: Headquarter

Vil du være med til at forme fundamentet under Søstrene Grenes digitale fremtid?

Vi søger en erfaren backend-udvikler, der har lyst til at kombinere hands-on udvikling med teknisk lederskab. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores digitale udviklingsrejse og får mulighed for gradvist at tage det tekniske ansvar for backenden bag vores digitale univers.

Om jobbet

I dag er vores platform primært bygget på Umbraco og .NET og understøtter både sostrenegrene.com, vores indhold og en stadig større del af forretningen. Samtidig står vi foran en spændende transformation, hvor vi ønsker at bevæge os mod en mere moderne og skalerbar arkitektur med tydelige domænegrænser og stærke integrationer.

Som Senior Backend Specialist bliver du med til både at definere retningen og realisere den. Rollen kombinerer arkitektur, udvikling og teknisk sparring med interne og eksterne udviklere. Du refererer til vores E-commerce Technology Manager og samarbejder tæt med vores Senior Frontend Specialist, samtidig med at du har en tæt dialog med forretningen om de behov, vores løsninger skal understøtte.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at

Være med til at forme og implementere vores fremtidige backend-arkitektur
Kortlægge og udvikle centrale domæner og services i vores platform
Modernisere og videreudvikle integrationer til forretningskritiske systemer
Sikre en stabil, performant og fremtidssikret platform
Etablere gode standarder for kvalitet, test, deployment og dokumentation
Coache, sparre med og understøtte udviklere i teamet
Bidrage aktivt med kode og tekniske beslutninger i hverdagen

Vi tror på, at holdbare tekniske løsninger skabes gennem godt håndværk, samarbejde og velovervejede skridt fremad. Derfor arbejder vi langsigtet og med fokus på kvalitet frem for hurtige genveje.

Om dig

Du har solid erfaring som senior .NET-udvikler og har arbejdet indgående med Umbraco. Du kender platformens styrker og muligheder, men også dens begrænsninger, og du trives med at finde løsninger, der skaber værdi både teknisk og forretningsmæssigt.

Du interesserer dig for arkitektur og systemdesign og har erfaring med komplekse løsninger. Samtidig ved du, at god arkitektur ikke handler om at følge de nyeste trends, men om at skabe den rette løsning til den virkelighed, den skal fungere i.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har flere års erfaring med .NET og gerne Umbraco
Har arbejdet med arkitektur, integrationer og skalerbare løsninger
Har erfaring med at sætte teknisk retning, formelt eller uformelt
Motiveres af at sparre med og udvikle andre mennesker
Tager ansvar, når udfordringer opstår, og deler succesen, når målene nås
Kan kommunikere komplekse tekniske valg til både udviklere, projektledere og forretningsinteressenter
Arbejder struktureret og kommunikerer klart, både mundtligt og skriftligt
Ser AI-værktøjer som en naturlig del af moderne softwareudvikling og er nysgerrig på, hvordan de kan skabe reel værdi i hverdagen

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er mindre vigtig for os. Måske er du datalog, måske har du fundet en anden vej ind i faget. Det vigtigste er din faglighed, din nysgerrighed og din evne til at omsætte idéer til løsninger sammen med andre. Vi forventer ikke, at du har alle svar fra første dag, men vi håber, at du har lyst til at udforske dem sammen med os.

Om Søstrene Grenes Ånd

Hos Søstrene Grene stræber vi efter at røre folks hjerter gennem et unikt univers, der omfavner mangfoldighed og inklusion og skaber et imødekommende fællesskab for alle uanset køn, etnicitet, religion, handicap eller baggrund.

Vi har en arbejdsplads, hvor alle bliver kaldt "Søster" uanset køn. Vi deler glæder, gør hinanden stærkere og griner sammen. Dét kalder vi Søsterånd, og vi opfordrer på det varmeste alle til at søge og være med til at skabe en levende og rummelig arbejdsplads.

Der er mange gode grunde til at vælge Søstrene Grene

Hos os får du en attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring og vi prioriterer det, der gør en forskel i hverdagen og skaber trivsel.

En vigtig del af den trivsel handler om fællesskab. Vi værner om det kollegiale sammenhold, som dyrkes både i de enkelte teams og på tværs af landegrænser og funktioner. Derudover har vi en aktiv personaleforening, som arrangerer alt fra fredagsbar og foredrag til sportsaktiviteter.

I vores nye, lyse lokaler midt i Aarhus kan du glæde dig til friskbrygget kaffe fra espressomaskinen og en af Danmarks bedste frokostordninger. Og fordi balance er vigtig, tilbyder vi fleksible rammer og mulighed for hjemmearbejde, så arbejde og privatliv kan gå op i en højere enhed.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Åboulevarden 21, 8000 Aarhus C

Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen

Start: Hurtigst muligt

Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt. Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingen, når vi har den rette kandidat.

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!   

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading! 

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will become part of the Valuation & Market Data product area within SimCorp's Product Division, responsible for delivering functionality that enables clients to make investment decisions with our back-office applications.  

The Valuation & Market Data product area consists of four teams spread across several geographical locations.  

You will contribute across all stages of  the development lifecycle
, including creating and defining user stories, designing, coding, testing, writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and providing customer support. Someone who belief that quality is a shared responsibility and willingness to participate in activities such as test design, test automation, exploratory testing, and defect analysis.

The ideal candidate should have  C# expertise
, a passion for delivering high-quality, scalable software, and an eagerness to learn  APL
 (A Programming Language).

Prior experience with APL isn’t required—we provide comprehensive training and a supportive environment to help you succeed. While  most development in this area is done in APL
. Our company also partly owns Dyalog APL, ensuring the language remains actively maintained and relevant. 

From time to time, teams may require additional support in quality assurance activities. Therefore, we

are looking for someone who is eager to broaden their skills beyond software development and grow

their knowledge of business domains, quality assurance, testing strategies, and test automation. You

should expect to contribute to testing and quality assurance activities when needed, as quality is a

shared responsibility across the team.

What You Will Be Responsible For   

You will be using multiple technologies, and your responsibilities will also include:  

Working with a team of software engineers in the design, development, and maintenance of software applications and sometimes even manual testing. 
Design and implement robust and efficient solutions using programming languages like primarily APL also sometimes in C#.

Maintaining the existing code base 
Constantly learning and developing yourself and our product 

What We Are Looking For 

We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest. 

1–8 years of experience in software development, with a passion for building high-quality software solutions.
Good working knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework, and object-oriented design principles.  
Interest in developing testing and quality assurance skills, with a willingness to contribute across both development and testing activities when needed.

Genuine willingness to learn and to dig into unknown areas  
A commitment to constantly deliver value to the clients, to improve yourself and the team  
You are interested and able to work with complex architecture 
Understanding Agile practices, values and principles allow you to better understand how we work  
Strong communication and collaboration skills 

What We Value 

Are motivated to work within the financial domain  
Are willing to acquire other technical and programming skills  
Consistently learn through experimentation when addressing the latest problems, using experiences from both accomplishments and setbacks 
Can introduce new ways of looking at problems and that you can take creative ideas and put them into practice  
Are able to work in a hybrid setup (virtual and physical work environments)  
We embrace AI in our everyday work. From GitHub Copilot to emerging tools, we encourage our Engineers to innovate and use AI to work smarter and build better products. 
Eager to broaden your skills beyond software development and grow into business areas as quality assurance, testing strategies, and test automation.

Benefits   

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.  
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.  
Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.  
Inclusive and diverse company culture  
Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace  
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes  

NEXT STEPS 

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.   In case you have questions, please approach Senior Engineering Manager Asif Nadeem Anjum,
through Asif.N.Anjum@SimCorp.com /Engineering Manager Anna Koprowicz-Boukoffa
, through Anna.Koprowicz-Boukoffa@SimCorp.com.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.     

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.  

Who We Are  

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.    

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.   

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. Job Description

Who we are

Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative but work well within a team.

Job Summary

The AI Architect is the technical authority responsible for designing secure, scalable and cost-efficient AI architectures for APAC deployments. The role defines technical standards, patterns and guardrails across models, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure and security layers, ensuring solutions align with global governance while meeting APAC data sovereignty and regulatory requirements. The role provides technical direction to the team, supporting the design, build, maintenance and continuous improvement of advanced AI and automation solutions. You will design and maintain the architecture for the AI enabled Marine Ground Digital Twin Platform.

This is a 3-year fixed term contract for placement in Singapore, and only open to SG/PR candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Design & Standards

Design scalable, secure and cost-efficient AI system architectures for regional deployments.
Define and enforce technical standards, design patterns and architectural guardrails for the team.
Lead build vs buy vs integrate decisions, evaluating platforms and vendors.
Produce architecture artefacts (solution designs, data flows, integration maps, technical roadmaps).

Cloud & Infrastructure

Architect solutions across relevant cloud platforms (Azure, AWS and compliant options as required).
Design for multi-cloud and hybrid environments where regulations demand.
Ensure infrastructure meets data sovereignty requirements across APAC countries.
Review cloud cost architecture to balance performance and spend.
Ensure AI development and deployment environments are designed for reliability, reproducibility, access control and operational support.

AI Platform & Model Strategy

Designs and governs AI and machine learning environments, including patterns for experimentation, deployment, monitoring and operational support.
Evaluate and select foundational models, fine-tuning approaches and RAG architectures appropriate to each use case.
Design MLOps and LLMOps pipelines (model versioning, evaluation, monitoring, retraining triggers).
Define the regional AI platform strategy (shared services, reusable components, integration patterns).
Stay current on model developments and assess architectural implications for the roadmap.

Security & Governance

Embed security controls (encryption, access controls, audit logging) into all architectural decisions.
Align architecture to global governance standards and partner with security and risk stakeholders.
Conduct technical risk assessments for new AI initiatives and define mitigation architecture.

Requirements

Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Data/AI, or equivalent experience)
Working experience 8+ years - Experience in solution, software, data or enterprise architecture
Experience using data platforms, data lakes, lakehouses, or data warehouses to discover, analyse, and prepare governed datasets for advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases.
Proficiency in SQL and Python for data access, analysis, and preparation.
Ability to work effectively with large datasets, apply data quality and governance standards, and collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Understanding of security-by-design, privacy-by-design, data governance, and access control

Nice-to-have

Understanding of AI solution patterns; RAG, model integration, agentic workflows, and secure enterprise deployment
Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure data services or comparable lakehouse/data platforms
MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management or AI evaluation frameworks
API design, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code
Vector databases, semantic search, fine-tuning or generative AI evaluation
Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry or related Microsoft AI service
Relevant certifications in Azure, AI, Databricks, or AWS
Management experience 2+ years - Experience providing technical leadership in collaborative or agile delivery environments, including guiding team members on solution design, engineering standards, maintainability and delivery quality.
AI & IT expertise - Proven experience sponsoring AI & IT initiatives, data driven platforms, IT transformation, and automation at scale.
Other experience - Strong business acumen, financial management, risk governance, and experience operating in APAC multicultural environments.

Please include your latest resume in the application.
We regret to inform this position is open only to SG/PR

Vei colabora cu echipa pentru a livra funcționalități în producție

Vei folosi AI în workflow-ul tău pentru a crește viteza și calitatea

Experiență cu backend (ideal .NET Core, dar nu obligatoriu);

Capacitatea de a lucra pe probleme care nu sunt complet definite;
Interes pentru produs și modul în care este folosit de utilizatori;

Modul În Care Lucrăm Este Influențat De Valorile În Care Credem Și Pe Care Ne Propunem Să Le Aplicăm În Tot Ce Facem

Bitdefender

Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com

About The Job

The Dynamics 365 Developer will be part of Business Systems, Integration & Data team that uses problem-solving skills to design, implement, and support accounting and finance solutions in Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Finance and Operations. This role will be responsible for working with our Business Analyst and Functional consultants, to convert functional requirements into software solution using both out-of-the-box features as well as custom .NET/C# and X++ modules in D365. The Developer will spend most their time executing tasks related to delivery of customized features within the application, financial report creation, data synchronization from D365 to internal systems, and potential application integrations using various Azure application services (web services, restAPI) and Azure Integration services (API, logic apps, service bus). The position requires familiarity with D365 F&O software development and azure cloud and sql db.

What You'll Do

Work with Functional consultant/or Business Analyst to understand the requirement, provide rough estimate and propose high-level design to define optimal solutions (custom vs. default functionality).
Assist and provide input in planning, and scheduling application development.
Create and maintain technical documentation.
Develop custom application components in D365 Finance and Operations using .NET and X++
Develop financial reports.
Monitor performance of different environments and analyze statistics to identify and resolve system problems.
Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize jobs scheduling & execution.
Work at the integrations and provide support for the Dynamics integrations with other internal or external applications.
Cross-train other development staff on Dynamics technical subjects.
As a technical member, understanding business processes and contributing to solutions for corporate ERP users in becoming more efficient and effective in using Dynamics FO and associated applications.

What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is required;
4+ years of hands-on development in Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations;
Experience working in git, Visual Studio using X++, C# and .NET;
Strong experience developing code (X++, C#, SQL, XML, Web Services);
SQL Server with a good understanding of the Dynamics 365 data structures;
Experience with SSIS, SSRS;
Experience with ERP processes is a plus;
Ability to translate experience to creatively solve client business, process, and application issues;
Organizational skills, attention to quality, self-motivation, and a desire to succeed;
Good communication skills both in Romanian and English, team player, time management and self-learning skills.

What We Offer

Friendly and professional working environment;
A chance to join global company;
Flextime;
Working with cloud technology.

development

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Bitdefender is a cybersecurity leader delivering best-in-class threat prevention, detection, and response solutions worldwide. Guardian over millions of consumer, enterprise, and government environments, Bitdefender is one of the industry’s most trusted experts for eliminating threats, protecting privacy, digital identity and data, and enabling cyber resilience. With deep investments in research and development, Bitdefender Labs discovers hundreds of new threats each minute and validates billions of threat queries daily. The company has pioneered breakthrough innovations in antimalware, IoT security, behavioral analytics, and artificial intelligence and its technology is licensed by more than 180 of the world’s most recognized technology brands. Founded in 2001, Bitdefender has customers in 170+ countries with offices around the world. For more information, visit https://www.bitdefender.com

About The Role

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Senior Software Engineer to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) Automation Engineering team. This position offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge security automation projects while contributing to the development and maintenance of our MDR product, particularly for our Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) platform.

Responsibilities

Software Development: Build and maintain software solutions and workflows using Python within our SOAR platform to streamline security operations.
Infrastructure Development: Develop, deploy and manage infrastructure components across multiple Cloud environments (e.g. AWS, GCP etc.)
Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Monitor SOC automation processes and troubleshoot issues, ensuring timely resolution to maintain operational efficiency.
Collaboration: Work closely with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, implement solutions, and support ongoing projects.
Security and Compliance: Collaborate with the InfoSec team to address security vulnerabilities, manage access controls, and ensure compliance with SOC2 change management processes.
Documentation: Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, including standard operating procedures and troubleshooting guides.
Continuous Learning: Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in automation, cloud services, and cybersecurity to enhance skill sets and contribute to team innovation.
On-Call Support: Participate in a rotational on-call schedule to address high-priority incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to services.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (5+ years of experience as a Software Development Engineer).

Technical Skills

Proficiency in at least one Object Oriented Programming Languages and good knowledge of Design Patterns and System Design (e.g. Python, Java, C#)
Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
Experience with working with containers and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes etc.)
Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts; exposure to tools like Terraform is a plus.
Knowledge of version control systems, such as Git.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with containerization and orchestration tools, particularly Kubernetes.
Exposure to monitoring and logging tools, such as Prometheus or Grafana.
Understanding of security operations and incident response processes.

Nice To Have

Experience with SOARs and/or SIEMs
Experience with SOC2 compliance and security best practices.
Knowledge of MongoDB and PostgreSQL.
Experience with AI/ML tools and integrating LLMs into operational workflows.

Regular

1. Présentation de l’ETNIC

L’ETNIC (Entreprise pour les Technologies de l’Information et de la Communication) est l’opérateur informatique de la Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles. Organisme d’intérêt public, l’ETNIC a pour mission de concevoir, développer, maintenir et faire évoluer les systèmes d’information et les infrastructures technologiques au service des administrations et établissements de la FWB.

Acteur central de la transformation numérique du secteur public francophone belge, l’ETNIC intervient dans des domaines variés tels que :

La gestion des infrastructures IT (réseaux, sécurité, data centers, cloud),
Le développement d’applications métiers sur mesure,
L’accompagnement des projets digitaux (analyse fonctionnelle, UX/UI, gestion de projet),
La cybersécurité et la protection des données,
Le support utilisateurs et la formation.

Dans un souci constant d’innovation, de performance et de service public, l’ETNIC collabore régulièrement avec des partenaires externes pour renforcer ses équipes à travers des missions de consultance IT. Ces collaborations s’inscrivent dans un cadre éthique, professionnel et orienté vers la qualité et l’impact concret des solutions livrées

2. Mission

Dans le cadre du programme ZEPHYR de l’Office de la Naissance et de l’Enfance (ONE)
, la mission d’Application Architect / Leader Technique couvre de nombreux aspects tels que l’élaboration de propositions d'architecture applicative, le développement, l'expertise technique, l'identification de solutions pour l’implémentation de systèmes complexes.

En tant qu’Application Architect / Leader technique, vous êtes responsable de l’implémentation de la solution, de la qualité du code et de la cohérence technique, des performances et des livraisons du produit. En tant que responsable du développement des applications, vous travaillez en collaboration avec les analystes fonctionnels et métiers, les testeurs, le chef de projet et les spécialistes du middleware afin de mener à bien les implémentations. Vous êtes responsable de la qualité du livrable et de la diffusion des bonnes pratiques en matière de design et de développement.

Les projets du programme ZEPHYR :

DOMES V2

Ce projet s’inscrit dans le domaine de l’accompagnement des enfants de 0 à 6 ans. Il vise à permettre aux professionnels de l’ONE de gérer le dossier de l’enfant, de l’éditer, de créer des consultations et de planifier les rendez-vous dans l’Agenda en lien avec le suivi de l’enfant.

Prénatal V1

Dans le cadre de l’accueil et du suivi médico-social de la future mère, Prénatal V1
vise à digitaliser le dossier social de la future mère
. La solution permet de soutenir les professionnels de l’ONE dans le suivi et l’accompagnement social des futures mères, tout au long de leur parcours au sein des services concernés.

e-VAX 2.0

Le projet e-VAX 2.0 vise à remplacer l’actuelle solution e-VAX CCR et à moderniser la gestion des données de vaccination. Il permettra notamment d’améliorer la collecte et l’échange des données vaccinales, de mettre en place une carte de vaccination transversale
et de renforcer le suivi de la chaîne d’approvisionnement des vaccins. La solution contribuera également au pilotage du programme de vaccination grâce à l’exploitation des données et à des fonctionnalités d’aide à la décision.

La mission s’inscrit dans un environnement Agile / SCRUM, avec une architecture orientée services et un environnement technique principalement basé sur Java et Angular.

Le stack technologique repose sur : Angular 21, JAVA8 / JEE7, Java 21, Sprint Boot, NgRx, DB2, MySQL, Flyway, …

Les outils de build sont : Apache Maven, Git/GitLab CI/CD, Nexus.

Conception

Créer et mettre à jour le document d’architecture logicielle.
Elaborer la conception et l’analyse technique sur base du dossier fonctionnel.
Elaborer et faire appliquer les bonnes pratiques de développement : clean code, principes SOLID, DRY, ….

Optimiser le code en fonction de la gestion mémoire et des temps réponse.

Qualité

We are looking for a Data & AI Architect
who will own the technical design and delivery of customer technology solutions for our clients. You will work across CMS, CDP, commerce, CRM and AI, and work hands-on with delivery teams to bring it all to production.

In this key role, you will:

Design end-to-end solution architectures across customer technology landscapes, connecting content platforms, customer data, commerce systems and AI capabilities into scalable solutions

Your Job

You are responsible for the technical vision and architecture of customer technology solutions across client engagements. You connect content management, customer data platforms, commerce, CRM and AI into working enterprise solutions, and you stay close to delivery to make sure what gets built matches what was designed.

You work hands-on with delivery teams: reviewing designs, unblocking technical challenges, validating integration approaches and making sure non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability) are covered. The team comes to you when architecture gets complex, whether that’s a multi-platform CMS migration, a CDP integration with downstream activation channels, a Salesforce Agentforce implementation, or an AI-powered service automation.

You work with client stakeholders (IT leads, product owners, enterprise architects) to align solutions with their technology landscape and business priorities. You evaluate and recommend platforms, design integration patterns across vendors, and present options with trade-offs: what’s technically sound, what’s practical to build and maintain, and what delivers the most value.

You bring AI and data capabilities into the customer technology domain. Think generative AI applied to content and personalisation, agentic patterns for customer service, and data-driven automation across commerce and CRM.

You also contribute to Accenture Song’s practice by capturing reusable architecture patterns and sharing learnings across teams. You work with Accenture’s technology partnerships (Adobe, Salesforce, SAP, Sprinklr, Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud) to bring the right capabilities to each engagement.

Your Team

Accenture Song is an incredible place to work where you can keep learning. By joining us, you’ll become part of a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Besides the work we do for our clients, we’re proud of our vibrant, diverse workplace culture: we believe in openness and honesty, fairness and equality, common sense and realism. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or equivalent experience

jobs.description:
Equal Plus Consulting has been engaged to search for a Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer to work hybrid 60% on-site in Belgium or Czech Republic.

TITLE Senior Cloud Center of Excellence Azure Platform Engineer (Belgium)
START DATE 5 Oct 2026
END DATE 5 Mar 2027
LOCATION Kontich, Belgium or Czech Republic
LANGUAGES English
hybrid 60% on-site in

About the Role
The Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) is responsible for the design, governance and scaling of Azure and self-service platform.

We are looking for a senior engineer to help clean up the technical depth — from landing zone architecture to Terraform Enterprise module engineering, networking design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.

Current Situation
The Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That
growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.

We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and
infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.

To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the
teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Act as second-line escalation for Azure platform issues (RBAC, DNS, VNET/Private Endpoint connectivity, AD integration, Terraform Enterprise
runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom
modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based
access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise
Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.
Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For
4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.
Personal Characteristics
Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely.

jobs.title: Bioinformatics Engineer
jobs.description:
Scientific Manager – Machine Learning Engineering (Computational Biology)

Ghent, Belgium (hybrid)

Who are we?

Excelra is a leader in biopharma data and analytics, that uniquely blends scientific understanding with technological expertise. This dual mastery empowers innovative drug discovery and development, transforming research data into actionable insights for groundbreaking discovery.

We have global locations in Ghent (Belgium), London (UK), Utrecht (The Netherlands), Boston/SFO (US) and Hyderabad (India).

www.excelra.com

About the role

We are hiring a Scientific Manager to take ownership of the machine learning and experimental design pipelines behind our customer’s genomic target prediction work. Much of this currently lives in individual scripts maintained by individual scientists. Your job is to turn it into an automated, version-controlled and reproducible platform the whole team can rely on – and to keep it scientifically sound by working shoulder to shoulder with our customer’s wet-lab and computational biology colleagues.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a scientific environment. You will spend more of your time building, automating and hardening pipelines than running individual analyses, so we are looking for someone who is as comfortable with Git, containers and workflow managers as with genomics data.

What will you do?

Automate and professionalize internal ML and experimental design pipelines for genomic target prediction.
Migrate existing scripts and notebooks into a production-ready, version-controlled codebase.
Reduce the manual input required for dataset preparation, settings configuration and pipeline execution.
Integrate pipelines into existing digital infrastructure, including AWS and HPC environments.
Implement version control, testing and reproducibility standards across ML workflows, and help the team adopt them.
Collaborate closely with wet-lab and computational biology colleagues to make sure pipelines meet real scientific requirements.
Run several projects in parallel, (re)assigning tasks as priorities shift, and present results concisely to stakeholders inside and outside your domain.

What do you bring?

A PhD in bioscience engineering, bioinformatics, computer science or machine learning engineering – or an MSc with 5+ years of equivalent experience. You can demonstrate this through peer-reviewed publications, contributions to public code repositories or relevant project work.
Strong Python, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can read, test and re-run.
Proven experience taking analysis code into production: version control with Git, code review, packaging, containerization (Docker, Singularity/Apptainer) and automated testing or CI/CD.
Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration – Nextflow, Snakemake or equivalent.
Experience running workloads on cloud infrastructure (AWS) and/or HPC clusters (e.g. SLURM).
Solid grounding in statistical modelling and machine learning applied to biological data, including model evaluation and experiment tracking.
The ability to translate between engineering and bench science, and to work with scientists who are not engineers.
You are eligible to live and work in Belgium.

Nice to have

Experience with genomics and transcriptomics data (RNAseq, single-cell, spatial, WES/WGS, …).
R alongside Python.
Experiment tracking and model registry tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases) or infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Experience in a client-facing, consulting or CRO setting.

Who are you?

You enjoy project-based work and have a strong analytical mindset.
You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment with people of diverse professional backgrounds (IT, (molecular) biology, genomics, engineering, etc.).
You are communicative and customer focused.
You are fluent in English, both written and verbally.
You take initiative and have an eye for new opportunities.

What do we offer?

A challenging job environment with advancement opportunities.
Flexible hybrid working in an international (global) setting: largely home-based, with the option to work alongside colleagues in our Ghent office and occasional visits to our customers on site.
A dynamic company with an open culture, easy communication and an ambitious vision.
A rich & global team with a mix of backgrounds, experiences and expertise.
Independence and flexibility.
An attractive salary package with extra-legal benefits.

Interested?

Please send your resume and motivation letter to Helen De Block, HR Director: helen.deblock@excelra.com

jobs.title: Senior .NET Backend Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Funstage, our players come first. The Backend team creates the technology behind our social casino games, from bonus engines and progression systems to leaderboards, battle passes and real-time gameplay that keep players coming back for another round.

As a Senior .NET Backend Developer, this is a chance to turn great game ideas into reality, tackle exciting challenges at scale, and see your work make a real difference to the player experience. From idea to production, there’s plenty of room to shape how things are built, bring fresh ideas to the table, and have fun solving tricky technical problems along the way.

Your tasks

Analyse

Turn technical discussions and stakeholder feedback, including insights from Customer Support and CRM, into clear, actionable requirements and practical solutions
Explore, evaluate, and manage libraries and tools that help the team choose the right solution for each project

Develop

Design and build optimised distributed backend systems and real-time gaming features capable of handling hundreds of thousands of operations per second and up to 50.000 simultaneous players
Create and optimise databases and ETL pipelines to keep data reliable and systems performing at their best
Bring new features to life in our Vue.js Admin Panel by implementing their configuration

Test

Create and maintain automated and performance tests that keep features reliable under pressure
Develop and maintain Vue.js Test-Client features that make backend features easy to test and validate

Deploy

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and fast, reliable rollback strategies
Work with web and mobile frontend teams to integrate backend services seamlessly across their platforms

Maintain

Build and continuously improve Kubernetes infrastructure and monitoring across Azure and local development environments
Maintain security protocols covering user roles, access controls, encryption, and security updates
Document incidents from root cause through resolution and post-mortem analysis, turning issues into opportunities to improve
Share your expertise with your colleagues and improve the overall team quality

Tools

Technologies: .NET 10, Vue.js, GraphQL via Hasura, WebSockets via SignalR, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Redis, OpenTelemetry, and Identity Server

The Team

Architecture is a team effort. New solutions are discussed openly and shaped together, with team buy-in before development begins
Code reviews are part of how we grow. Every pull request is reviewed by the rest of the team within a few hours, helping us maintain quality while sharing knowledge along the way
We work as peers. The manager is part of the team, and technical decisions are discussed openly and made together
Choose what you build. Features aren’t simply assigned, team members can choose which features they want to work on from the sprint
Quality comes built in. Unit tests and Gherkin-based acceptance tests are part of our definition of done and are kept up to date
Keep it simple. We follow the YAGNI principle, avoiding unnecessary complexity and focusing on solid, evolvable architectures
Own the full picture. Everyone builds a strong understanding of our Kubernetes components and CI/CD, so infrastructure knowledge is shared across the team

Your profile

Professional experience working with .NET technologies, with .NET 5+ experience preferred
Strong knowledge of database technologies, with experience across SQL and NoSQL preferred
Familiarity with the API technologies that connect our backend to frontend experiences, including REST, GraphQL, and WebSockets
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies
Understanding of distributed systems and the challenges of building technology capable of supporting millions of players worldwide
Capable of building event-driven systems using message buses like Kafka, RabbitMQ, and Azure Service Bus
Strong product thinking, with the ability to turn stakeholder needs into clear and effective technical requirements
Collaborative mindset with experience in pair programming, team workshops, knowledge sharing, and supporting the growth of others
Agile mindset and a pragmatic approach to building solid, evolvable solutions
Confident communicating and collaborating in English, both written and spoken

Our offer

We believe great work happens when people feel supported, inspired, and balanced. By investing in our employees, we create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential. This commitment has been recognized through our Great Place to Work® certification. We offer the following benefits:
Flexible working hours and a hybrid model that fit your lifestyle, backed by a strong culture of work-life balance
A dedicated training budget to explore new skills, deepen your expertise, and shape your career journey
A welcoming office atmosphere at our Vienna HQ with daily fresh fruit, a wide range of teas, fair-trade coffee, and meals at our company-subsidized restaurant
Subsidized public transportation, plus access to pool e-bikes and e-cars — for both business and personal use
Plenty of ways to stay active and connected, from MyClubs app points to regular sports and company events
Attractive local employee discounts and healthcare benefits that make everyday life a little easier
The minimum gross annual salary for this position according to the applicable collective agreement is €58,000 (full-time basis). A higher salary is possible depending on qualifications and experience

About Greentube

Greentube GmbH, the global interactive unit of NOVOMATIC, is a leading developer and supplier of iGaming solutions. Greentube is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the NOVOMATIC Group, one of the biggest producers and operators of gaming technologies and one of the largest integrated gaming companies in the world. Greentube’s industry leading omni-channel technology allows the convergence of online, mobile and land-based games. The well-diversified product portfolio includes Classic Slots, Table Games, Live Dealer Gaming, AWP Reloaded Slots, Server-Based Gaming, Social Casino Gaming, Bingo and more.
