Do you want to turn business challenges into smart, scalable solutions with Microsoft Power Platform? At Tieto Tech Consulting, we work at the intersection of technology, consulting, and customer value - helping organizations automate processes and build modern digital solutions that make daily work easier and more impactful.

With over 8,000 colleagues worldwide and around 300 colleagues in the DACH region, we combine industry insight, software engineering, cloud expertise, data capabilities, and enterprise solutions know-how to help our customers design, build, and run their digital businesses.

We are looking for a Microsoft Power Platform Architect who can take ownership of enterprise-level solution architectures, guide customers in strategic technology decisions, and translate complex business needs into scalable, secure and future-ready Microsoft ecosystem solutions. If you are passionate about architecture, governance, cloud technologies and creating sustainable business value with Power Platform, this role offers the opportunity to shape impactful solutions together with skilled colleagues and forward-thinking customers.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Microsoft Power Platform Architect, you

Define and own end-to-end Power Platform architectures, ensuring scalable, secure and sustainable solution designs across Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages
Advise customers on best practices for Power Platform governance and lifecycle management
Lead the architectural integration of Power Platform solutions into broader Microsoft 365 and Azure ecosystems, aligning technical decisions with enterprise standards and customer strategy
Facilitate architecture workshops, guide decision-making with customers and provide expert recommendations on solution design, governance and technical roadmaps
Stay up-to-date with Microsoft certifications and contribute to internal capability building

Who We Are Looking For

We value diverse backgrounds and welcome candidates who bring:

5+ years of hands-on experience in a similar role
Very good knowledge of Cloud Enterprise Architecture, Power Platform, Azure and Azure AI ecosystems
A completed degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable qualification
Certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, PL-600 or PL-900 are a plus
Hands-on knowledge of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, and GPT-based solutions
Strong understanding of low-code/no-code development principles
Good programming skills, preferably with C#/.NET
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
A consulting mindset and strong communication skills in both German and English
Passion for continuous learning and staying up-to-date with new developments

As an individual, you are a team player who takes initiative and ownership. You communicate clearly, organize your work effectively, and enjoy solving complex challenges. You’re eager to learn and share knowledge, and you thrive in a fast-evolving technology landscape.

We offer

Collaboration with highly skilled experts across Europe and beyond
A culture built on trust, collaboration, and continuous learning
Flexible hybrid working models and modern ways of working
Benefits like laptop and smartphone also for private use, health programs, team events, excellent public transport connection, food vouchers, contribution to the costs of the Austrian “Klimaticket”, fresh fruits, the perfect environment to prosper professionally, and a lot more
Continuous professional development and international career opportunities
An attractive compensation package including performance-based incentives

The monthly gross salary for this position will start from € 4.476,00 (based on IT collective agreement, ST1 Erfahrungsstufe) on a full-time basis, depending on your qualifications and experience. Our aim is to provide you with a salary package that is both competitive and reflective of your relevant experience, while also aligning with current market standards.

Did we get you inspired?

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please attach your CV or LinkedIn profile, and we will get in touch.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact us: careers.austria@tieto.com.

We’re also happy to connect you with one of your future colleagues for an informal conversation. It’s a great opportunity to hear first-hand what the role looks like, how we work and what it’s like to be part of the team.

Please note that while we are happy to answer questions via email, we can only consider applications submitted through our online application system and therefore cannot accept applications sent directly by email.

Locations:
Vienna, Linz, Graz

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.

Autonet opereert in een omgeving met een sterke focus op vernieuwing, schaalbaarheid en modernisering en combineert bestaande systemen met de ontwikkeling van nieuwe platformen.

Wat de .NET Developer zal doen

Als Medior .NET Developer werk je voornamelijk aan backend‑ontwikkeling binnen meerdere applicaties en diensten. Je draagt actief bij aan zowel het onderhoud en de doorontwikkeling van bestaande systemen als aan de bouw van een nieuw webplatform dat de huidige backend zal vervangen.
Je werkt aan bedrijfskritische applicaties, integraties met externe partijen en schaalbare oplossingen binnen een omgeving die zich ontwikkelt richting service‑ en (micro)service‑architecturen. Frontendwerk speelt een beperkte, ondersteunende rol.

De .NET Developer zal:

Je werkt proactief, zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht en neemt eigenaarschap over je werk. Je hebt een sterke interesse in AI en past dit actief toe binnen je ontwikkelwerk.
Daarnaast beschik je over:
– Ervaring met C# en .NET (bij voorkeur modern .NET / .NET Core)
– Ervaring met MSSQL en/of PostgreSQL
– Affiniteit met of ervaring in API‑integraties
– Basiskennis van frontendtechnieken (JavaScript, jQuery, CSS)
– Het vermogen om te werken in zowel legacy‑ als moderne omgevingen
– Actieve interesse in AI en het toepassen hiervan in softwareontwikkeling
– Een proactieve mindset en inhoudelijke betrokkenheid binnen het team

Nice to have

– Ervaring met het implementeren van AI in bestaande applicaties
– Ervaring met of interesse in service‑georiënteerde of microservice‑architecturen
– Affiniteit met de automotive sector of logistieke processen

Onze tools & technische omgeving

Je werkt in een technisch landschap dat sterk in ontwikkeling is, met onder andere:

– .NET (voornamelijk .NET Core / modern .NET)
– Legacy backend in VB.NET en C#
– Nieuwe platformontwikkeling met ASP.NET Core en Razor Pages
– Meerdere .NET Core applicaties en services

– JavaScript, jQuery en CSS
– Architectuur in transitie naar schaalbare services en (micro)services

Wat wij bieden

new_jobs.title: Teamlead Software Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Als Teamlead Software Engineering breng jij technisch leiderschap en architectuur samen in de ontwikkeling van slimme machinebesturingen.

Voor deze functie zijn we op zoek naar een Teamlead Software Engineering voor onze opdrachtgever, een toonaangevende speler in de ontwikkeling en bouw van industriële plaatbewerkingsmachines, met productielocaties in Lochem en Eijsden. Onze opdrachtgever bedient klanten wereldwijd vanuit een internationale organisatie met vestigingen in onder meer Zweden, Noord-Amerika, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk.

Onze opdrachtgever ontwikkelt en bouwt volledig in eigen huis innovatieve en geautomatiseerde oplossingen voor plaatbewerking, met een sterke focus op technologische vernieuwing en kwaliteit. Vanuit nauwe samenwerking tussen R&D, productmanagement en internationale softwareteams wordt voortdurend gewerkt aan de volgende generatie machinebesturingen, waarbij innovatie en duurzaamheid samengaan met een persoonlijke, betrokken werksfeer.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen deze functie combineer je technisch leiderschap met architectuur en actieve softwareontwikkeling. Je stuurt een softwareteam van acht FTE aan, verdeeld over .NET/HMI-ontwikkeling, embedded software en Automated Solutions. Prioriteiten stellen, capaciteit verdelen en de voortgang bewaken horen daarbij. Coaching van engineers krijgt veel aandacht, net als het voeren van voortgangs- en ontwikkelgesprekken. Daarnaast ben je het escalatiepunt voor complexe technische vraagstukken.

Op architectuurvlak bewaak je de samenhang tussen embedded software, HMI, motion control, robotinterfaces en connectiviteit. Coding guidelines en architectuurrichtlijnen stel je op en bewaak je, met oog voor een toekomstbestendig softwareplatform. Ook aan de meerjarenvisie voor softwareontwikkeling werk je actief mee.

Zelf ontwikkelen blijft onderdeel van je werk: gemiddeld één dag per week schrijf je embedded software voor machinebesturingen. Code reviews, debugging en het ondersteunen van prototypes horen hier ook bij. Tot slot draag je bij aan backlogbeheer, sprintplanning en releaseprocessen, en lever je een actieve bijdrage aan de cybersecurity- en kwaliteitsprocessen binnen R&D.

Wij bieden

Voor deze functie mag je een salaris verwachten dat past bij jouw ervaring en verantwoordelijkheid, aangevuld met uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Je krijgt een vast dienstverband voor 40 uur per week, met 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw verdere ontwikkeling dankzij uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden. Daarnaast profiteer je van een leasefietsregeling, een pensioenregeling binnen de Metalektro, een collectieve zorgverzekering en korting op een sportschoolabonnement. De werksfeer is informeel en betrokken, met leuke collega's, een actieve personeelsvereniging en een geregelde borrel. Flexibiliteit en persoonlijke ontwikkeling staan centraal, zodat werk en privé goed in balans blijven.

Wat breng je mee

HBO- of WO-diploma in Informatica, Embedded Systems, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als lead engineer, architect of teamlead
Ervaring met embedded softwareontwikkeling
Ruime ervaring met softwarearchitectuur
Achtergrond binnen machinebouw, industriële automatisering of robotica
Kennis van Embedded C/C++, .NET/C#, EtherCAT en motion control
Bekend met Git, Azure DevOps en OPC-UA
Affiniteit met IEC 62443 en cybersecurity
Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden
Analytisch en resultaatgericht, met oog voor samenwerking

Wat kun je van CTS verwachten?

CTS helpt jou om de juiste volgende stap in je carrière te zetten. Wij begeleiden je gedurende het gehele sollicitatieproces en zorgen ervoor dat je goed voorbereid bent op gesprekken. Daarnaast bieden we advies op maat, zodat jouw profiel perfect aansluit bij de wensen van de opdrachtgever. Met onze persoonlijke aanpak en ervaring in de technische sector staan we garant voor een succesvolle samenwerking.

Bij CTS draait alles om de juiste match tussen mens en organisatie. Wij bemiddelen professionals naar vaste banen binnen de techniek en begeleiden je gedurende het volledige sollicitatieproces. We starten met een persoonlijk kennismakingsgesprek om jouw wensen en ambities in kaart te brengen. We begeleiden je tijdens het hele traject, van voorbereiding op gesprekken tot ondersteuning bij onderhandelingen. Ook na je start blijven we betrokken en denken we mee over jouw verdere ontwikkeling

Wij geloven dat werk een belangrijk onderdeel is van het leven. Daarom is het essentieel dat je werk doet dat bij je past en waar je energie uit haalt. Of je nu precies weet wat je zoekt of nog aan het oriënteren bent, wij helpen je de juiste richting te vinden. Indien nodig schakelen we daarbij onze vaste partner voor loopbaanadvies in.

En nu? Herken je jezelf in dit profiel? Neem contact op met CTS, dan bespreken we de mogelijkheden.

Als Senior Mobile Apps Developer speel je een sleutelrol binnen het development team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van mobiele applicaties voor Android en iOS, en zorgt ervoor dat deze schaalbaar, performant en toekomstbestendig zijn.

Definiëren en bewaken van de technische architectuur van mobiele applicaties
Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van schaalbare mobiele oplossingen
Maken van onderbouwde keuzes in frameworks, tooling en technologieën
End-to-end ownership van complexe features en projecten
Integreren van API’s en externe services
Waarborgen van codekwaliteit, performance, security en maintainability
Opzetten en verbeteren van CI/CD processen en automatisering
Coachen en begeleiden van (junior/medior) developers
Fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt voor stakeholders
Signaleren van risico’s en proactief aandragen van oplossingen

Hoe werk je?

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een scrumteam en werkt nauw samen met Product Management, UX/UI en andere development teams. Je neemt actief deel aan Agile/Scrum processen en draagt bij aan een effectieve samenwerking en continue verbetering.

Wat breng je mee?

Minimaal 5+ jaar ervaring als Software Developer, waarvan meerdere jaren in mobile development
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met .NET (bij voorkeur .NET Core / .NET 6+)

Ervaring met .NET MAUI of vergelijkbare mobile frameworks (bijv. Xamarin)
Aantoonbare ervaring met mobiele app development (Android en/of iOS)
Sterke ervaring met Git (branching, pull requests, code reviews)

Aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van maintainable en testbare software
Sterk analytisch vermogen en probleemoplossend denken
Affiniteit met mobile app development (UX, performance, offline/online scenario’s)
Ownership mindset en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid voor kwaliteit en delivery
Ervaring met werken in Agile/Scrum teams

Ervaring met AI-tools in development (bijv. Copilot, AI-assisted testing)

Wie ben jij?

Je werkt graag zelfstandig en neemt duidelijk eigenaarschap over je werk en resultaten. Tegelijk beschik je over een sterke technische visie, die je helder en overtuigend weet over te brengen op anderen. Je voelt je echter niet alleen comfortabel in een zelfstandige rol; je draagt actief bij aan samenwerking en functioneert uitstekend als teamspeler.

UWV is voor het Applicatie Ontwikkel Centrum (AOC) binnen Concern-ICT op zoek naar een ervaren Principal Applicatie Ontwikkelaar (.Net) voor de ontwikkeling en het onderhoud van één of meer applicaties. De Principal Applicatie Ontwikkelaar is in staat .Net-applicaties (releases) te realiseren en te integreren vanaf de requirementsfase tot en met de oplevering. De werkwijze is iteratief en er wordt intensief samengewerkt met andere ontwikkelaars, de klant, gebruikers en testers. new_jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer – Azure
new_jobs.description:
Bij Solvinity werk je aan Azure-omgevingen voor organisaties die geen fouten kunnen veroorloven. Denk aan het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en toonaangevende financiële dienstverleners. Maar deze rol gaat verder dan engineering alleen. Je werkt ook mee in het Cloud Center of Excellence van het ministerie, waar je de cloud-strategie van een van de grootste overheidsorganisaties van Nederland mede vormgeeft. Diepgaand technisch werk, gecombineerd met echte strategische impact.

Wat ga je doen?

Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert veilige Azure-omgevingen voor klanten met strenge eisen op het gebied van beveiliging en compliance. Je werkt met Terraform, Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en Azure Policies. Deployments automatiseer je via CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps of GitLab. Wijzigingen rollen geautomatiseerd en foutloos uit. Je beheert het versie- en lifecycle management van cloud resources en zorgt dat alles gedocumenteerd en herleidbaar is.

Je stelt accreditatiedocumentatie op, voert risicoanalyses en security assessments uit en zorgt dat cloudservices aantoonbaar voldoen aan normen zoals BIO2 en NIS2. Je bent daarin een betrouwbare gesprekspartner voor security- en risk-stakeholders.

Jouw kerntaken

Ontwerpen en beheren van Azure-netwerkarchitecturen (VNet, NSG, UDR, BGP, VPN, ExpressRoute)
Configureren van Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en implementeren van zero-trust netwerksegmentatie
Bouwen en onderhouden van Infrastructure as Code met Terraform en CI/CD pipelines
Opstellen en implementeren van Azure Policies en policy-initiatieven voor governance en compliance
Opstellen van accreditatiedocumentatie, risicoanalyses en security assessments

Je werkt in een klein, hecht cloudteam met korte lijnen. Er zijn twee à drie standups per week. Geen zware vergadercultuur, wel nauwe samenwerking met collega’s, klanten en stakeholders.

Wat bieden wij?

€5.356 – €7.961 bruto per maand (o.b.v. een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
Mobiliteitsvergoeding of een lease-auto
32 tot 40-urige werkweek
Grotendeels thuiswerken met een vaste dag per week op kantoor en bij de klant
80% pensioenbijdrage van de werkgever

26 vakantiedagen, met mogelijkheid tot uitbreiding

Tot €300 per jaar voor jouw sportactiviteiten

Solvinity investeert structureel in jouw ontwikkeling. Vanaf dag één volg je relevante opleidingen en trainingen. Na twee jaar in dienst ontvang je €1.000 extra opleidingsbudget dat je volledig zelf mag invullen. Denk aan een Azure-certificering zoals de AZ-104 of AZ-400, de Palo Alto PCNSE of een ander traject dat bij jou past. Jaarlijks stel je samen met je manager een persoonlijk opleidingsplan op.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren cloud engineer met een analytische instelling en een security-first mindset. Je bouwt niet alleen — je denkt ook na over waarom je iets zo inricht en wat de risico’s zijn. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, klanten en stakeholders. Je bent nauwkeurig, documentatievaardig en weet complexe technische vraagstukken helder op te schrijven.

Wat Je Meebrengt

Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare cloud-rol
Diepgaande kennis van Azure-netwerken (VNet, NSG, UDR, BGP, VPN, ExpressRoute)
Hands-on ervaring met Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en zero-trust segmentatie
Aantoonbare ervaring met Terraform en CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions)
Ervaring met Azure Policies, accreditatieprocessen en compliance-kaders (BIO2, NIS2 is een pré)

Kennis van Bicep of ARM is een pré. Een relevante Azure-certificering (AZ-104, AZ-400) of Palo Alto PCNSE is een pluspunt, maar aantoonbare praktijkervaring weegt minstens zo zwaar. Je beheerst het Nederlands goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, op minimaal hbo-niveau.

Over Solvinity

Solvinity levert Secure Managed Cloud Services aan organisaties met hoge beveiligingseisen. Hiermee ondersteunt het bedrijf de (rijks-)overheid, gemeenten en toonaangevende organisaties in de financiële en zakelijke dienstverlening, zoals het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, Politie Nederland, TransLink (OV-chipkaart), ING en Klaverblad. Solvinity ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert de complexe platformen waarop bedrijfskritische applicaties veilig en optimaal functioneren. Daarnaast levert het bedrijf CI/CD, containertechnologie en ‘Stretched’ DevSecOps oplossingen voor softwareontwikkelaars.

Solvinity onderscheidt zich op het gebied van cybersecurity met een uitgebreid portfolio aan securitydiensten en -oplossingen en biedt, met een meerderheidsbelang in Securify.nl, aanvullende cybersecurity diensten. Daarnaast heeft het bedrijf certificeringen volgens (inter)nationale normen als ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001, PCI DSS en heeft het als eerste MSP in Nederland SOC 1 en 2 compliance rapporten voor de gehele beheeromgeving van de private én Azure cloud.

Kijk voor meer informatie op [www.solvinity.nl](http://www.solvinity.nl), of volg Solvinity op LinkedIn.

Interesse?

Passen we bij elkaar? Wil je ons daarvan overtuigen? Bel of app dan onze recruitmentspecialist, Niels Moelard, op 06-30399509 of stuur een mail naar niels.moelard@solvinity.com We streven naar een snel en persoonlijk sollicitatieproces: na een eerste (online) kennismaking volgt een gesprek op kantoor in Amersfoort. Binnen twee gespreksrondes weet je waar je aan toe bent.

You will bridge the gap between product strategy and technical execution while fostering individual growth. Because our domain spans embedded/systems engineering, web platforms, and quality assurance, we need a leader with a solid technical background who can speak the team's language, guide architectural decisions, and manage a diverse set of engineering disciplines effectively.

Take ownership of existing production services and continuously improve their reliability and performance.

7+ years of JVM development experience, preferably with Kotlin.

Experience building and operating production SaaS services.

new_jobs.title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Consulting – Cloud Engineering
das volle Potential der Cloud ausschöpfen? Unser Team begleitet Unternehmen von der Strategie über die Entwicklung und Integration zukunftsfähiger Anwendungen bis hin zur Transformation großer IT-Organisationen zu mehr Agilität und zur Migration komplexer IT-Landschaften in die Cloud. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Senior Cloud Software Engineer (m/w/d)
.

Standorte: Berlin
, Düsseldorf
, Frankfurt (Main)
, Hamburg
, Hannover
, Köln
, München
und Stuttgart
.

Dein Impact:

Als Senior Cloud Software Engineer (m/w/d) gestaltet du die Cloud-Transformation unserer Mandanten und entwickelst skalierbare, sichere und innovative Cloud-Lösungen.

Cloud Solution Design & Architecture: Entwickle cloud-native Lösungen und übersetze Anforderungen unserer Mandanten in skalierbare und sichere Architekturen.
Automation & Deployment: Implementiere CI/CD-Pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code und Monitoring-Frameworks für stabile Abläufe.
Engineering Excellence: Fördere Best Practices durch Code-Reviews, Testautomatisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.
Mentorship: Unterstütze Junior Engineers (m/w/d) und etabliere eine Kultur des Lernens und der Zusammenarbeit.
Client & Stakeholder Engagement: Berate Mandanten und interne Teams, um technische Lösungen mit Geschäftszielen abzustimmen.

Dein Skillset:

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der cloud-nativen Softwareentwicklung sowie im Aufbau und Betrieb von Lösungen auf führenden Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. Azure, AWS oder GCP), idealerweise mit relevanten Zertifizierungen
Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner, verteilter Softwarearchitekturen mit Fokus auf Containerisierung, Kubernetes, Microservices und Infrastructure-as-Code
Sicherer Umgang mit Programmiersprachen wie Python, Java oder C# sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke in agilen Teams und Interesse an KI-/ML-Technologien
Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, KI-Potenziale zu identifizieren, kritisch zu bewerten und gezielt für innovative Lösungsansätze, fundierte Empfehlungen und messbaren Kundennutzen einzusetzen

Deine Chance:

Best-in-class Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University sowie im Rahmen individueller Qualifikationsangebote und Trainings
Umfassende Entwicklungschancen durch strukturierte Karriereplanung, Inclusive Leadership, Entsendungsprogramme, projektbasierte Job-Rotation sowie Förderung sozialen Engagements und Corporate Volunteering
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf & Familie dank Mobile Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals und Familienservice, z. B. zur Unterstützung für pflegende Angehörige, Elternzeit-Beratung und vielem mehr
Gesundheit & Fitness im Fokus durch regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und die Unterstützung von Sport- und Teamevents
Attraktive Arbeitgeberleistungen inklusive Bike- und Pkw-Leasing, Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung sowie flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen wie z. B. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und EU Remote Working
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren Bewerbungs-FAQs.

Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111.

new_jobs.title: Senior IT-Consultant Software-Testautomatisierung (all genders)
new_jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Gestalte Testarchitekturen: Entwickle und pflege Testautomatisierungsarchitekturen und stelle die Qualität geschäftskritischer Software sicher.
Implementiere und überwache Tests: Setze Automatisierungslösungen um, integriere sie in CI/CD-Pipelines, generiere Testdaten und führe automatisierte Testfälle aus, dokumentiere Abweichungen und stimme deren Behebung mit dem Entwicklungsteam ab.
Koordiniere Teams und Lasttests: Leite kleine Teams von technischen Testern, implementiere Testszenarien für Lasttests und stelle sicher, dass sie effizient ausgeführt werden.
Berate Stakeholder: Unterstütze User der Fachabteilungen und Entwicklungsteams bei Fragen zur Softwarequalität und Testmaßnahmen.
Unterstütze die Testplanung: Trage durch Schätzungen und Statusberichte zur Planung und Steuerung von Testaufgaben bei.
Arbeite neue Teammitglieder ein: Unterstütze neue Tester:innen bei der Einarbeitung und teile dein Wissen, um den Testprozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

DEIN PROFIL

Fachliche Qualifikation: Ein Ausbildungs- oder Studienabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik bildet deine Basis für diese Rolle.
Testautomatisierung und Programmiersprachen: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in agilen Projekten mit DevOps mit und bist sicher in mindestens zwei Programmiersprachen wie Java, TypeScript, C# oder Python.
Know-how in Automatisierung: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von Automatisierungslösungen mit Technologien wie Playwright oder Selenium und kannst diese in CI/CD-Pipelines wie Jenkins oder GitLab integrieren.
Testdaten und Umgebungen: Synthetische Generierung von Testdaten und Containerisierung von Testumgebungen, z.B. mit Docker und Kubernetes sind dir nicht fremd.
Schnittstellen: Vertrautheit mit dem automatisierten Test für synchrone Schnittstellen (Client-Server) und asynchrone Schnittstellen (Microservices) wie REST, SOAP, AMQP oder MQTT gehören zu deinem Skillset.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

new_jobs.title: Senior IT-Consultant Software-Testautomatisierung (all genders)
new_jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Gestalte Testarchitekturen: Entwickle und pflege Testautomatisierungsarchitekturen und stelle die Qualität geschäftskritischer Software sicher.
Implementiere und überwache Tests: Setze Automatisierungslösungen um, integriere sie in CI/CD-Pipelines, generiere Testdaten und führe automatisierte Testfälle aus, dokumentiere Abweichungen und stimme deren Behebung mit dem Entwicklungsteam ab.
Koordiniere Teams und Lasttests: Leite kleine Teams von technischen Testern, implementiere Testszenarien für Lasttests und stelle sicher, dass sie effizient ausgeführt werden.
Berate Stakeholder: Unterstütze User der Fachabteilungen und Entwicklungsteams bei Fragen zur Softwarequalität und Testmaßnahmen.
Unterstütze die Testplanung: Trage durch Schätzungen und Statusberichte zur Planung und Steuerung von Testaufgaben bei.
Arbeite neue Teammitglieder ein: Unterstütze neue Tester:innen bei der Einarbeitung und teile dein Wissen, um den Testprozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

DEIN PROFIL

Fachliche Qualifikation: Ein Ausbildungs- oder Studienabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik bildet deine Basis für diese Rolle.
Testautomatisierung und Programmiersprachen: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in agilen Projekten mit DevOps mit und bist sicher in mindestens zwei Programmiersprachen wie Java, TypeScript, C# oder Python.
Know-how in Automatisierung: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von Automatisierungslösungen mit Technologien wie Playwright oder Selenium und kannst diese in CI/CD-Pipelines wie Jenkins oder GitLab integrieren.
Testdaten und Umgebungen: Synthetische Generierung von Testdaten und Containerisierung von Testumgebungen, z.B. mit Docker und Kubernetes sind dir nicht fremd.
Schnittstellen: Vertrautheit mit dem automatisierten Test für synchrone Schnittstellen (Client-Server) und asynchrone Schnittstellen (Microservices) wie REST, SOAP, AMQP oder MQTT gehören zu deinem Skillset.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

new_jobs.title: AI Engineer Consultant (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
Du sollteste bei uns anfangen, weil wir:

Sehr familiär und locker miteinander umgehen

Umfangreiches Fortbildungspotential bieten (Wechselnde Projekte, enge Technologiepartnerschaft mit Azure & Databricks, Zertifikate, interner Austausch, Kurse)

Trotz der kleinen Unternehmensgröße von 15 Mitarbeitern kompetitiv zahlen

Viel Wert auf Teambuilding und Wohlfühlatmosphäre legen (Workations auf Mallorca, gemeinsame Ausgehabende, Pizza Donnerstag etc.)

Unbegrenzte Flexibilität was Homeoffice und Arbeitszeiten angeht anbieten

Du bei uns kein kleines Zahnrad einer großen Maschinerie bist sondern wirklich etwas bedeutest und bewegen kannst

Die Geschäftsführung immer hinter dir steht und versucht dir ein bestmögliches Arbeitsklima zu bieten

Aufgaben
Als AI Engineer
bei Ailio nbist du Teil von Workshops und der Konzeption moderner AI- & GenAI-Anwendungen, setzt Prototypen sowie MVPs im Team um und begleitest Kunden dabei, diese in produktive, wertstiftende AI-Produkte zu verwandeln und zu betreiben.

Gemeinsam mit deinem Team bringst du Machine Learning, Generative AI, Cloud-Know-How und Software Engineering zusammen, um End-To-End KI-Lösungen zu bauen, die wirklich auf die Straße kommen und nicht in der Schublade enden.

Aufgabenbereiche

Bei uns sind die Aufgabenbereiche dynamisch gestreut und wir verzichten auf starre Rollenbilder. Bewirb dich einfach – gemeinsam finden wir heraus, welches Portfolio am besten zu deinen Stärken passt:

Beratung bei der Identifikation, Bewertung und Einordnung von Use-Cases

Python & AI-Entwicklung

Generative AI & RAG-Architekturen
(Retrieval-Augmented Generation, AI Agents)

Azure Cloud & Azure OpenAI
/ Databricks / Fabric

MLOps & AI Governance
(Model-Deployment, CI/CD, Monitoring & Evaluierung)

API-Entwicklung & Systemintegration
(z. B. FastAPI, REST)

Technische Beratung & Workshop-Moderation

Kunden helfen KI Adaption zu optimieren

Automation Software (N8N)

Qualifikation
Wir sind flexibel, was Hardskills angeht, und suchen vor allem talentierte und wissbegierige Menschen, die dazu noch kommunikationsstark sind.

Ein großer Bonus ist, wenn du bereits nachweisbare Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen mitbringst:

Enterprise Python-Entwicklung
& moderne AI-Frameworks

Generative AI & LLMs
(z. B. RAG-Architekturen, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering)

Azure Cloud & Azure OpenAI Services

Databricks / Fabric
oder MLOps-Pipelines

REST-APIs
& Backend-Entwicklung (z. B. FastAPI)

Praktische Umsetzung von KI- Use-Cases
in Produktionsumgebungen

Beratung bei der Identifikation, Bewertung und Einordnung von Use-Cases

Benefits
Wir sind ein kleines und familiäres Unternehmen mit 15 Mitarbeitern. Das besteht aus einem Geschäftsführer, einem Vertriebler und einem Assistenten. Der Rest sind Techies.

Bei uns wirst du sehr eigenverantwortlich Themen Vorantreiben. Die Geschäftsführung ist vor allem Sparringspartner, der dir den Rücken Freihält und dich coached.

Wir legen viel Wert auf Servant-Leadership und eigenbestimmtes Handeln und Arbeiten.

Dadurch finden sich bei uns vor allem Kollegen wieder, die eigenständig kreative Lösungen finden und ausarbeiten können.

1. Erstes Interview mit Geschäftsführung um dir zu zeigen, was dich bei Ailio hinter den Kulissen erwartet & sicherzustellen, dass du gut ins Team passen würdest

2. Probeaufgabe ( Scope etwa 2-4 Stunden )

3. Tech Interview

Feedback gibts spätestens 24 Stunden nach Tech Interview, theoretisch kann der Prozess in 3-4 Tagen durch sein, wenn du die Probeaufgabe zügig erledigst.

daniel.massey@searchability.com

THE ROLE

An established digital transformation and software consultancy in Lincolnshire is looking for a talented .NET Developer to join its growing development team. You'll design, build and maintain high-quality web applications and bespoke software solutions for a varied portfolio of clients, working across the full development lifecycle — from technical design through build, testing and deployment to ongoing support. Working alongside Business Analysts, Project Managers, Designers and fellow Developers, you'll turn business requirements into robust, scalable and well-engineered solutions, and have a genuine hand in the technical decisions that shape them.

Our client is an established consultancy delivering software and digital solutions to organisations across the UK. They work across bespoke development, enterprise applications, CMS-driven platforms and system integration, and this role has come about through continued growth.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer | API Enterprise
new_jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the API Enterprise
team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem. Whereas the Core team obsesses over the self-service developer journey, our focus is on enterprise customer adoption: the usage insights, cost controls, RBAC , compliance, and data residency capabilities that enterprise IT and security teams depend on. We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.

We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Drive Enterprise API Adoption: You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs
Build for Governance & Compliance: You will design the controls enterprise IT and security admins rely on (roles and permissions, projects, data residency, and audit-ability), making DeepL the compliant default for regulated, global organizations
Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability: You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. You will implement strong contract testing, monitoring, and SLOs, preventing breaking changes and security vulnerabilities before they reach our enterprise customers
Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem: You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities

Qualities we look for

An "Enterprise-First" Mindset: You treat enterprise IT and security admins as your primary users. You understand that earning their trust means clear governance, predictable cost control, robust compliance, fast response times and data residency. You're a strong communicator who's comfortable owning product decisions and implementing them
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and distributed architectures, primarily in C# / .NET, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong API design fundamentals and system design are core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/TypeScript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement
Enterprise Platform Fluency: You bring hands-on experience with the building blocks of modern enterprise APIs (MCP, CLIs, and OAuth) and know how to wield them to build secure, extensible integrations
Cross-Team Leadership: You have a track record of leading projects across multiple teams. You can align with different areas and other stakeholders, manage cross-team contracts and dependencies, and keep complex, interconnected systems coherent
Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, learn from incidents, and treat mature SLOs as a core engineering feature
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery so you can focus your energy on high-value architecture and complex problem-solving
Bonus points if you have: a track record of zero-downtime migrations on live systems; experience with metering, quota, or usage-data systems; worked in a compliance environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, C5, or similar)

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

new_jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Athera Healthcare delivers innovative healthcare solutions that improve patient outcomes and transform healthcare delivery.

About the role

We are looking for a QA Engineer who wants the opportunity to shape how quality assurance is done, rather than simply inherit an established testing process.
You will be our first dedicated QA hire and will work closely with the Head of Technology and the wider development team to define and establish a pragmatic QA approach across a varied technology estate.
Our applications span modern web technologies and long-established desktop systems, including React, Angular, .NET, Java, Delphi, WinForms/WPF and ASP.NET Web Forms.
Automation today is relatively limited. A major part of this role will be helping us change that.
We are particularly interested in someone who is keen to embrace AI-assisted testing and modern automation techniques. We do not expect you to arrive with every answer. We are looking for someone with strong QA fundamentals, good scripting and technical skills, and the curiosity to investigate new approaches and turn them into practical improvements.
This could suit an experienced mid-level QA Engineer who wants greater ownership and the opportunity to demonstrate that they can build and influence a QA capability.

What you'll be doing

The role will be approximately 50% test automation and 50% hands-on exploratory and manual testing, although the balance will naturally change depending on releases and projects.
You will:

Help define and continuously improve our overall QA strategy, processes and standards.
Build out automated regression coverage across both web and legacy desktop applications.
Investigate where AI can make testing faster, broader and more maintainable.
Convert existing manual regression tests into appropriate automated tests.
Use AI-assisted tools to help generate, maintain and improve automated test suites.
Investigate agentic and computer-use technologies for automating applications that are difficult to test using traditional automation frameworks.
Identify gaps in regression coverage and prioritise automation based on risk and business impact.
Create and maintain appropriate test data.
Use AI and automation tooling to analyse failures, diagnose issues and reduce brittle or unreliable tests.
Perform exploratory testing to identify issues that scripted and automated tests may miss.
Manually verify complex functionality and changes where automation would not provide sufficient confidence.
Test functionality across modern web applications and legacy Windows desktop systems.
Test APIs and integrations.
Participate in performance, security and non-functional testing where appropriate.
Review acceptance criteria and contribute to improving testability before development begins.
Produce proportionate test plans based on technical and business risk.
Participate in defect triage and help development teams understand and reproduce issues.
Contribute to release readiness and release sign-off.
Help manage test environments, test data and regression coverage.
Integrate automated testing into our Azure DevOps development and delivery processes.
Work closely with developers to encourage quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final release step.

AI and automation

We see AI as an important part of the future of software quality.
We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to generate test scripts. We want someone interested in understanding where AI genuinely improves QA and where traditional engineering judgement remains essential.
You will be encouraged to investigate and apply AI to areas including:
Generating initial automated test cases and scripts.
Turning manual regression scenarios into automation
Identifying potential gaps in regression coverage.
Generating realistic and useful test data.
Analysing automated test failures and logs.
Diagnosing flaky or brittle tests.
Improving and maintaining existing automated tests.
Exploring AI-driven browser automation.
Exploring computer-use and agentic testing approaches for legacy desktop applications.
Supporting exploratory testing and identifying unusual edge cases.

AI-generated tests and results must still be critically reviewed. Strong QA judgement, curiosity and the ability to recognise unexpected behaviour remain central to the role.

What we're looking for

You should have:
Commercial experience in software quality assurance or software testing.
Strong exploratory and manual testing skills.
Experience testing web applications.
An understanding of automated regression testing and when automation is appropriate.
The ability to write scripts or test automation without needing to be a full-time software developer.
An interest in modern AI-assisted and low-code/no-code automation tools.
Experience investigating defects and providing developers with clear, reproducible information.
Experience creating test cases, test scenarios and regression suites.
An understanding of API testing.
An understanding of risk-based testing.
Experience working alongside software developers in an Agile or iterative development environment.
The confidence to question requirements and identify scenarios that may not have been considered.
The ability to work independently and establish structure in an environment where the QA function is still developing.

Most importantly,
you should be someone who is curious about how modern tools can improve software quality and willing to experiment, learn and challenge established testing approaches.

Useful experience

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial, but we do not expect candidates to have everything:
Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar web automation frameworks.
Windows desktop application automation.
Testing WinForms, WPF or Delphi applications.
Testing applications built using React or Angular.
Testing .NET or Java applications.
ASP.NET Web Forms applications.
REST API testing.
Postman or similar API testing tools.
Azure DevOps.
Automated testing within CI/CD pipelines.
Performance testing.
Security testing.
Accessibility testing.
AI-assisted development or testing tools.
Agentic automation or computer-use technologies.
Healthcare, audit or other environments where accuracy, traceability and reliability are particularly important.

What success looks like
During your first year, we would expect you to progressively:
Establish a clear and pragmatic QA approach across the technology team.
Create greater visibility of regression coverage and software quality risks.
Build a maintainable automated regression suite for our highest-value and highest-risk workflows.
Introduce appropriate automated testing into Azure DevOps pipelines.
Reduce the amount of repetitive manual regression testing required for releases.
Establish effective exploratory testing practices alongside automation.
Demonstrate practical uses of AI that improve testing speed, coverage or maintainability.
Develop workable approaches for automating appropriate parts of our legacy application estate.
Improve the quality and consistency of release readiness decisions.
Help developers consider testing and quality earlier in the development lifecycle.

The opportunity

This is not a role where you will simply execute someone else's test scripts.
You will have the opportunity to influence how QA develops across the organisation, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and demonstrate what a modern QA function can deliver.
There will be guidance and support from the technology leadership team, but we are looking for someone who wants ownership, is comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems, and is motivated by the opportunity to build something better.

Benefits

· £35,000 - £45,000 per annum, dependant on experience
· Company pension scheme
· Professional development opportunities
· 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Location

Leeds, Norwich or London – Hybrid / Remote

Athera Healthcare is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of age, gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief.

The role

This position involves a mix of hands-on technical expertise and strategic planning, with a focus on optimizing our systems for scalability, reliability, and maintainability. new_jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern (2027 Cohort)
new_jobs.description:
At Cogna, we're working hard to solve the productivity crisis. Lagging productivity is the biggest barrier to economic growth and a major obstacle to addressing our most important issues, such as climate change, healthcare, and social equality.

But it's not a single problem that can be tackled with a silver-bullet solution, it's the accumulation of millions of highly specific, context-driven challenges across every facet of every organisation that have to be addressed on their own terms.

Cogna is on a mission to solve this very complex problem. We're creating an AI-powered platform to understand these inefficiencies within customers' operating models, to define the requirements, and develop the software itself in a fully automated way. The result is high-quality, precision software at scale.

Since our launch in May 2023, we've already seen significant traction and customer revenue that outpaces most companies at our stage. We're backed by top VCs, including Notion Capital and Hoxton Ventures, and we're growing our world-class team - ex Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Palantir - to take us to the next level on our mission.

This is more than a job, it's an opportunity to be part of something genuinely transformative. Are you up for the challenge?

Overview

We are hiring multiple interns to join our team of experts building the future of software and natural language programming. Given the recent advances in AI, we're on the cusp of a seismic shift in the way software is developed. This is your chance to be part of it, and experience life at an AI startup.

There is a wide range of interesting technical challenges here in software engineering, programming languages, and AI: how to elicit requirements from end users, how to generate full stack code to meet those requirements, how to automatically generate tests, to repair faults, to generate verifiable code, and to deploy securely and to maintain and revise over time.

We are tackling these challenges step by step by building a working system with customers, and extending as we go, in light of feedback from real examples.

One of our interns wrote a blog about what it's like to spend a summer at Cogna. Blogs by our full-time engineers and designers include this and this and this.

The Role

Internships will last a minimum of 16 weeks during summer 2027, based at our offices in central London, with competitive salary
At Cogna, interns engage in real-world projects alongside our product team
Your responsibility will be to develop methods to make meaningful contributions to the quality of our product pipeline, closely guided by your engineering mentor
These internships are for candidates who have an existing right to live and work in the UK
Our working environment is fast-paced and demanding, yet also fun and closely bonded, with a low-ego culture

Qualifications

Achieved or nearing completion of masters degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience
Preferred: nearing completion of a PhD-level degree in area of research that analyses or synthesises code, or AI for code
Excellent coding skills in strongly-typed languages such as C++, C#, Java, Rust, Golang, Haskell, Ocaml, TypeScript, typed Python or equivalent experience
Strong interest in experimenting with AI and current agentic tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent). Having written an agent is a plus but not the bar
Preferred: solid grasp of LLM fundamentals and how to use them well: prompting, tool use, evaluation, and failure modes. You should be able to say when an agent is the right tool (vs. a deterministic script for example) and when it is not
Keen to work at the cutting edge of AI-native software development. Preferable if there's datapoints to show that through research, a personal project, or published work
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

All the details

As part of the M&S Software Engineering team, you’ll be joining a well-loved historic brand, working on solutions that serve millions of loyal customers and thousands of colleagues. With ethical values that run right through the company’s core and technology leaders that truly understand software engineering, it’s an exciting time as we’re redefining ourselves into a digital-first, engineering-led organisation, with the quality of our engineering team being a key differentiator.

This role sits within our Warehouse Platform team
, supporting the Fashion, Home & Beauty (FH&B) Supply Chain & Logistics
sub-domain, a core part of M&S’s growth plans. You will help shape and improve the core warehouse technology that keeps site operations running, building robust, scalable solutions across Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and related platforms. Working within a modern engineering environment, you’ll drive technical direction, improve reliability, reduce operational support demand over time, and deliver solutions with strong observability, meaningful metrics and best-in-class engineering practices.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced engineer who can combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, helping to shape the future of warehouse technology while supporting the growth and development of the wider engineering community.

Due to high interest, this role may close earlier than advertised. We recommend applying as soon as possible.

What You'll Do

Your key accountabilities will include:

Develop, test and debug high-quality software solutions, setting the standard for engineering excellence and promoting best coding practices across the team.
Provide technical leadership on complex initiatives, ensuring solutions align with engineering strategy, technology standards and architectural principles.
Lead the design and implementation of scalable software solutions and third-party integrations, working closely with Architecture teams to deliver sustainable outcomes.
Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure maintainability, automated testing coverage, performance and adherence to engineering standards while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product managers and engineers to understand challenges and design effective, scalable technology solutions.
Mentor and coach engineers at all levels, sharing expertise, enabling growth and supporting the development of high-performing engineering teams.
Drive operational excellence through monitoring, alerting, incident management and continuous service improvements, ensuring lessons learned are incorporated into future development.

Who You Are

Your skills and experience will include:

Proven track record in full-stack engineering, delivering high-performing, scalable user interfaces, backend systems and enterprise integrations.
Deep understanding of software engineering principles, patterns and best practices, with a focus on maintainable, adaptable and resilient solutions.
Strong knowledge of automated testing and performance testing approaches across unit, integration and end-to-end testing layers.
Proven experience implementing DevSecOps practices at scale across enterprise applications, embedding security and operational excellence throughout the software development lifecycle.
Technical expertise across a range of programming languages and technologies including Java, SQL, JavaScript and modern CI/CD tooling.
Experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions with a strong focus on scalability, performance, observability and security.
Excellent communication, leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and develop engineering capability across teams.

Desirable Experience

Knowledge of the retail domain, particularly Supply Chain and Logistics, including transportation, freight and haulier integrations, Distribution Centres, Retail and eCommerce operations.
Experience working with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), including platforms such as Blue Yonder Dispatcher and related warehouse technologies.
Experience integrating third-party transport planning, transport execution and operational systems within large-scale enterprise environments.

Tech Stack

The team uses a variety of technologies, including:

Languages & Frameworks: Java (Spring Boot), .NET, Angular, AngularJS, React, TypeScript, Python, Playwright, Cucumber, JMeter and AI/ML technologies.
Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure IaaS and PaaS services, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform.
Data & Messaging: Kafka (Confluent), IBM MQ/MQFTE and SFTP.
Databases: Relational databases
API & Integration: Apigee, REST APIs and Windows Services.
Observability: Dynatrace, PagerDuty and Helix.
CI/CD & Quality: GitHub Actions, SonarQube, Semgrep, Snyk, Prisma, GitHub Advanced Security and Qualys.
Analytics: Power BI.

What’s in it for you?

Working at M&S means being part of something bigger – helping to deliver quality, value and service to millions of customers every day. We’re inclusive, fast-moving and always evolving, with a strong sense of purpose and a focus on doing the right thing.

Here are just a few of the benefits that make working here even more rewarding:

20% colleague discount on all M&S products and many third-party brands for you and someone in your household, available once you’ve completed your probation.
Competitive holiday allowance with the option to buy more.
Discretionary bonus schemes linked to your performance and ours.
Strong pension and life assurance to help plan for the future.
Tailored induction and training to support your development from day one.
Exclusive perks and savings through our M&S Choices portal.
Market-leading family policies, including parental, adoption and neonatal leave.
24/7 wellbeing support, including virtual GP access and mental health services.
One paid volunteer day a year to support a cause that matters to you.

Everyone’s Welcome

We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re disrupting, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re transforming how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. Marks & Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers and suppliers. Join us and make change happen.

We are committed to building diverse and representative teams, where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and be at their best. We support each other and work together to win together.

The company’s integrated platform combines inventory management, CRM, websites, sales, marketing, and payment tools, everything needed to run a modern and successful art business.

In 2021, Artlogic was acquired by tech investors Cove Hill Partners to accelerate innovation and expand its global reach. Since then, the company has doubled in size, with employees across London, New York, Atlanta, and Cape Town.

Today, Artlogic is entering an exciting new chapter through its merger with ArtCloud, another industry leader in art technology. Together, the two companies are uniting complementary platforms to build the most comprehensive, forward-thinking solution for the art world. This collaboration brings together deep expertise across CRM, sales, marketing, inventory, payments, and AI-powered tools, empowering galleries, artists, and collectors worldwide.

Joining Artlogic means becoming part of a growing global team that is shaping the future of how art is bought, sold, and managed, both online and in person.

Our technology team comprises over 50 people across Product, UX and Engineering working in cross-functional teams geographically distributed principally between the UK and Brazil with a technical operations team in the UK and South Africa. At present, our technology stack comprises a combination of Python, Typescript, C# in Azure, GCP and AWS cloud environments.

You will contribute to technical strategy by identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, performance, and user experience within our current architecture, while also supporting the evolution of our strategic platform.

This role will play a key part in driving the adoption of AI across engineering, leveraging emerging technologies and embedding AI-native workflows to improve how we design, build, and deliver software.

This role is predominantly hands-on, with around 20–30% of time on technical leadership: architecture, mentoring, and shaping how the team works.

Help the team move faster by adopting AI-native workflows and the shift to an agentic development lifecycle, without compromising the architectural qualities that make our platform reliable, scalable, and maintainable over the long term.
Define guardrails, review practices, and validation gates that hold AI-generated code to our standards for security, reliability, and cost-efficiency (FinOps). These are first-class concerns in agentic pipelines, not afterthoughts.
Design, build, and operate software across our platform, applying the same rigour to AI-augmented work as to anything else you ship.
Embed deeply with Product and Design from the earliest stages of discovery, using rapid prototyping and iteration to compress the gap between idea and validated solution.
Act as feature lead on a rotating basis, taking accountability for the development and delivery of a feature from shaping through to production. This means partnering with Product and Design on the approach, breaking the work down, coordinating the engineers contributing to it, removing blockers, and being the person who knows the state of the feature at any point
Serve as a critical technical voice, stress-testing AI-generated solutions, surfacing second-order risks, and ensuring the team builds the right thing, not just the fast thing.
Shape platform architecture with an architectural lens, contributing to long-term decisions about how AI tooling, LLM integrations, and human-in-the-loop controls evolve across the stack.
Continuously identify and exploit opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and user experience, using observability and analysis to find signals in noisy systems.
Navigate confidently across legacy and greenfield contexts, applying AI tooling pragmatically to modernise where it matters most.
Set the engineering standard, demonstrating through your own work what excellent looks like when much of the code is AI-generated.
Grow the team's capability and confidence with AI-native practices, coaching more junior engineers to think critically about model outputs, prompt design, and the boundaries of automation.
Define and evolve best practices for code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery in a world where much of the first draft is AI-generated.
Evolve CI/CD pipelines to incorporate agentic workflows, automated testing, AI-assisted code review, and intelligent deployment gates.
Champion secure by design principles across both human-written and AI-generated code, embedding security validation into the development pipeline rather than treating it as an afterthought.
Own system observability and reliability, moving from reactive alerting to proactive, model-assisted incident prevention.
Participate in on-call rotation, bringing the same rigour to incident response that you bring to day-to-day development.

About you

You're a hands-on senior engineer with a product mindset and the judgement to know which trade-offs matter. You care about business impact as much as engineering quality, and you've been building with AI tools long enough to know how to use them effectively.

You'll likely bring:

Deep experience building scalable, secure, cloud-based systems, giving you the foundation to confidently guide and validate agentic workflow outputs.
Proven ability to work across both legacy and greenfield codebases, using modern tooling to improve reliability and evolve architecture pragmatically.
Strong system design fundamentals across scalability, performance, and distributed systems, including API design (REST, GraphQL).
Hands-on experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, or similar) and a data-informed approach to system health and reliability.
Solid SQL and data management skills, with an appreciation for AI-enabled, data-driven systems.
Familiarity with CI/CD, containerisation (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker), and DevSecOps practices in modern AI development environments.
A pragmatic approach to testing, knowing what to cover, what to skip, and how to use AI to improve efficiency.
Experience mentoring engineers and supporting the adoption of modern tools and AI-native workflows.
Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

You'll stand out if you:

Ask "what problem are we solving and why?" before reaching for a solution.
Act as a genuine partner to Product and Design, shaping the problem, not just delivering against a spec.
Balance technical debt and feature delivery with long-term business value in mind.
Make confident decisions with incomplete information and thrive in fast-moving, evolving environments.
Bring curiosity and hands-on experience with agentic workflows, using them to raise the bar for engineering..

new_jobs.title: Solutions Architect
new_jobs.location: Newcastle Upon Tyne, England, United Kingdom
new_jobs.description:
Plenty of architect roles have you writing documents nobody reads. This one has you building.

You go into a client, work out the solution, then help build the early versions yourself. You are working alongside the development team, not producing artefacts that get filed and forgotten.

This is a mid-level role in our architecture function, with a clear path into senior architecture as you grow.

The work varies a lot. You might be shaping a cloud setup one week and pulling AI into a delivery workflow the next.

Why you'd want it

You stay close to the code, writing it yourself where it makes sense, increasingly with AI tooling.

You get condensed experience. A couple of years in a consultancy is worth more than a couple internal, because you have to do more.

And you get variety, in the technology you touch and the clients you work with.

What You'll Do

Go into discovery, understand the problem, and shape the technical solution
Translate between engineers and clients, so both sides stay clear on what is being built
Build the early versions and stay close to the code
Define the infrastructure and cloud setups behind the solutions you design
Build awareness of the commercial and scoping side, picking up pre-sales estimation as you go

What Comes With The Role

28 days annual leave plus bank holidays
5 Impact Days for learning, innovation or volunteering
Flexible working environment
Enhanced parental leave
Annual wellbeing budget plus 2 wellbeing days
Mental health support
Company Mac

What You'll Bring

Essential. The heart of the role, and where your strongest experience needs to be:

A broad, hands-on technical background, rooted in engineering rather than business
AI software engineering experience, since a large part of our work now runs through it
Comfort writing and shipping code, increasingly with AI coding tools
Cloud and infrastructure experience, defining setups rather than just working within them
Strong communication, translating between low-level technical detail and non-technical stakeholders
A fast learner who context switches well and stays curious outside their own specialism

Also Important

Systems and solution design
Awareness of pre-sales estimation and scoping
Agile delivery

Who We Are

We make digital products that help clients do what they set out to do. We do our best work when the problem is hard and the constraints are real.

We are a certified B Corp with a Flexa-certified culture, with offices in Edinburgh, Newcastle, Leeds, Manchester and London. Our work speaks for itself. You can see some of it here.

Where you'll be based

Hybrid: home, office, or a mix. We just ask that you are within 50 miles of one of our offices: Edinburgh, Newcastle, Leeds, Manchester or London.

Interested?

If you want the range of consultancy work and a role that keeps you building rather than just designing, we want to hear from you.
