new_jobs.title: Software Test Engineer — Verification & Test Automation
new_jobs.description:
Denna annons är publicerad i samarbete med Jobbet.se. Ansökan sker via Jobbet.se:s hemsida.

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure? Scandinavian Real Heart (Realheart) is a Swedish company developing and manufacturing an artificial heart that mimics the anatomy and function of the human heart. In Västerås, where the company was originally founded, our team is working to take the technology from development to clinical reality. Realheart is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

About the role

We are hiring a Software Test Engineer to own software verification for a Class III medical device system spanning embedded firmware, desktop applications and the communication between them. This is a verification role in the regulatory sense: you will derive test cases from approved software requirements, demonstrate objectively that the software meets them, and produce the traceable, auditable evidence that supports the design history file and technical documentation.

You will also develop and maintain the automation that makes verification repeatable. Using a Python-based test framework integrated with CI/CD, you will help turn regression testing from extensive manual work into reliable pipeline-driven execution.

You will analyse software requirements and design specifications for testability, ambiguity and measurable acceptance criteria. You will create verification plans, protocols and test cases, select and justify suitable verification methods, define expected results and pass/fail criteria, and maintain traceability from requirement through execution record to result.

The role also includes executing protocols under configuration control, documenting objective evidence, managing deviations and amendments, investigating defects, and writing verification reports. You will contribute to design reviews and audits by clearly explaining and defending the verification approach.

On the automation side, you will design, build and maintain test frameworks and automated suites across unit, integration and system levels. This includes developing test harnesses, simulators, stubs and fixtures, as well as supporting hardware-in-the-loop testing where appropriate. You will integrate suites into GitHub Actions and help ensure that automated results can serve as reliable verification evidence.

About you

You have experience of working with software testing in a regulated environment and understand the importance of disciplined design control, configuration management and technical documentation. You are comfortable moving between detailed test work and the broader verification argument, and you can distinguish between requirement, implementation and test defects.

To succeed in the role, you combine a rigorous, structured approach with practical engineering judgement. You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating closely with software, firmware, systems and QA/RA colleagues to keep requirements, code and tests aligned.

What we offer

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of verification in a complex medical device environment and to contribute to both the verification process and the automation infrastructure that supports it. You will work across embedded firmware, desktop applications and connected interfaces, with a clear opportunity to influence templates, tooling and workflows as verification needs evolve. We welcome you to be a central member of our highly skilled and engaged team.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application. The application period runs from 18 September 2026 to 18 October 2026. For more information please feel welcome to contact Anna Nordanstig +46 70 306 55 64.

Interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.

Requirements

Experience of software testing in medical devices or another comparably regulated industry, such as aerospace, automotive, rail, nuclear, defence or regulated pharma/IVD.
Understanding of formal design control or safety lifecycles, including the distinction between design verification and design validation.
Demonstrated experience of requirements-driven test design, including defining objective acceptance criteria, maintaining traceability, and producing verification protocols and reports suitable for audit.
Experience of building and maintaining automated test suites, including framework design, test data management and test fixtures.
Experience of version control, change control and formal defect management.
Strong technical documentation skills, with attention to detail and traceability.
Strong spoken and written English.

Preferred qualifications

A Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, computer science or a closely related technical field; equivalent demonstrable experience is also valued.
Working familiarity with .NET/C# and C++, including the ability to read code, understand architecture and create meaningful integration tests.
Practical Python experience for test automation, using a framework such as pytest, unittest or Robot Framework.
CI/CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions, including workflow YAML, runners, matrices, secrets, caching and artifacts.
Experience of IEC 62304 software lifecycle activities, including software safety classification, testing expectations, SOUP management and anomaly evaluation.
Familiarity with ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR technical documentation and IEC 62366 usability engineering.
Experience of ALM or requirements-management tools such as Polarion, Jama, Codebeamer, DOORS or Azure DevOps, including generating trace matrices.
Experience of embedded or hardware-adjacent testing, for example serial protocols, CAN bus, instrument control, logic analysers, test rigs or hardware-in-the-loop frameworks.
Experience of static analysis, code coverage measurement and their role in software verification.
Experience of FDA inspections, notified body audits, or regulatory submissions such as 510(k), PMA or CE submissions.
Exposure to cybersecurity testing for connected medical devices.

About the employer – Scandinavian Real Heart

Would you like to help build the world’s best artificial heart – a technology that could save the lives of people suffering from severe heart failure?

Scandinavian Real Heart AB is a Swedish MedTech company that develops a total artificial heart (TAH) for implantation in patients with life-threatening heart failure. Realheart® TAH has a unique, patented design that resembles that of the natural human heart. Only about 8,000 heart transplants occur annually worldwide, and the availability of donated hearts is very limited. Realheart’s mission is to save as many patients who suffer from congestive heart disease as possible through this advanced MedTech solution. Realheart has a an extremely competent and engaged team placed in Västerås in Sweden and is also carried out in very close collaboration with world-leading heart surgeons and international researchers and engineers. In 2028 the goal is to be able to perform the first implantation in a human patient. Realheart is a public company listed on Nasdaq First North and has recently announced its goal of being ready for implantation in its first patient in February 2028.

new_jobs.title: ERP Integration & Automation Specialist, Lund
new_jobs.description:
Job Title

ERP Integration & Automation Specialist, Lund

Job Description

Connect the systems that keep a global business moving . Every order Axis fulfills, every product we manufacture, every purchase we make touches our ERP platform. And none of it works unless the systems talk to each other properly.

That's where you come in. We're looking for an ERP Integration and Automation Specialist to join our ERP & PLM Applications team, where you'll build the connections and remove the manual work that slows a fast-growing global business down.

The role is based at our headquarters in Lund or at our office in Linköping.

Who is your future team?

You'll join our ERP & PLM applications team, the group behind some of the most business-critical applications at Axis. We support a global organization and run the full application lifecycle, from daily support to long-term development and upgrades.

The team sits in Lund and Linköping, and we work with colleagues around the world to improve our ERP platform. You'll have people close by to think out loud with, and a global organization to make an impact on.

What will you do here?

Our ERP platform is a global solution that supports many of our core functions, including manufacturing, warehousing, order fulfillment, purchasing, and finance. You'll work closely with users, business stakeholders, and your teammates to solve problems, sharpen end-to-end processes, and shape what comes next.

Your responsibilities include:

Design, build, and maintain integrations between our ERP solution and connected systems
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data flows and integration performance
Make sure integrations stay secure, scalable, and aligned with our architectural guidelines
Spot opportunities to automate manual and repetitive tasks in and around the ERP solution
Help the business put smart automation to work, so processes run smoother
Support implementation and deployment projects
Improve our platform continuously, alongside the rest of the team
Keep solutions consistent by collaborating across functions

Who are we looking for?

You're a team player who enjoys working with people, whether they sit in the next room or on another continent. You're curious about how things fit together, you share your ideas and your knowledge, and you get a small kick out of replacing a manual routine with something that just runs.

You have experience with integration and automation, ideally around Microsoft Dynamics 365 or IFS

We'd love to hear that you have:

A solid understanding of integration patterns, APIs, REST and OData, JSON and XML
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, such as Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience balancing ongoing support with improvement work and projects
A knack for identifying and refining requirements for business processes and the systems behind them
The initiative to find, track, and resolve issues without waiting to be asked
Familiarity with databases, data modeling, and data management

What Axis Has To Offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.

Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “ fika ” chats, formal meetings,   or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:

Life at Axis blog 

Engineering at Axis blog 

Innovation at Axis 

Ready to Act?

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

If you have any questions, please reach out to recruiting Manager Maria Malmborg, maria.malmborg@axis.com

Type of Employment

Permanent Employment

Posting End Date

2026-09-20

Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action.

About Axis Communications

We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.

With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.

Let´s create a smarter, safer world

For more information about Axis, please visit our website www.axis.com.

new_jobs.description:
ccenture is hiring an Automotive Software Platform Verification Senior Engineer
to strengthen our automotive team in Gothenburg.

In this cross-functional role you will be on-site technical representative
at customer location to provide direct support and contribute to developing and maintaining developer platform infrastructure
and software-in-the-loop (SiL) environments.
The role focuses on faster, more reliable, and more automated verification of embedded software. This role requires frequent presence at client premises in Gothenburg, thus we look for candidates having existing working permit/rights in Sweden or right to work in EU.

Industry X is Accenture’s capability focused on engineering and manufacturing transformation — it’s about how products are designed, built, connected, and operated across their entire lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

For the Developer Platform, design and maintain a unified, hermetic developer container (Docker/OCI) for toolchains, build systems, SDKs and test runners (Linux, QNX, FreeRTOS, Android)

Build and manage CI/CD pipelines; maintain container registry with versioned images and changelogs

Establish a clear E2E developer journey: bring-up scripts, debugging workflows, log/trace collection

Enable and optimize workloads on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Terraform)

Enable developers and testers to work with embedded automotive software stacks in pure-software environments (software-in-the-loop, SiL)

Implement multi-VM / container communication on protocol layers (Ethernet, SomeIP, CAN)

Develop helper tools and integrate simulation models into the SiL environment

As on-site customer interface, serve as on-site technical liaison; support integration, verification and vehicle testing at customer facilities

Facilitate rapid issue identification, debugging and resolution; communicate feedback to development teams

Provide hands-on support for software flashing, configuration and milestone reviews

Primary skills for the role:

experience in customer-facing roles and automotive projects

Python and Bash proficiency

Cloud / IaC: Terraform, AWS (or equivalent), developer environments at scale

CI/CD: GitHub Actions, pipeline-as-code, artifact management

Containers: Docker/OCI multi-stage builds, registry management, hermetic environments

Automotive protocols: Automotive Ethernet, SomeIP, CAN, LIN, UDS — including in software-only setups

Simulation tooling, especially Vector SIL-Kit

Strong SOC/MCU software integration knowledge

Good communication skills; fluent English

Nice if you have also some of these skills:

OSP Cuttlefish / Android virtual device experience

Build systems: Bazel (preferred) CMake/Ninja, Yocto/BitBake, AOSP, QNX SDP, ARM cross-compilation

Yocto SDK and sysroot

SBOM generation and supply-chain tooling in CI

MISRA/AUTOSAR static analysis tools (Polyspace, Axivion, Coverity)

Distributed build systems (Bazel, IncrediBuild)

Virtual targets: QEMU/KVM, GDB/KGDB remote debugging

C++ experience

What We Can Offer You

Competitive compensation and benefits

Flexible work hours with a good work-life balance

Significant development opportunities and support for progressing in your professional career.

Rich opportunities to develop your business acumen, consulting toolbox, industry knowledge, technical and professional skills.

Meaningful and exciting client projects

A phenomenal opportunity through working with a great variation of projects and industries.

A dedicated mentor following your career journey and a strong learning culture.

Responsibility, trust, and an inclusive work environment

The opportunity to get involved in Accenture´s volunteering, Women in Tech, sport- and social groups.

Access to industry and capability specialists in all corners of the world with outstanding international knowledge and experience

A good and inclusive working environment, where you will work with inspiring and skilled colleagues and managers.

Apply now by sending your CV and relevant certificates.

new_jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom applications-team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation, med leverans av affärskritiska cloudlösningar i hög kvalitet och hastighet, möjliggjort av Generative AI. Bli en del av oss och hjälp världsledande organisationer att frigöra teknikens värde och bygga en mer hållbar och inkluderande framtid!

Om rollen

Vill du designa moderna lösningar där AI, cloud och data samverkar för att skapa skalbara och intelligenta system? Som lösningsarkitekt arbetar du med att analysera och designa lösningar för skalbara cloudlösningar, AI‑drivna applikationer och integrationsplattformar, baserat på kundernas behov, krav och processer. Du arbetar i kundprojekt inom flera branscher och möter kontinuerligt nya tekniska och affärsmässiga utmaningar. Genom din breda tekniska förståelse kan du översätta krav och behov till hållbara, säkra och effektiva lösningar samt ge teknisk guidning och stöd till teamet. Genom att vara driven, kommunikativ och samarbetsorienterad är du med och ser till att leveransen möter kraven.

I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i:

Designa och leda arkitekturen för skalbara, säkra och AI‑drivna lösningar
Säkerställa helhetsperspektivet genom att definiera lösningsdesign, integrationsmönster och tekniska vägval i samarbete med utvecklare och andra arkitekter
Vägleda team i hur AI, data och cloud samverkar, inklusive hur agentiska AI‑lösningar integreras i kundernas system

Din profil

Du arbetar som lösningsarkitekt idag samt har en bakgrund som systemutvecklare
Erfarenhet av att utveckla eller integrera AI-lösningar (Agentic-AI, Gen-AI, ML)
Erfarenhet av arkitektur- och designprinciper för att bygga skalbara, säkra och effektiva system
Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta i molnlösningar, exempelvis Azure eller AWS
Du har god förståelse och kunskap kring säkerhetsprinciper och hur de bäst tillämpas i praktiken
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift
Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning

Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas

Möjlighet att bygga AI-drivna lösningar på riktigt, inte bara använda AI som verktyg
En kultur som uppmuntrar lärande, innovation och kunskapsdelning, med tydliga möjligheter till certifieringar, kompetensutveckling och mentorskap
Flexibelt arbete som stödjer balans i livet, i kombination med kontinuerligt lärande och utveckling
Möjlighet att arbeta med teknik i framkant och påverka, i samarbete med andra specialister och några av världens ledande organisationer
En inkluderande och engagerande arbetsplats med konkurrenskraftiga förmåner, aktiva tech communities och interna initiativ med fokus på gemenskap, hållbarhet och välmående
Vi har en hybrid arbetsmodell, vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att variera med att jobba från kontor eller hemifrån.

Ansökan

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Bentley Systems

Location: Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid/On-site)

Position Summary

Operating directly within our global Product & Technology organisation, this role functions as an internal Forward Deployed Software Engineer. We are looking for an adaptable, highly autonomous senior engineer to tackle rapid prototyping, architectural de-risking, and tactical engineering initiatives.

Rather than maintaining a traditional product lifecycle, you will partner closely with our leadership team, including the CTO, senior engineers and architects on short-cycle strategic initiatives. Your customers are Bentley's global Product & Technology (P&T) organization - the teams responsible for building and operating the products and solutions that power our customers' success.

You will take on complex, ambiguous technical challenges, rapidly evaluate solution options across the full stack, from architecture and design to hands-on implementation, build functional proof-of-concepts, and transition successful solutions to our core product teams.

Responsibilities

Full-Spectrum Problem Solving: Fluidly navigate across varied technical domains depending on the project. One month you may be addressing deep performance profiling and cloud reliability; the next, you may be building modern front-end spikes or evaluating microservice patterns.
De-Risk Architecture: Architect, code, and benchmark functional proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to validate performance and evaluate emerging technologies before Bentley makes a company-wide commitment.
Operate Across the Stack & Cloud: Leverage a wide range of technologies, acting as a polyglot across multiple programming languages and major cloud platforms to deliver the right solution for the business.
Ensure Frictionless Hand-offs: Package your validated architectures, write the technical summary, and hand the clean, maintainable deliverables over to our global P&T teams so you can pivot to the next strategic unknown.

Qualifications

0-to-1 Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrable track record of designing, building, and delivering complex, high-performance software in fast-paced environments.
Ownership and Bias for Action: You are highly self-directed, comfortable operating autonomously without extensive supervision, and driven to turn ambiguity into actionable solutions.
Curiosity and Learning Agility: You possess an aptitude to select the best tool for the specific problem at hand. You have working fluency across multiple programming languages (such as C#, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++) and continuously learn new ones.
Empathy and Partnership: You view the global P&T organization as your customer, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring your prototypes are built with their eventual operational needs in mind.
AI-Amplified Output: Practical experience leveraging generative AI APIs, vector retrieval/RAG patterns, or daily integration of AI-assisted engineering tools to amplify output.
High-Signal Communication: Ability to synthesize complex technical discoveries, trade-offs, and architectural recommendations into direct, high-signal summaries for technical leadership.
Big Picture Architecture: Solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems, multi-tenant patterns, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

What We Offer

A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video.
An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start.
An attractive salary and benefits package.
A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

 About Bentley Systems

Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com

Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

new_jobs.title: Bli med å kvalitetssikre samfunnskritiske IT-løsninger med Quality Engineering, Test og Testledelse
new_jobs.description:
Accenture søker erfarne og dedikerte testere som vil være med å videreutvikle vårt fagmiljø innen Quality Engineering. Du blir en del av et sterkt og erfarent team på ca. 30 personer – som sammen jobber med å kvalitetssikre noen av de mest komplekse og samfunnsviktige IT-løsningene i Norge.

I våre prosjekter jobber vi med helhetlig og kontinuerlig testing og kvalitetssikring av komplekse og samfunnskritiske IT-løsninger. I denne rollen får du utfordret deg på et bredt spekter av ferdigheter innen fagområdet Quality Engineering og Testing, inkludert bruk av Kunstig Intelligens i testrollen.

Høres dette spennende ut? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er en kreativ og erfaren tester, med interesse for å koordinere testaktiviteter på tvers av team. Du synes det er givende å jobbe med samfunnskritiske systemer og du omfavner DevOps som tilrettelegger for effektiv testing og raske leveranser. Du har erfaring med API-drevet testing og du har et stort engasjement for automatisering. Du er initiativrik og har et detaljert øye for helheten i et prosjekt. Du er en person som er interessert i kontinuerlig læring og utvikling og trives i å sette deg inn i nye og komplekse funksjonelle og tekniske problemstillinger.

I tillegg er du løsningsorientert, nysgjerrig og liker å sette deg inn i nye problemstillinger der du deler av din kunnskap. Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner og trives i tverrfaglige team der du bygger bro mellom teknologi og forretning. Du liker å jobbe i team, samtidig som du liker å jobbe selvstendig med krevende arbeidsoppgaver hos våre kunder.

Du vil ha innflytelse på arbeidshverdagen og det du ønsker å jobbe med. Hos oss sitter du i førersetet for din fremtidige teknologikarriere, enten av om du ønsker å bli en ekspert innen et område, eller en leder med bredere faglig- og teknologibakgrunn. Accenture er en karriereskole der du coacher andre, og der du selv blir coachet.

Oppsummert, vi ser etter deg som:  

Har minimum tre års utdannelse som Bachelor

3+ års erfaring med test og kvalitetssikring som tester i team i smidige prosjekter

Erfaring med testadminstasjonsverktøy som Jira og Confluence eller lignende verktøy for oppgavestyring og testadministrasjon

Har vært utførende på test av GUI, funksjonell test av brukergrensesnittet, backend-testing, test av funksjoner og forretningslogikk

Har kjennskap eller erfaring med ett eller flere av følgende verktøy: Bruno, SoapUI, Postman, JMeter, Selenium, Playwright, SQL og databaseverktøy, Camunda, Kafka, Splunk

Har erfaring med testing på strømmende data og Kafka

Kjennskap til kunstig intelligens og prompt engineering

ISTQB Foundation sertifisering (eller planer om å ta den)

Flytende norsk muntlig og skriftlig (tilsvarende C1 eller bedre)

Hvem er vi? 

I tillegg til prosjektarbeid jobber vi i fagmiljøet med de nyeste innovative løsninger innen Quality Engineering. Vi organiserer workshops internt og for kunder, deltar og presenterer på konferanser, holder gjesteforelesninger på høgskoler og universiteter samt støtter salgsaktiviteter. Utover fagmiljøet har vi goder som firmahytter, sosiale grupper av mange slag, årlige fester og sosiale samlinger. Det er viktig for oss å trives på jobb!

Vi dyrker både fag og fellesskap, og hos oss får du støtte til å utvikle deg videre – enten du vil fordype deg som teknolog, eller gå en ledervei.

"Det mest givende med jobben min er kombinasjonen av teknisk utvikling og reell samfunnsinnvirkning. Vi jobber med nye teknologistakker, automatisering og AI – og bidrar samtidig til tryggere tjenester for folk flest."

— Shiladitya, systemtestleder i Accenture

Stillingen rapporterer til leder for Quality Engineering Norge. Arbeidssted: Oslo - med fleksible løsninger.

new_jobs.title: Software Developer (Application development)
new_jobs.description:
NAPA Design Solutions offers a comprehensive solution for 3D ship modeling and design tools covering hull form design and hydrodynamics, hydrostatics and stability, structural design, and information sharing across the shipbuilding process. These are among the most powerful tools in the industry, trusted by the world's largest shipyards and classification societies.

The role: what is it about?

The team is now looking for a Software Developer who will focus on application usability development with .NET, C#, WPF and XAML. Development, testing, and maintenance of the NAPA ship design solutions are part of your daily work. In this role you will mainly work on developing NAPA Engineer, a modern design and computing platform for naval architects. It combines trusted NAPA calculation capabilities with a redesigned, intuitive user experience and a powerful visual approach to engineering workflows. You can read more about the solution at: https://www.napa.fi/software-and-services/ship-design/software/napa-engineer/

You will do this work with artificial intelligence (AI) as a normal part of your toolchain. We use agentic coding capability across our development teams, which means using AI coding agents to plan, write, test, review and refactor code, and doing it in a way that improves both delivery speed and code quality. We expect you to use these tools in your daily work, to help us learn where they work well and where they do not, and to share those learnings with your team.

You will be working with Windows desktop applications, native libraries, third-party components, including a 3D graphics library, database engines, a licensing solution, and more
.

This job is permanent and full-time
.

Your team and job location

You will work in an international team where your closest colleagues are experienced software developers and naval architectural domain experts who will support you in your role. You will also interact with local and global colleagues
from various teams in software development, UX design, DevOps, and sales. Together with them you will also shape how we use AI coding agents in practice, from tooling choices to review practices.

Our office is located in Helsinki (Ruoholahti), and you can work at the office or in hybrid mode
. We hope to meet you at our Helsinki office regularly.

What are we looking for?

What matters most: you're curious about UI development, energized by AI-assisted development tools, and hungry to solve real problems as a self-starter
. If the visual side of UI excites you too, that's a big plus.

Our Ideal Candidate Would Have

Academic degree in a relevant field such as computer science, mathematics, physics, naval architecture, or engineering
Completed basic studies and/or having a good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and OOP (object-oriented programming)
2+ years of experience in building native Windows desktop applications
Experience in UI design
Experience using WPF, C#, and XAML
Understanding of user experience and the ability to apply it in your own design work
Hands-on experience of using AI coding assistants or coding agents in real development work, together with the judgment to review, test and take responsibility for what they produce
Interest in NAPA’s domain (maritime business)

Additionally, The Following Skills Would Be Considered An Advantage

Experience with agentic coding workflows
Knowledge or studies in usability
Experience with database solutions
Experience in automated testing methods
Knowledge of software reliability and maintainability
Experience in CAD or CAE applications

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English
across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

You get to combine modern desktop application development on a next-generation engineering platform, combined with AI agentic development that we are scaling across the company
The design work of the world's largest shipyards and classification societies happens in the software you develop
Great colleagues with expertise in, for example, naval architecture, software development and UX design
A global team of 230 experts who support you and share what they know
When you join NAPA, you will be assigned an onboarding buddy who will help ensure a smooth start and introduce you to the NAPA way of working

Ready to get on board and join the napa crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the "Apply for this job" button on the job ad page), but no later than 11 October 2026
. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, please send your questions by e-mail to jobs@napa.fi. Notice that we cannot accept job applications sent by e-mail.

NAPA as a company and as an employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 230 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

With over 90% of new vessels built by NAPA customers, NAPA’s ship design software is the global de facto standard in shipbuilding. Furthermore, NAPA is a market leader in ship stability management and safety data services for passenger ships, and its cloud-based solutions for ship performance monitoring and voyage optimization support shipping’s decarbonization journey. For more information, visit www.napa.fi .

Meaningful work

We are proud to play our part in creating a sustainable world, and a career at NAPA means working with a purpose. We focus on building the best possible products for our customers, with whom we have close and long-lasting relationships. We protect the environment and human life at sea by powering safer and greener vessels with our technology.

NAPA way of working

At NAPA, we lead and manage the company together. We help and learn from each other, while making impactful decisions for a cleaner, safer maritime industry.

At its heart, our co-leadership philosophy is founded on trust. We trust that our people are smart enough that if they make a decision, having consulted the right people, it will be good for our company. And if it's not the right decision on that occasion, that's fine too. We trust that we'll make it right, learn from the decision, and grow as a company as a result.

Enjoy working together

new_jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help modernize a product area at the heart of construction projects.

Dalux is growing, and we are looking for an experienced software developer to join our team called "Tender".

You will work on software that supports the bidding process for construction projects and is tightly integrated with the wider Dalux platform. It is a domain where reliability, data security, and good technical design matter – and where there is plenty of opportunity to influence how the product and architecture evolve.

You will also have the opportunity to influence how we increasingly use AI to make software development more effective.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will join a full-stack development team working closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Within Tender, there is a particular focus on strengthening and evolving the technical foundation of the product while continuing to deliver new functionality.

Your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and the technical direction of the team
Improving the structure of an established codebase and reducing technical debt
Helping evolve boundaries and modularity within the application
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas, technologies, and development practices into the team when they create real value

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

The Tender team is already experimenting with how these tools can improve its day-to-day development work.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in that development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue evolving your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Tender is a full-stack product area primarily built with:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
MSSQL
Elasticsearch

Our wider platform runs on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

What would make you a particularly strong match?

We are looking for an experienced software developer with strong technical fundamentals and the ability to influence the software around you.

For this particular team, we would especially value:

Strong professional experience with C# and .NET
Experience improving or modernizing established software systems
An understanding of Domain-Driven Design, modular architecture, or similar approaches to structuring complex applications
Experience mentoring or providing technical sparring to other developers
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

You do not need to match every point.

Technical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to make an established product better are more important than having worked with exactly the same technologies or architectural patterns before.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussions
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to improve an established product and architecture
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Interested?

If you are looking for a role where you can remain hands-on while gaining greater technical influence and helping evolve an established product and architecture, we would like to hear from you.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact IT Talent Acquisition Specialist Sara at sni@dalux.com.

Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!
🚀🏎️

We are looking for a new colleague to join our talented Technology team based at our Vejle office.

At AutoProff, we believe great technology drives great experiences—and we’re just getting started. We’re on a mission to transform the way vehicles are traded across Europe, and we need curious and driven new colleagues to help us do it.

As our new Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, you’ll join a cross-functional team responsible for building a unified seller solution that powers how vehicles enter and move through the AutoProff platform. We focus on enabling dealers to efficiently manage, price, and sell their inventory by combining streamlined vehicle intake, data-driven pricing, and intuitive seller tools. Our work simplifies trade-ins, improves sourcing decisions, and helps dealers act faster and more confidently, ultimately unlocking value earlier in the vehicle lifecycle.

We foster a developer-friendly culture where innovation isn’t just encouraged; it’s expected. You’ll have access to modern, AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and streamline your daily work. We host hackathons to explore new tech, ideas and tools, and our internal developer forums are open spaces for discussing architecture, new technologies, and tough engineering challenges. Whether building or learning, there's always room to experiment and grow.

Let's dive into your key responsibilities. You will:

Work in a dynamic and international environment with experienced and skilled colleagues
Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable solutions across backend, web frontend, and mobile, using engineering best practices and design patterns.
Drive a culture of “you build it – you own it” mentality
Identify and act on areas for your own personal development
Mentor and coach co-workers on topics that you master.

What you’ll need

We’re looking for a pragmatic generalist with a strong backend foundation. You should be confident working with .NET and C#.

Strong hands-on experience building backend services with .NET and C#
Sound knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience working with databases
The ability to troubleshoot problems and take ownership of software in production
A collaborative and adaptable mindset, with a focus on shared ownership and continuous improvement
Good communication skills and fluency in business English

You do not need to be an expert in every part of our stack. We use agentic development to help engineers work effectively across technical boundaries. Sound engineering judgement, code reviews, and testing remain essential.

Nice to have

We’d also value experience in some of the following areas, but we do not expect you to bring all of them:

Feeling comfortable contributing to web frontend and, when needed, React Native development
Distributed systems and event-driven architecture
Vue 3 and TypeScript; we are currently transitioning from Webpack to Vite
React Native and TypeScript
AWS or another cloud provider, particularly containerization or serverless computing
Designing and working with RESTful APIs

We’re eager to hear from you. If the role sounds like a good match, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every nice-to-have. Curiosity, sound engineering judgement, and the willingness to learn matter more to us than matching every part of the stack.

AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

In August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

END DATE 5 Mar 2027

hybrid 60% on-site in

About the Role
The Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) is responsible for the design, governance and scaling of Azure and self-service platform.

We are looking for a senior engineer to help clean up the technical depth — from landing zone architecture to Terraform Enterprise module engineering, networking design and enterprise system integrations. This is a medior/senior individual contributor role: you're expected to work independently on well-defined scopes, but you'll be ramping up within an existing team structure rather than owning the full platform strategy from day one.

Current Situation
The Azure platform has grown fast — more application teams, more subscriptions, more consumers of our self-service capabilities every quarter. That
growth has been a success story, but it also means parts of our platform (governance controls, identity and access processes, networking/DNS patterns, and our Terraform Enterprise setup) were built for an earlier stage of adoption and now need to be modernized to keep pace with scale.

We're tackling this step by step: moving toward more standardized, automated and maintainable ways of working across governance, identity, networking and
infrastructure-as-code, so the platform can keep scaling without a proportional increase in manual effort.

To do that well, we're expanding the team with senior engineers who can contribute on two fronts: keeping day-to-day platform operations running smoothly for the
teams that depend on us, while also helping design and build the more standardized, scalable solutions we're moving toward.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Act as second-line escalation for Azure platform issues (RBAC, DNS, VNET/Private Endpoint connectivity, AD integration, Terraform Enterprise
runs) and write up root cause analyses.
Maintain and incrementally improve landing zones, archetypes, Azure Policy and naming/tagging standards; process governance exception requests.
Build, version and maintain Terraform modules; review consumer changes and evaluate Azure Verified Modules (AVM) as replacements for custom
modules.
Handle recurring IAM tickets (RBAC assignments, group memberships, access troubleshooting) and contribute to cleanup of legacy/exception-based
access.
Support DNS/connectivity requests and troubleshooting across the hybrid environment within existing patterns.
Maintain and troubleshoot existing PowerShell automation scripts used across platform operations.
Keep governance documentation current and contribute to internal Terraform Enterprise workshops and application team enablement.

Required Technical Expertise
Azure (hands-on production experience required)
Governance: management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), RBAC design and troubleshooting.
Identity: Microsoft Entra ID — group-based access models, app registrations, managed identities, service principals.
Networking: VNET peering/hub-spoke, Private Endpoints, Private DNS Zones, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, hybrid/on-prem DNS integration.
Landing zone concepts aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) archetypes.
Exposure to Azure Databricks networking (VNet injection) is a plus.
Infrastructure as Code
Solid production-level Terraform authoring — designing, versioning and publishing modules, not just consuming them.
Terraform Enterprise or Terraform Cloud experience specifically: workspaces, private module registry, VCS-driven workflows, policy checks (Sentinel/OPA).
Familiarity with Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and module lifecycle/versioning practices.

DevOps & Automation
CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps preferred): build/release pipelines, YAML pipelines, service connections.
Scripting for automation and troubleshooting (PowerShell, Bash or Python).
Comfortable working with KQL/Log Analytics for diagnostics is a plus.

Identity & Access Management
Practical RBAC design and troubleshooting at enterprise scale (role assignments, group nesting, inheritance issues, propagation delays).
Experience managing access for both human users and service/application identities.
Understanding of access governance concepts (ownership, periodic reviews, exception handling).

Networking
Solid understanding of enterprise DNS architecture, including hybrid on- prem/cloud scenarios.
Experience troubleshooting connectivity issues across VNETs, firewalls, and hybrid links.

Prior Experience we're Looking For
4–7 years in a cloud platform engineering, DevOps or infrastructure engineering role, ideally within a large, governed enterprise (not a greenfield/startup environment).
Demonstrated experience operating (not just building) an Azure landing zone platform at scale — supporting real application teams with real tickets.
Prior role involving Terraform Enterprise/Cloud in a production capacity, ideally including module authorship and CI/CD integration.
Experience working across team boundaries (IAM, Networking, Security, external partners/vendors) to resolve platform issues.
Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, or Terraform Associate) are a strong plus but not a substitute for demonstrable hands-on experience.
Personal Characteristics
Can operate independently on a well-scoped task from day one — this is a "plug in and go"; role, not a ramp-up position.
Comfortable working in a live, legacy-entangled environment where not everything is fully standardized yet.
Detail-oriented, especially around governance, documentation and naming/tagging consistency.
Good communicator — able to support application teams directly without needing everything translated by the platform lead.
Takes ownership of tickets/incidents end-to-end rather than escalating prematurely.

new_jobs.description:
Scientific Manager – Machine Learning Engineering (Computational Biology)

Ghent, Belgium (hybrid)

Who are we?

Excelra is a leader in biopharma data and analytics, that uniquely blends scientific understanding with technological expertise. This dual mastery empowers innovative drug discovery and development, transforming research data into actionable insights for groundbreaking discovery.

We have global locations in Ghent (Belgium), London (UK), Utrecht (The Netherlands), Boston/SFO (US) and Hyderabad (India).

www.excelra.com

About the role

We are hiring a Scientific Manager to take ownership of the machine learning and experimental design pipelines behind our customer’s genomic target prediction work. Much of this currently lives in individual scripts maintained by individual scientists. Your job is to turn it into an automated, version-controlled and reproducible platform the whole team can rely on – and to keep it scientifically sound by working shoulder to shoulder with our customer’s wet-lab and computational biology colleagues.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a scientific environment. You will spend more of your time building, automating and hardening pipelines than running individual analyses, so we are looking for someone who is as comfortable with Git, containers and workflow managers as with genomics data.

What will you do?

Automate and professionalize internal ML and experimental design pipelines for genomic target prediction.
Migrate existing scripts and notebooks into a production-ready, version-controlled codebase.
Reduce the manual input required for dataset preparation, settings configuration and pipeline execution.
Integrate pipelines into existing digital infrastructure, including AWS and HPC environments.
Implement version control, testing and reproducibility standards across ML workflows, and help the team adopt them.
Collaborate closely with wet-lab and computational biology colleagues to make sure pipelines meet real scientific requirements.
Run several projects in parallel, (re)assigning tasks as priorities shift, and present results concisely to stakeholders inside and outside your domain.

What do you bring?

A PhD in bioscience engineering, bioinformatics, computer science or machine learning engineering – or an MSc with 5+ years of equivalent experience. You can demonstrate this through peer-reviewed publications, contributions to public code repositories or relevant project work.
Strong Python, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can read, test and re-run.
Proven experience taking analysis code into production: version control with Git, code review, packaging, containerization (Docker, Singularity/Apptainer) and automated testing or CI/CD.
Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration – Nextflow, Snakemake or equivalent.
Experience running workloads on cloud infrastructure (AWS) and/or HPC clusters (e.g. SLURM).
Solid grounding in statistical modelling and machine learning applied to biological data, including model evaluation and experiment tracking.
The ability to translate between engineering and bench science, and to work with scientists who are not engineers.
You are eligible to live and work in Belgium.

Nice to have

Experience with genomics and transcriptomics data (RNAseq, single-cell, spatial, WES/WGS, …).
R alongside Python.
Experiment tracking and model registry tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases) or infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
Experience in a client-facing, consulting or CRO setting.

Who are you?

You enjoy project-based work and have a strong analytical mindset.
You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment with people of diverse professional backgrounds (IT, (molecular) biology, genomics, engineering, etc.).
You are communicative and customer focused.
You are fluent in English, both written and verbally.
You take initiative and have an eye for new opportunities.

What do we offer?

A challenging job environment with advancement opportunities.
Flexible hybrid working in an international (global) setting: largely home-based, with the option to work alongside colleagues in our Ghent office and occasional visits to our customers on site.
A dynamic company with an open culture, easy communication and an ambitious vision.
A rich & global team with a mix of backgrounds, experiences and expertise.
Independence and flexibility.
An attractive salary package with extra-legal benefits.

Interested?

Please send your resume and motivation letter to Helen De Block, HR Director: helen.deblock@excelra.com

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Senior DevOps-/Full-Stack-Engineer mit fundierter Praxis in React und C# sowie im Betrieb von Container-/Kubernetes-Umgebungen; Kenntnisse in Dapr oder vergleichbaren Microservice-Runtimes sind von Vorteil.

:

An den Schweizer Standorten Zürich, Bern und Lausanne arbeiten rund 450 Mitarbeitende.

Du gestaltest Lösungen von Anfang an mit. Gemeinsam mit Fachpersonen, Architects und Delivery Leads konkretisierst du Anforderungen, entwickelst technische Lösungsansätze und machst deren Machbarkeit durch Demos, PoCs und MVPs greifbar.
Du entwickelst Data- & AI-Anwendungen bis zur Produktionsreife. Du implementierst Services, Agenten und Agent-Teams und integrierst AI-Komponenten in APIs, Datenbanken, Fachsysteme und Benutzeroberflächen.

Dieser Job ist für dich, wenn...

Praktische Erfahrung entlang des Software Development Lifecycle. Du hast Lösungen mit AI-Komponenten entwickelt, deployt und im produktiven Einsatz begleitet. Du kennst die Herausforderungen beim Übergang vom Prototyp zur produktiven Anwendung.
Fundiertes Software-Engineering-Know-how. Du beherrschst Python auf produktionsreifem Niveau und bringst Projekterfahrung in einem weiteren Enterprise-Stack wie C#/.NET oder Java/Spring Boot mit. Modularer Code, API-Entwicklung, SQL und Git gehören zu deinem Handwerk.
Praktische Erfahrung mit Agentic AI. Du kennst Agents, Agent-Teams und Agentic Frameworks sowie Tool-Calling, strukturierte Ausgaben und multimodale Verarbeitung mit Voice und Vision. Du setzt Berechtigungen, Fehlerbehandlung und Human-in-the-Loop gezielt um.

Beratungskompetenz und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen, sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau

Do you want to turn business challenges into smart, scalable solutions with Microsoft Power Platform? At Tieto Tech Consulting, we work at the intersection of technology, consulting, and customer value - helping organizations automate processes and build modern digital solutions that make daily work easier and more impactful.

With over 8,000 colleagues worldwide and around 300 colleagues in the DACH region, we combine industry insight, software engineering, cloud expertise, data capabilities, and enterprise solutions know-how to help our customers design, build, and run their digital businesses.

We are looking for a Microsoft Power Platform Architect who can take ownership of enterprise-level solution architectures, guide customers in strategic technology decisions, and translate complex business needs into scalable, secure and future-ready Microsoft ecosystem solutions. If you are passionate about architecture, governance, cloud technologies and creating sustainable business value with Power Platform, this role offers the opportunity to shape impactful solutions together with skilled colleagues and forward-thinking customers.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Microsoft Power Platform Architect, you

Define and own end-to-end Power Platform architectures, ensuring scalable, secure and sustainable solution designs across Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages
Advise customers on best practices for Power Platform governance and lifecycle management
Lead the architectural integration of Power Platform solutions into broader Microsoft 365 and Azure ecosystems, aligning technical decisions with enterprise standards and customer strategy
Facilitate architecture workshops, guide decision-making with customers and provide expert recommendations on solution design, governance and technical roadmaps
Stay up-to-date with Microsoft certifications and contribute to internal capability building

Who We Are Looking For

We value diverse backgrounds and welcome candidates who bring:

5+ years of hands-on experience in a similar role
Very good knowledge of Cloud Enterprise Architecture, Power Platform, Azure and Azure AI ecosystems
A completed degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable qualification
Certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, PL-600 or PL-900 are a plus
Hands-on knowledge of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, and GPT-based solutions
Strong understanding of low-code/no-code development principles
Good programming skills, preferably with C#/.NET
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
A consulting mindset and strong communication skills in both German and English
Passion for continuous learning and staying up-to-date with new developments

As an individual, you are a team player who takes initiative and ownership. You communicate clearly, organize your work effectively, and enjoy solving complex challenges. You’re eager to learn and share knowledge, and you thrive in a fast-evolving technology landscape.

We offer

Collaboration with highly skilled experts across Europe and beyond
A culture built on trust, collaboration, and continuous learning
Flexible hybrid working models and modern ways of working
Benefits like laptop and smartphone also for private use, health programs, team events, excellent public transport connection, food vouchers, contribution to the costs of the Austrian “Klimaticket”, fresh fruits, the perfect environment to prosper professionally, and a lot more
Continuous professional development and international career opportunities
An attractive compensation package including performance-based incentives

The monthly gross salary for this position will start from € 4.476,00 (based on IT collective agreement, ST1 Erfahrungsstufe) on a full-time basis, depending on your qualifications and experience. If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please attach your CV or LinkedIn profile, and we will get in touch.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact us: careers.austria@tieto.com.

We’re also happy to connect you with one of your future colleagues for an informal conversation. It’s a great opportunity to hear first-hand what the role looks like, how we work and what it’s like to be part of the team.

Please note that while we are happy to answer questions via email, we can only consider applications submitted through our online application system and therefore cannot accept applications sent directly by email.

Vienna, Linz, Graz

At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily.

As a Software Architect, you will help shape the future of our SaaS platform as we evolve from a serverless, AWS-oriented approach toward a more container-based, cloud-native architecture. You will work across a mixed technology landscape, helping steer the platform in a .NET-preferred
direction while understanding and supporting existing Python-based services. This is a key role for someone who enjoys combining technical vision, pragmatic decision-making, and cross-team leadership to build scalable, secure, and maintainable software.

What You Will Do

Define and evolve the architectural vision for scalable, secure, and maintainable SaaS solutions aligned with business goals.
Lead architecture decisions across services, APIs, integrations, and platform capabilities.
Guide the move toward container-based architectures and modern cloud-native engineering practices.
Work closely with engineering teams to improve software design, code quality, testing, deployment, and production readiness.
Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to align solutions with company standards, templates, and deployment practices around Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, and monorepo workflows.
Shape multi-tenant SaaS capabilities, including tenant-aware services, security boundaries, and platform scalability.
Partner with product management, stakeholders, and technical leaders to shape and defend the technical roadmap.
Mentor engineers and help foster strong architectural and engineering practices across teams.
Represent your team in the broader architecture community and contribute to alignment across departments.

Your profile
What is a must?

Proven experience in a Software Architect or similar senior technical leadership role.
Strong experience designing distributed systems and cloud-native applications in container-based environments.
Solid knowledge of Kubernetes and modern deployment practices for containerized workloads.
Strong experience with .NET / C#, and the ability to guide architecture in a mixed-technology environment.
Strong understanding of software architecture principles, OOP, SOLID, design patterns, and maintainable system design.
Experience designing SaaS and multi-tenant solutions.
Strong knowledge of API design, HTTP, REST, and service integration patterns.
Solid understanding of application and API security best practices.
Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases.
Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain and defend technical decisions across technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, and create alignment across teams.

What is nice to have?

Experience with Python in production systems.
Familiarity with Helm, ArgoCD, and monorepo-based development models.
Experience with at least one major cloud provider such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.
Knowledge of OIDC, OAuth2, JWT, and modern identity patterns.
Familiarity with Linux and scripting in Bash or PowerShell.

What’s Waiting For You

Work that matters

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.

At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.

A people-centered space

When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.

At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.

An environment of trust

As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls.

At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.

A career ready to build

When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.

At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count.

NUESTRO CLIENTE

Compañía tecnológica de capital privado, multinacional inglesa con fuerte presencia en Europa, especializada en servicios IT, cloud, infraestructura, ciberseguridad, workplace, managed services y transformación digital para grandes organizaciones. Con presencia en España desde hace más de 25 años. Global y large accounts.

EL PROYECTO

En el marco de su crecimiento en España (y global), la compañía está impulsando una nueva unidad de negocio especializada en Inteligencia Artificial
, concebida como una línea estratégica de alto impacto dentro del grupo. Se trata de una apuesta corporativa con visibilidad internacional, conectada con HQ y con participación activa en el CoE global de IA de la compañía.
Se trata de una posición de nueva creación
que reportará directamente al Director de la Unidad de Negocio de IA en España. Su misión será clave para convertir la estrategia de IA en soluciones reales, vendibles, escalables y ejecutables para clientes enterprise.

El rol tendrá una doble dimensión especialmente atractiva. Por un lado, será una figura clave de cara al mercado, acompañando a clientes en la identificación de casos de uso, diseño de arquitecturas, construcción de propuestas, desarrollo de PoCs/PoVs y defensa técnica de soluciones de IA ante interlocutores C-Level. Por otro, tendrá también un papel innovador dentro de la propia organización, ayudando a desarrollar capacidades, metodologías, arquitecturas de referencia, aceleradores y modelos de servicio que permitan consolidar la práctica de IA en España.
Es una oportunidad especialmente interesante para un perfil que quiera participar en la construcción de una práctica de IA desde una fase inicial, con respaldo internacional, exposición a clientes estratégicos y capacidad real de influir en la propuesta de valor de la compañía.

PRINCIPALES FUNCIONES

Acompañar a los equipos comerciales y account managers en sesiones de discovery con clientes, identificando necesidades, pain points, casos de uso y criterios técnicos de decisión.
Diseñar arquitecturas de soluciones Data & AI basadas en plataformas cloud y tecnologías como Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Mistral AI u otras soluciones de IA privada o soberana.
Elaborar propuestas técnicas, Statements of Work, planes de PoC/PoV, estimaciones de esfuerzo, arquitecturas de referencia y documentación de solución.
Liderar respuestas técnicas a RFPs y RFIs, en coordinación con equipos de bid management, comercial, cloud, infraestructura, ciberseguridad y delivery.
Preparar y defender presentaciones técnicas, workshops de arquitectura, demos y sesiones ejecutivas ante CIOs, CTOs, responsables de datos, innovación, tecnología y negocio.
Diseñar patrones reutilizables para casos de uso habituales como Document Intelligence, Conversational AI, Knowledge Mining, RAG, automatización mediante agentes y procesos de IA aplicada.
Participar en la construcción de PoCs, PoVs, prototipos y aceleradores técnicos que permitan validar la viabilidad de la solución y demostrar valor de negocio.
Definir especificaciones técnicas para servicios gestionados de IA, incluyendo procedimientos operativos, monitorización, SLAs, LLMOps, AIOps y traspaso a equipos de delivery.
Garantizar que las soluciones diseñadas cumplen criterios de seguridad, privacidad, gobierno del dato, responsible AI y frameworks corporativos de cloud landing zones.
Colaborar activamente con el Centro de Excelencia Global de IA, incorporando buenas prácticas, metodologías, arquitecturas de referencia y capacidades diferenciales del grupo.
Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre nuevas herramientas, modelos, frameworks de orquestación y tendencias de mercado en el ámbito de IA generativa, agentes, RAG, MLOps/LLMOps y cloud AI.

PERFIL REQUERIDO

Buscamos un perfil técnico-consultivo con experiencia en arquitectura de soluciones Data & AI, preventa técnica o consultoría tecnológica, idealmente en compañías de servicios IT, integradores, consultoras tecnológicas, partners cloud, hyperscalers o empresas especializadas en datos e inteligencia artificial.

Muy valorable aportar experiencia real en el diseño de soluciones de IA aplicada, especialmente en arquitecturas GenAI, RAG, automatización, integración de APIs, plataformas cloud, gobierno del dato y modelos de operación.

Experiencia aproximada de 4 a 7 años, o superior, en Data & AI Solution Architecture, Technical Presales, Cloud AI Architecture, Data Platform Architecture o consultoría tecnológica especializada.
Conocimiento sólido de tecnologías del ecosistema Microsoft, especialmente Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio y Azure AI Document Intelligence.
Experiencia o conocimiento práctico de otras plataformas como AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Google Vertex AI o soluciones de Private/Sovereign AI.
Experiencia en diseño de arquitecturas RAG, patrones de orquestación de IA y frameworks como Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain o equivalentes.
Conocimiento de integración vía APIs, DevOps/MLOps, plataformas de datos, Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks o entornos similares.
Experiencia en preventa técnica: elaboración de propuestas, SoWs, RFPs/RFIs, estimaciones, dimensionamiento de proyectos y defensa técnica de soluciones ante cliente.
Capacidad para construir o liderar PoCs, PoVs, demos y prototipos orientados a demostrar valor de negocio.
Nivel alto de español e inglés (imprescindible)
Valorable certificación Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert o equivalentes.

QUÉ OFRECE ESTA OPORTUNIDAD

Incorporación a una unidad de IA de nueva creación dentro de una compañía tecnológica internacional consolidada.
Reporte directo al Director de la Unidad de Negocio de IA en España.
Participación activa en una práctica estratégica para el grupo, conectada con HQ y con el Centro de Excelencia Global de IA.
Exposición a clientes enterprise, grandes cuentas y proyectos de alto valor añadido.
